_readme: Cover URLs and neutral blurbs for everything the viewer app renders. Three namespaces because the tabs are keyed differently: `media` by book-cache.json key, `readMedia` by a slug of the books-read.md title, `rejectMedia` by a slug of entity+author in book-rejects.jsonl. Fully regenerable: run tools/fetch-media.py. Kept out of book-cache.json so a cover refresh never has to reserialise that hand-formatted file. Blurbs say what the book IS; whether the reader would like it is book-estimates.jsonl's `why` and must not be duplicated here. A slug join is deliberately loose - editing a title in books-read.md costs a placeholder cover, never a broken row. `coverOL` is an Open Library cover for a row whose `cover` is on obalkyknih.cz, which serves only registered library catalogues; the GitHub Pages copy of the viewer shows it instead, and null means Open Library had none.
_cover: Open Library cover id resolved by title+author search, rendered as https://covers.openlibrary.org/b/id/<id>-M.jpg. Null with a 'coverNote' means no match - the app draws a typographic placeholder, which is a missing cover and not an error.

morning-star.blurb: Third of the Red Rising books: Darrow's rebellion against the Gold caste comes to open war across the solar system.

mistborn-final-empire.blurb: A street thief joins a crew of magic-users planning to overthrow an immortal god-emperor, in a world where metals grant specific, rule-bound powers.

leviathan-wakes.blurb: An ice hauler and a station detective stumble into the same conspiracy as Earth, Mars and the asteroid Belt slide toward war.

fahrenheit-451.blurb: A fireman whose job is burning books begins to wonder what is in them.

mans-search-for-meaning.blurb: A psychiatrist's account of surviving Auschwitz, and the theory of meaning he built out of it.

half-a-king.blurb: A maimed prince, raised to be a scholar rather than a king, is betrayed and sold into slavery, and swears to take back what was his.

jurassic-park.blurb: A billionaire clones dinosaurs for a theme park, and the control systems he built fail exactly as the mathematician warned they would.

three-musketeers.blurb: A young Gascon arrives in Paris to join the King's musketeers and lands in the middle of a war between the crown and the cardinal.

shadow-of-what-was-lost.blurb: Twenty years after a rebellion stripped the magic-users of their power, a young man discovers he has abilities that were supposed to be gone.

night-flight-wind-sand-stars.blurb: Two short works by a pioneer airmail pilot on flying, danger and what it is that men owe each other.

leva-ruka-tmy.blurb: An envoy arrives alone on a glacial world whose people have no fixed sex, and has to understand its politics before he can explain his own.

narod-nation-pratchett.blurb: A tsunami leaves one island boy and one shipwrecked English girl to rebuild a people from nothing - Pratchett outside Discworld, on belief and what survives it.

divine-cities.blurb: A diplomat investigates a murder in a conquered city whose gods were killed but whose miracles have not entirely stopped.

silo-wool.blurb: Humanity lives in a buried silo under rules nobody questions, and the one forbidden question is what is actually outside.

darce-the-giver.blurb: A boy in a community that has abolished pain, choice and colour is assigned to inherit the memories everyone else has been spared.

draci-cesta.blurb: An epic fantasy that runs on banking, grain and debt rather than battle, following an orphan banker, an ageing spymaster and a war nobody can afford.

koseni-scythe.blurb: Death has been cured, so a professional order is licensed to kill by quota, and two teenagers are apprenticed to it.

naslouchej-nozi.blurb: On a colony world where every man's thoughts are audible to everyone, a boy finds a pocket of silence and has to run.

neuromancer.blurb: A burned-out console cowboy is hired for one last job by an employer who turns out to be an artificial intelligence trying to complete itself.

children-of-time.blurb: A terraforming experiment loses its human overseers and succeeds on the spiders instead, and the book follows both species for millennia.

day-of-the-triffids.blurb: A man wakes in hospital to find nearly everyone blinded overnight and the cultivated carnivorous plants no longer contained.

sin-slavy-mistru-sf.blurb: The SFWA Hall of Fame anthology in Czech - the short stories the field's own writers voted canonical.

skyward.blurb: On a planet under permanent aerial siege, a pilot's daughter fights for a place in flight school and finds a derelict ship that talks back.

tri-tvare-sandersona.blurb: A Czech collection of three shorter Sanderson works; the exact contents are not confirmed in the catalogue record.

agent-to-the-stars.blurb: First contact goes to a Hollywood agent, because the aliens smell terrible and need a publicist.

dark-matter.blurb: A physics professor is abducted by a version of himself who took the other path, and has to find his way back through the lives he didn't live.

pillars-of-the-earth.blurb: Twelve generations of ambition, politics and violence around the building of a cathedral in twelfth-century England.

the-blade-itself.blurb: A barbarian, a crippled torturer and a vain nobleman are pulled into a wizard's plan, in a fantasy that keeps undercutting its own heroics.

dungeon-crawler-carl.blurb: Earth's buildings are demolished and the planet becomes a televised dungeon crawl; Carl enters in his underwear with his ex-girlfriend's cat.

murderbot-all-systems-red.blurb: A security android that has hacked its own governor module and would rather watch soap operas is assigned to protect a survey team.

the-will-of-the-many.blurb: A hidden heir enrols in an imperial academy in a republic where citizens cede their will - and thus their strength - upward to their betters.

recursion.blurb: A neuroscientist builds a chair that lets people return to their own memories, and reality starts accumulating contradictory pasts.

we-are-legion.blurb: A software engineer wakes up a century after death as the computer core of a self-replicating interstellar probe, and keeps making copies of himself.

ted-chiang-vydech.blurb: Nine stories, each taking one precisely stated premise - a mechanical universe, a device that records every moment - and following it exactly where it leads.

ted-chiang-pribehy-vaseho-zivota.blurb: Eight stories including the linguistics-of-first-contact novella filmed as Arrival, plus a Babel tower, a golem-making alphabet and a proof of God.

ja-robot-asimov.blurb: Linked stories in which the Three Laws of Robotics are stated once and then broken open, one logical consequence at a time.

martanska-kronika.blurb: Linked stories covering the colonisation of Mars from first landing to the ruins left behind.

rebelka-hirsi-ali.blurb: A Somali woman's account of Islam, forced marriage, escape to the Netherlands, and becoming a parliamentarian under police protection.

prezila-jsem-cinsky-gulag.blurb: A Uyghur woman's account of two years in a Xinjiang re-education camp, written after her release to France.

cekam-az-si-pro-me-prijdou.blurb: A Uyghur poet's account of the surveillance state closing around his family, and the decision to leave.

mnich-v-zajeti-islamistu.blurb: A Syrian monk's account of the months he was held by Islamic State, and of the Muslim neighbours who had been his community.

pan-much.blurb: Schoolboys stranded on an island build a society, and it comes apart in the order Golding argues it must.

jonathan-livingston-racek.blurb: A short allegory about a gull who cares more about flying well than about eating.

fantasticke-povidky-dostojevskij.blurb: Dostoevsky's short fantastic fiction, including the dream of a man who has decided to shoot himself.

vrchol-vulkanu-ellison.blurb: Ellison's own selection of his award-winning stories - short, confrontational, idea-first SF.

tabaterka-z-bagomba-vonnegut.blurb: Vonnegut's early magazine stories, collected: small-town American lives, told straight and quick.

vul-v-chryzantemach-saki.blurb: Edwardian comic short stories built on a cruel wit and a last-line reversal.

hana-mornstajnova.blurb: Czech family novel in three time layers: a girl orphaned by the 1954 typhus epidemic in a small Moravian town is left with an aunt whose own past explains everything.

europeana-ourednik.blurb: A short, deadpan prose collage of twentieth-century Europe, assembling its wars, ideologies and statistics into one continuous voice.

modlitba-horovitzova.blurb: Novella: a group of wealthy Jewish prisoners is persuaded to buy its way out of a camp, in a transaction that was never real.

zert-kundera.blurb: A student's sarcastic postcard destroys his life under Czech Stalinism; decades later he engineers an elaborate revenge that misfires.

spalovac-mrtvol.blurb: A mild, sentimental crematorium employee in occupied Prague is drawn by degrees into serving the Nazi machine.

nadace-foundation.blurb: A mathematician predicts the fall of a galactic empire and founds a colony meant to shorten the dark age that follows; the book follows its first centuries in jumps.

ruze-pro-algernon.blurb: Charlie Gordon, a man with an IQ of 68, keeps a diary through the experimental surgery that makes him a genius, and through what comes after.

mesicni-prach.blurb: A tourist dust-cruiser sinks beneath the Moon's Sea of Thirst with its passengers alive inside, and the rest is a rescue worked out against the clock.

architekti-svetu.blurb: Fifty years after moon-sized Architects reshaped inhabited planets into sculpture, a salvage crew finds evidence they have come back. First of The Final Architecture.

muz-ktery-si-pletl-manzelku.blurb: Twenty-four neurological case histories: patients who lose the ability to recognise faces, to feel where their limbs are, or to remember anything new.

siddhartha.blurb: A brahmin's son leaves home to find enlightenment, tries asceticism, commerce and love in turn, and learns that wisdom cannot be handed over.

lovec-draku.blurb: Kabul in the 1970s: a wealthy boy betrays his servant's son, and spends the next thirty years, through the Soviet and Taliban decades, trying to undo it.

pocitani-hvezd.blurb: A meteorite destroys Washington in 1952 and forces the space programme decades early; a wartime pilot and mathematician fights to fly it. First of Lady Astronaut.

neuprosny-mesic.blurb: Someone is sabotaging the lunar colony, and the First Lady, a pilot travelling under cover, is the only one placed to find out who. Third of Lady Astronaut.

ostre-sledovane-vlaky.blurb: A young trainee dispatcher at a small Czech station in 1945, preoccupied with his own humiliation, ends up carrying out an act of sabotage.

predehra-k-nadaci.blurb: Hari Seldon arrives on Trantor with a mathematical theory nobody believes in, and spends the book on the run while it becomes psychohistory.

slysim-te-vsude.blurb: An outpatient procedure is meant to let couples feel each other's emotions; it goes wrong and one woman starts hearing everyone's thoughts instead.

2001-vesmirna-odysea.blurb: A monolith buried on the Moon points at Saturn, and the ship sent to follow it carries a computer that begins to lie.

ozvena-veci-budoucich.blurb: The Boundary is failing and the Augurs' bargain is coming due, with Davian, Wirr and Asha scattered across a war they only half understand. Second of Licanius.

pohrbeny-obr.blurb: An elderly couple leave their village to find the son they can barely remember, in a Britain where a mist is eating everyone's memory.

skorapka.blurb: A nine-months-unborn narrator, upside down in the womb, overhears his mother and his uncle planning to poison his father.

wolf-hall.blurb: Thomas Cromwell rises from a blacksmith's son to Henry VIII's indispensable servant across the years of the king's first divorce.

pulnocni-knihovna.blurb: A woman at the end of her rope wakes in a library where every book is a life she could have lived, and is allowed to try them.

syn-lowry.blurb: A young mother in the walled community gives birth as a Vessel, loses the child, and spends years searching outside for him. Fourth of The Giver.

nezna-dostojevskij.blurb: A pawnbroker stands over his young wife's body and talks himself through the marriage, minute by minute, trying to explain why she jumped.

blaznovy-zapisky.blurb: Gogol's Petersburg tales: a clerk whose diary slides into madness, a nose that leaves its owner and takes up a career, an overcoat worth a life.

ortel-kafka.blurb: A young merchant writes to a friend abroad about his engagement, shows the letter to his bedridden father, and is sentenced.

cizinec-camus.blurb: Meursault buries his mother without crying, drifts into killing a man on a beach, and is condemned less for the murder than for his indifference.

bozska-komedie.blurb: Guided by Virgil and then Beatrice, the poet descends through the circles of Hell, climbs Purgatory, and ascends the spheres of Paradise.

icehenge.blurb: A monument of ice stands at Pluto's north pole and nobody can prove who built it; three narrators, centuries apart, argue over the evidence.

jonathan-strange-norrell.blurb: English magic returns during the Napoleonic wars through two very different magicians, and the fairy one of them summons will not be dismissed.

neviditelny-zivot-addie-larue.blurb: A woman trades her soul in 1714 for a life without end, on the condition that nobody she meets can remember her, until three hundred years later someone does.

dvanact-povidek-o-poutnicich.blurb: Twelve stories about Latin Americans adrift in Europe: an exiled president selling his possessions, a woman locked in an asylum by mistake.

jana-eyrova.blurb: An orphaned governess takes a post at Thornfield Hall, falls in love with its master, and discovers what he keeps upstairs.

starec-ktery-cetl-milostne-romany.blurb: An old man in an Amazon river town reads romance novels for pleasure, and is the only person who understands the ocelot the hunters have provoked.

dynastie-pampelisek.blurb: Two friends, a bandit's son and a fallen duke, bring down an empire together and then find themselves on opposite sides. First of The Dandelion Dynasty.

pate-rocni-obdobi.blurb: On a continent where the earth kills regularly, the people who can still it are enslaved for it; three women's stories run in parallel. First of The Broken Earth.

general-ve-svem-labyrintu.blurb: Simon Bolivar's last journey down the Magdalena river, dying and abandoned by the republics he made.

pohreb-velke-matky.blurb: Eight stories from Macondo and its neighbours, ending with the state funeral of a matriarch who owned everything, including the weather.

rijnova-zeme.blurb: Nineteen macabre stories: a jar at a carnival, a skeleton the narrator wants removed, and the Elliotts, a family of amiable monsters.

hvezdy-jako-prach.blurb: A student on a tyrant-ruled world flees an assassination attempt and joins a search for the document that could break the Tyranni.

sila-psa.blurb: Two brothers run a Montana ranch; when the younger marries a widow, the elder sets about destroying her and her son, and why he is cruel is the point.

ministerstvo-pro-budoucnost.blurb: After a heatwave kills twenty million people in India, a UN body is created to represent everyone not yet born, and told to fix the climate.

totoznost-kundera.blurb: A woman starts receiving anonymous admiring letters; her lover, who is writing them, watches the fiction take her over.

milosrdenstvi.blurb: Colonial Virginia in the 1680s, before race had hardened: a farmer takes a slave child in payment, and four women on his land tell what follows.

pampeliskove-vino.blurb: One summer in a small Illinois town in 1928, in the vignettes of a twelve-year-old boy: a ravine, a Tarot witch, a machine for happiness.

plujici-ostrov.blurb: A string quartet is kidnapped onto Standard Island, a self-propelled artificial island owned by millionaires, and watches it split in two.

pomalost-kundera.blurb: A libertine night at a French chateau in the eighteenth century and a conference at the same chateau today, interleaved as an essay on hurry.

okamziky-cechov.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)
okamziky-cechov.blurb: A selection of Chekhov's short stories: provincial doctors, clerks and landowners caught at the moment a life quietly settles.

dublinane.blurb: Fifteen stories of Dublin lives at the point where they stop moving: a boy, a clerk, a spinster, and a party where a husband learns something.

prilis-mnoho-stesti.blurb: Ten stories of Ontario lives, ending with the Russian mathematician Sophia Kovalevsky's last journey.

pritelkyne-z-mladi.blurb: Ten stories about women looking back at the moment their lives turned, told in Munro's doubling-back way.

nepritel-pritel-ctitel.blurb: Nine stories, including a housekeeper tricked by a forged love letter into travelling to a man who never wrote it.

schizofrenicke-evangelium.blurb: Early experimental Hrabal: collage, overheard talk and lyrical digression rather than narrative.

pabitele.blurb: Hrabal's palaverers, the tram conductors, scrap-yard workers and pub philosophers who talk their way through a story.

zvirata-hrdinove.blurb: Animal life stories by the founder of the genre, a mustang, a hound and a lynx, written as biographies rather than fables.

niziny-muller.blurb: Prose fragments of a German-speaking childhood in Ceausescu's Banat, where the village and the state are equally close.

city-and-its-uncertain-walls.blurb: A man searches for the girl he loved as a teenager, in a walled city where shadows are removed at the gate and he reads old dreams.

inheritance-paolini.blurb: Eragon and Saphira face Galbatorix at last, with the Varden marching on the capital. Fourth of the Inheritance Cycle.

erendira-marquez.blurb: After accidentally burning down her grandmother's house, fourteen-year-old Erendira is sold into years of forced prostitution across a string of desert towns to pay off the debt, until a young smuggler named Ulises falls for her and tries to free her.

hodiny-mcewan.blurb: Deserted by his wife with an infant son in 1986, Roland Baines revisits his life from a 1950s childhood in Libya and an English boarding school - where, at eleven, a piano teacher begins a relationship with him that continues into his teens - through the Cold War, the fall of the Berlin Wall and the Covid pandemic.

muzi-kteri-nemaji-zeny.blurb: Seven linked short stories about men separated from women in their lives - by death, infidelity, or simple unknowability - including a widowed actor who hires a female chauffeur to talk through his late wife's affairs, a housebound man visited by a woman who tells him stories after sex, and a reverse retelling of Kafka's Metamorphosis in which a creature wakes up human and is named Gregor Samsa.

prvni-osoba-jednotneho-cisla.blurb: Eight loosely autobiographical first-person stories - some straight nostalgia (a Beatles-era teenage romance, a piano-recital invitation gone strange), some outright fabulist (a talking monkey who confesses to stealing women's names) - narrated by men looking back and not always sure what the memory adds up to.

oci-modreho-psa.blurb: A 1974 collection of eleven early short stories (written 1947-1955, before the author's Nobel-era style) built around death-in-life states, dreams and inherited curses -- including the title story, in which a man and a woman meet only in each other's dreams and can never recognize each other awake.

spanek-murakami.blurb: A married woman stops sleeping for seventeen straight nights with no physical decline, and spends her new waking hours re-reading Anna Karenina, eating chocolate and drinking brandy, and reconsidering the routine of her marriage from an unfamiliar angle. The story ends with her alone at night in her car as two unidentified men rock it back and forth, unresolved.

svab-mcewan.blurb: A cockroach hive-mind wakes to find itself running the British government; the new Prime Minister, Jim Sams, pushes 'Reversalism' - an inverted economy in which employees pay to work and shops pay customers to shop - as a satire of Brexit-era politics, splitting the country into Reversalists and Clockwisers.

inkvizitor.blurb: Sent back to England after the fall of Hookton, Thomas of Hookton pursues his dead father's hints of a hidden Holy Grail, survives the Scottish invasion of 1347, and is drawn into a Dominican inquisitor's hunt for the Vexille family's heresy.

sharpuv-regiment.blurb: The South Essex Regiment in Spain is starved of replacements and facing disbandment; Sharpe returns to England to find out why, and traces the failure to a fraudulent recruiting ring protected by powerful men in London.

2061-treti-vesmirna-odysea.blurb: In 2061 Heywood Floyd, now over a hundred, travels aboard a liner to land on Halley's Comet, while a second ship is forced down on Europa, where humans have been warned not to go.

3001-posledni-vesmirna-odysea.blurb: Frank Poole, thrown into space by his ship's computer a thousand years earlier, is recovered and revived in the year 3001, and takes a part in humanity's dealings with the monoliths.

a-zrodi-se-nadace.blurb: Hari Seldon works across four decades to establish psychohistory and protect it from a decaying Galactic Empire, through political intrigue, personal loss, and the discovery that his granddaughter can read minds.

alcatraz-versus-dabelsti-knihovnici.blurb: On his thirteenth birthday Alcatraz Smedry inherits a bag of sand, accidentally burns his foster parents' kitchen, and learns from a grandfather he has never met that a secret order of Librarians is hiding the truth about the world. They go to steal the sand back.

alcatraz-versus-legie-zakladatelovych-ko.blurb: Alcatraz travels to Nalhalla, the country his family comes from, and instead ends up in the Library of Alexandria hunting for his missing father, pursued by a Librarian assassin built partly of metal.

ani-sami-bohove.blurb: A physicist works out that the Electron Pump, which supplies Earth with limitless energy by exchanging matter with a parallel universe, will eventually make the Sun explode, and nobody will listen. The middle section follows three beings of the other universe, one of whom reaches the same conclusion from her side.

anna-na-krku-a-jine-povidky.blurb: A Czech selection of Anton Chekhov's short stories spanning his whole career, from the brief early humoresques to the mature serious work. The title story follows Anya, married off to an elderly official, as she turns her new social standing to her own use.

automat-svet.blurb: A selection of Bohumil Hrabal's short stories set among railwaymen, pub regulars and outsiders on the Prague periphery, with an afterword by Emanuel Frynta. The title story begins with the discovery of a hanged girl in the Liben arcade housing the automat Svet.

betonova-zahrada.blurb: Four siblings are left alone in a suburban house after both parents die. To avoid being separated by the authorities they hide their mother's body in cement in the cellar and keep house themselves.

blokada.blurb: Mars is in alien hands and the outer solar system is blockaded. Andrew Grayson ships out on a warship attempting to break through to a cut-off colony, alongside the rival human alliance that was recently the enemy.

bojove-rozkazy.blurb: Four years after the aliens were pushed back, the peace is holding but the threat is not gone. Major Andrew Grayson and his special tactics team ship out on the warship Washington for a reconnaissance run deep into enemy-held space.

brany-athen.blurb: Athens, 490 BC. The general Xanthippos, the ambitious Themistokles and the incorruptible Aristides meet the first Persian invasion at Marathon, then spend a decade quarrelling over the city while Xerxes prepares a second.

cary.blurb: In present-day night-time Tokyo a chain of strangers - among them prostitutes, clients and drifters - meet by chance, each chapter passing the story to another of them.

cas-malin-prezralych.blurb: Autobiographical humorous pieces in which the author recounts trips around the Czech lands, France and Britain, and episodes from her own life. Illustrated by Tereza Budilova; 222 pages.

cytonik.blurb: Spensa flees into the nowhere, a place where time behaves differently, people lose their memories and pirate factions fight for control, following an old path in search of what the delvers are and how they can be beaten.

demanty-noci.blurb: Nine stories of Jewish children and young people - in hiding, in the ghetto, in the camps and on a death transport - by a writer who survived the places he describes.

den-kdy-padla-noc.blurb: A sister of a warrior priory whose enemy has not appeared for five hundred years, a young princess of Inys expected to continue her mother's line, and a godsinger in the East are drawn together when dragons wake in the mountains.

deti-zmaru.blurb: Long after the collapse of human empire, a terraforming crew reaches two habitable worlds and one scientist begins uplifting octopuses, while centuries later a joint human and spider expedition arrives chasing a radio signal from the same system.

dezerce.blurb: With Mars still held by the aliens, Andrew Grayson is posted as an instructor while both human alliances rebuild their fleets. A reconnaissance mission then takes him far from the front line and outside his orders.

dole-v-udoli.blurb: Luigi, a forest ranger in the Valsesia expecting a first child with Elisabetta, receives his brother Alfredo back from Canada to settle their dead father's house between them, while a series of dog shootings along the river goes on nearby.

draci-plamen.blurb: On a cold evening in early 1957, Sarah Dewhurst and her father wait at a petrol station for the dragon they have hired to work their failing farm. Elsewhere a young assassin raised by a cult of dragon worshippers is sent to kill the saviour named in a prophecy.

druha-nadace.blurb: After the Mule's conquest, first he and then the First Foundation itself hunt for the hidden Second Foundation of mind-readers, in two linked narratives sixty years apart - the second led by Arkady Darell, a fourteen-year-old who leaves home to find it.

dubliners.blurb: Fifteen short stories about the ordinary lives of Dublin's inhabitants, from childhood episodes through portraits of adults in middle age, closing with a Christmas party and its aftermath.

elantris.blurb: On the eve of his wedding the crown prince of Arelon is struck by the curse that turned the shining city of Elantris into a prison of the living dead, and is thrown inside. His unmet bride arrives in the capital as a widow, while a foreign high priest is given three months to convert the kingdom or see it destroyed.

evakuace.blurb: With Mars lost and alien seed ships patrolling the edge of the solar system, the ice colony of New Svalbard is close to starvation. Andrew Grayson, now a combat controller, is caught between the two human alliances and an enemy neither can beat alone.

gallant.blurb: Olivia Prior, a mute orphan raised at a school for girls, is summoned by letter to her family's estate, Gallant, and finds her uncle already dead and her cousin unwilling to have her there. Beyond a ruined wall on the grounds stands another version of the house, ruled by a figure who wants her.

gentleman-v-moskve.blurb: In June 1922 a Bolshevik tribunal sentences Count Alexander Ilyich Rostov to lifelong house arrest in Moscow's Hotel Metropol. He moves from his suite to a small attic room and lives there through three decades of Soviet history.

hannibal.blurb: Syracuse, 213 BC. A Roman army besieges the city; the Carthaginian Hanno serves inside the walls, his former friend Quintus in the legions outside, and Quintus's sister is held captive within.

hledani-modre.blurb: In a village that abandons the weak, the orphaned and lame Kira is spared because she can embroider. The Council of Guardians sets her to repairing the robe on which the village's whole history is recorded.

hluboke-pastviny.blurb: In a future where the oceans are farmed, Walter Franklin, a former spaceman who can no longer face space, retrains as a warden herding whales, and later administers the fisheries when their morality is challenged.

hnev.blurb: King Nathair holds the fortress of Drassil and three of the Seven Treasures, and with all seven he can open a gate to the Otherworld for Asroth and his demons. Corban has been taken captive by the Jotun, giant warriors who ride to battle on bears, and his own army is scattered.

inzerat-na-dum-ve-kterem-uz-nechci-bydle.blurb: Seven stories first collected in 1965. Four are set in the Kladno steelworks of the 1950s and three in Prague, following labourers and men conscripted to manual work - former tradesmen, lawyers and intellectuals - through an era Hrabal called the period of the cult of personality.

jak-byt-zenou.blurb: A first-person account of the author's life from adolescence through work, marriage, childbirth and an abortion, each chapter turning a personal episode into an argument about what is expected of women.

jak-stvorit-divku.blurb: In 1990 Wolverhampton, fourteen-year-old Johanna Morrigan reinvents herself as Dolly Wilde and talks her way into work as a music journalist in London.

jasno-lepo-podstin-zhyna.blurb: In a small Irish seaside town a solitary fifty-seven-year-old man adopts a damaged one-eyed dog from a shelter and addresses the whole narrative to it across a year, until trouble forces the two of them onto the road.

jiskra-v-popelu.blurb: A Scholar girl whose brother is arrested for treason goes undercover as a slave in the household of a military academy's commandant, while one of the academy's top graduates, who intends to desert, is forced into a lethal contest to choose the next emperor.

kaleidoskop.blurb: Seventy short stories drawn from Bradbury's collections of 1950 to 1964, arranged in eight thematic sections ranging from horror and fantasy to future worlds, Mexico, Ireland and small-town America.

klara-a-slunce.blurb: Klara is a solar-powered Artificial Friend who watches the street from a store window until she is bought as a companion for a seriously ill teenage girl.

klec-dusi.blurb: Stefan Advani writes an account of his life from a prison island in the swamps outside Shadrapar, the last city of a humanity living under a dying, hostile sun.

kluby-poezie.blurb: A 1981 volume in which Bohumil Hrabal interleaved excerpts from two of his Liben prose works into a single alternating text, presented as a peripheral ballad in honour of the graphic artist Vladimir Boudnik.

kocka-a-cert.blurb: The town of Beaugency is split in two by the Loire and needs a bridge its citizens cannot build. The mayor strikes a bargain with the Devil, who will build it overnight in exchange for the soul of the first creature to cross.

kralovska-krev.blurb: Geder Palliako, a minor Antean nobleman, rises to Protector of the Prince, while the young banker Cithrin bel Sarcour and the mercenary Marcus Wester begin to grasp what the priests backing him are. War follows.

krvavy-kamen.blurb: Twenty years after the Jerusalem Man disappeared, the Deacon rules from Unity and his Jerusalem Riders burn churches and hunt mutants. A wounded rider with no memory begins killing the killers, and word spreads that Shannow has returned.

lev.blurb: Athens after the Persian wars. The young Perikles serves under Kimon through the Delian League's campaigns from Eion to the Eurymedon, and comes of age between the battlefield and the city's assembly and theatre.

lincolnova-dalnice.blurb: June 1954: Emmett Watson, eighteen, is driven home to Nebraska after fifteen months in a juvenile work farm, planning to collect his eight-year-old brother and start again in California. Two friends who hid in the warden's trunk have a different destination in mind.

mapa-a-uzemi.blurb: Jed Martin becomes famous twice over, first for photographing Michelin maps and then as a painter of people at their work, while his relations with his dying architect father and with the writer he commissions for a catalogue essay run their course.

mesto-duchu.blurb: Cassidy Blake can cross the Veil that separates the living from the dead, and her best friend is a ghost. When her parents take their paranormal television show to Edinburgh, she meets another girl with the same ability and learns what she is supposed to do with it.

moc.blurb: The continent of the Banished Lands drifts toward war as an old prophecy of two opposed figures begins to be read. Corban, a blacksmith's son in the kingdom of Ardan, trains for his manhood trial while kings, queens and immortals manoeuvre around him.

morantologie.blurb: A collection of the author's newspaper columns and interviews on television, politics, music, celebrity, the welfare state and family life.

most-dusi.blurb: Days after leaving Paris, Cassidy Blake travels to New Orleans with her ghost-hunting parents while a bone-masked emissary of death follows her. She and a fellow in-betweener look for a secret society that may know how to stop it.

my-ostatni-tu-proste-zijem.blurb: Mikey Mitchell is a high-school senior in a small Washington town where the Chosen Ones keep dying heroically. He mostly wants to graduate, keep his friends and tell Henna how he feels, while each chapter opens with a paragraph of the supernatural war going on elsewhere.

myslete-na-deti.blurb: Fiona Maye, a High Court judge in the Family Division, must rule on whether a seventeen-year-old Jehovah's Witness dying of leukaemia can be given the blood transfusion he and his parents refuse, while her own marriage breaks open.

na-hranicich-nadace.blurb: A Foundation councilman is exiled for arguing that the Second Foundation still exists and sent to look for it, while a rising Second Foundation speaker concludes that a third, stronger power is manipulating the Seldon Plan; both converge on an uncharted world.

nadace-a-zeme.blurb: Golan Trevize, uneasy about the choice he has made for humanity's future, sets out with the historian Janov Pelorat to find Earth, whose records have been erased from every archive, travelling through a series of long-abandoned worlds.

najdi-odpoved.blurb: Arriving at the city they hoped would save them, Todd and Viola find the Mayor already in charge and are separated. Todd is put to work for the new regime while Viola falls in with the resistance, and each has to decide what they will do to survive and find the other.

nemame-na-vybranou.blurb: During a single day's truce in the Israeli-Arab fighting of 1948, ground crew at a Jerusalem airfield prepare a party for the pilots and nurses. Days earlier two pilots failed to return from a reconnaissance flight, and Johny Cohen is quietly planning what to do about it.

nesmrtelnost.blurb: A narrator watching a woman wave at her swimming instructor invents Agnes and follows her marriage, her sister and her death, interleaved with an account of Goethe's relations with Bettina von Arnim and with the narrator's own commentary on the book he is writing.

nikdy-nevystoupat-na-vrchol.blurb: Cognetti walks a circuit through the Nepalese Himalaya, recording the landscape, the people he meets and his companions, alongside reflections on solitude and friendship.

nokturna.blurb: Five loosely linked stories about musicians and music lovers, set in Venice, London, the English countryside and Beverly Hills.

oblazek-na-obloze.blurb: Joseph Schwartz, a retired tailor from twentieth-century Chicago, is thrown thousands of years into the future onto a radioactive, impoverished Earth that is a despised province of a galactic empire, and becomes the subject of a scientist's experiment while an archaeologist from off-world investigates Earth's claim to be humanity's origin.

odvaha.blurb: The war for the Banished Lands widens as High King Nathair hunts the Seven Treasures and Queen Rhin takes the west. Corban flees his homeland with a small band while the demons of the Otherworld are loosed on the world of flesh.

ohniva-pole.blurb: A year after Mars falls, the rebuilt human fleets launch an assault to take the planet back. Andrew Grayson and Diana Halley go in with the invasion force.

olga.blurb: The life of a German woman born at the end of the nineteenth century: a village childhood, a long attachment to a man who leaves for the Arctic before the First World War, two wars, and her death in the early 1970s. The final part consists of her letters to him.

orlove-v-bouri.blurb: Germanicus drives deeper into Germania to recover the last of the eagles lost at Teutoburg, while a Roman centurion pursues a personal reckoning with Arminius and a storm at sea wrecks part of the fleet.

ostri-snu.blurb: Garreth Left, heir to a declining Kithamar merchant house and promised to a strategic marriage, meets a woman by chance, abandons the path set for him and joins the city guard.

ozveny-velke-pisne.blurb: The Avatars, a near-immortal caste sustained by failing crystals, rule the remnants of a drowned world. When two moons appear and the Crystal Queen's armies land, the Avatars make common cause with their own subjects.

pavouci-valka.blurb: The war against the goddess's priests reaches its end: a tired mercenary captain, a banker willing to break the rules of profit, and the last living dragon converge on an empire that has never lost a battle.

perlicka-na-dne.blurb: Bohumil Hrabal's first published book of short stories (1963), portraits of ordinary men from the lower reaches of society - railwaymen, foundry workers, pub regulars - who turn out to be compulsive and brilliant tellers of their own lives.

pisek.blurb: Generations after civilisation was buried under sand, four siblings in a dune-top town search for their father, one of the divers who descend hundreds of feet into the desert for salvage, and for a lost city said to lie a mile down.

platforma.blurb: Michel, a bored official at the French Ministry of Culture, comes into an inheritance and travels to Thailand, where he meets a travel executive named Valerie; together they design a chain of holiday resorts built around paid sex.

posel-v-temnem-lese.blurb: Matty, a boy taken in years earlier by a village that shelters outcasts, carries messages through the forest. As the village turns against strangers and its people begin trading away parts of themselves, he learns what his own gift is for.

posledni-hlidka.blurb: Major Andrew Grayson and the crew of the Washington are stranded nine hundred light years from home in a sunless system, running out of water, fuel and food. The only moon showing signs of life offers food - and is infested with the enemy.

posledni-strazce.blurb: Two years after the Hellborn war, Jon Shannow is found near death in the mountains and drawn into a second conflict, with part of the story set in an ancient civilisation before its fall.

pozdni-zivot.blurb: Martin, a seventy-six-year-old emeritus professor of legal history with a much younger wife and a six-year-old son, is diagnosed with terminal cancer and sets about leaving the boy a letter.

prach.blurb: The isolated silos converge: a mayor drives a digging machine toward a neighbouring silo while taking air samples outside, and in the silo that controls them all a man and his sister try to stop the shutdown of the rest.

pravi-bastardi.blurb: Fetching, once the only woman riding with the half-orc hoofs, is now chief of the Bastards. Her fortress is failing, a famine and a pack of devil-dogs are killing her people, and a human captain manoeuvres to seize the Lot Lands for his crown.

pravidla-hry.blurb: Ash Bowman, a high-school football lineman, is shifted into a parallel version of his own life by a hard tackle, and each subsequent hit sends him into a further altered reality, guided by multidimensional beings he calls the Edwards.

predcitac.blurb: In post-war Germany a fifteen-year-old boy begins an affair with a woman twice his age who asks him to read aloud to her; years later, as a law student, he sees her again in the dock at a war-crimes trial.

pres-pisek.blurb: In a world buried under sand, an atomic bomb destroys a mining town and a girl who survives follows her father across No Man's Land for revenge, while far to the west a family of sand divers is pulled apart by the reputation of a missing sister.

prevorstvi-u-pomerancovniku.blurb: Queen Sabran of Inys must conceive an heir to keep her realm safe while an undercover mage from a southern order guards her against assassins, and in the East a young woman trains to become a dragonrider as an ancient draconic enemy stirs.

probud-monstrum.blurb: Three armies converge on New Prentisstown as full war breaks out between the Mayor's forces, the resistance, and the planet's native Spackle. Todd, Viola and a Spackle survivor called the Return narrate in turn.

protiuder.blurb: Human forces finally have ships and weapons that can kill the aliens on even terms. Andrew Grayson and Diana Halley take on command duties as a new phase of the war opens.

pul-sveta.blurb: In a Viking-flavoured world around a shattered sea, two young Gettlanders - Thorn, who wants to be a warrior, and Brand, who cannot bring himself to kill - are pressed into the crew of a minister's long voyage south to find allies against the High King.

pul-valky.blurb: A night attack leaves Princess Skara the only royal survivor of Throvenland, and she must hold an alliance of former enemies together against the High King. Narrated by Skara, a Vansterland king's sword-bearer and a minister's apprentice.

ruda-zeme.blurb: Shy South comes home to a burned farm and two kidnapped siblings and sets out across a lawless frontier with her stepfather Lamb to get them back, crossing paths with a mercenary company and its runaway lawyer.

s-navigaci-osudu.blurb: Autobiographical humorous pieces in which the author recounts journeys through eastern Bohemia, the Iron Mountains and Corsica, alongside remarks on events around her. Illustrated by Tereza Budilova; 221 pages.

sedi-bastardi.blurb: Jackal is a half-orc rider in the Grey Bastards, one of eight brotherhoods that patrol the Lot Lands against orc raids. After a young cavalryman is killed in a brawl at a brothel he sets out to find who arranged it, fails to unseat his chief, and is forced out of his hoof.

slavnosti-snezenek.blurb: Sixteen short stories and sketches about the inhabitants of the Kersko cottage settlement outside Prague - hunters, publicans, gardeners and their animals. The title story turns on a dispute between two hunting associations over a shot wild boar.

smlouva-na-zivot.blurb: In 2108 Andrew Grayson enlists in the North American Commonwealth military to escape a welfare tenement and its ration of two thousand soy calories a day. Training leads to a riot-control deployment against civilians in Detroit, and then off Earth, where humanity meets something far larger than itself.

smrt-pred-branami.blurb: As a new emperor's rule collapses into madness, his enforcer hunts the Scholar resistance, a Scholar girl races an immortal for the last piece of an artefact, and the keeper of the dead struggles alone to hold the ghosts inside their forest.

spisy-2.blurb: A critical edition volume gathering Bohumil Hrabal's short stories of the 1960s, edited by Vaclav Kadlec, Jiri Pelan and Claudio Poeta, with editorial commentary. The stories are set in the milieus Hrabal worked in himself: the railways, the Kladno steelworks, a scrap-paper depot and a Prague theatre.

spocitej-hvezdy.blurb: Copenhagen, 1943. Ten-year-old Annemarie's best friend Ellen is Jewish, and when the Germans begin rounding up Denmark's Jews, Annemarie's family hides Ellen and helps move her family across to Sweden.

stret-imperii.blurb: 198 BC. In the closing phase of the Second Macedonian War, Roman legions and the phalanx of Philip V of Macedon manoeuvre and fight toward a decisive engagement, seen from the ranks of both armies.

stul-pro-dva.blurb: A novella following Eve in 1938 Hollywood, plus six short stories set mostly in present-day New York: a beginning writer forging famous authors' signatures, a young woman shadowing her stepfather, a former peasant in post-revolutionary Russia who discovers a talent for standing in queues. Each story turns on a moment when two characters end up facing each other across a table.

stvanice-na-orly.blurb: Five years after three legions were destroyed in the German forests, a surviving centurion and his men join Germanicus's campaign across the Rhine to recover the lost legionary eagles, while Arminius struggles to hold his tribal alliance together.

sucho.blurb: California's water supply is shut off without warning, and four teenagers from one suburban street - joined by strangers they would never otherwise have met - travel in search of water and of two missing parents as public order collapses.

svetlo-veci-konecnych.blurb: With the Boundary sealed but monsters loose in Andarra, Wirr struggles to hold a fracturing alliance together in the capital while Davian, imprisoned in a foreign land, faces the surviving Venerate as they try to undo the sacrifice that closed the Boundary.

svobodni-bastardi.blurb: War reaches the Lot Lands and Oats, the plainest of the three friends who lead the half-orc Bastards, fights on the front line. Freeing half-breed captives from a human fortress costs him a wound, and in the battle that follows a sorceress runs him through with a spear.

tanecni-hodiny-pro-starsi-a-pokrocile.blurb: A novella from 1964 written as one continuous sentence: an unnamed old cobbler, based on Hrabal's uncle Pepin, talks without pause to a young woman named Kamila, drifting by association through anecdotes of his working life, the Austro-Hungarian army, his lovers, and Czech history.

tunel-kosti.blurb: Cassidy Blake's family takes their paranormal television show to Paris, where she wakes a poltergeist in the catacombs. Because it has forgotten who it was, she cannot send it on until she finds out.

turnus.blurb: In 2049 a newly elected congressman is asked to design a vast underground facility for spent nuclear fuel; centuries later, the men who built it are woken from cryogenic sleep in six-month shifts to administer the fifty silos and the people inside them.

tyranuv-zakon.blurb: Geder Palliako, now Lord Regent of Antea, turns each victory into the next war, while Cithrin bel Sarcour works her bank against him and Marcus Wester hunts for a weapon against the goddess's priests.

ulice-ztracenych-bratri.blurb: A collection of stories about Jewish boys in their early teens who pass through the wartime transports and camps, and who take in what is happening to them differently from the adults around them.

valka-ruzi.blurb: Winter 1461. Richard of York is dead, his son Edward claims the English throne and marches toward Towton, while Margaret of Anjou drives south with a northern army to free her imprisoned husband.

vdovin-dum.blurb: Lord Regent Geder Palliako pushes his war on with the goddess's priests behind him, set on regaining or destroying the one woman who refused him, while a widowed noblewoman works against him from inside Antea.

vek-popela.blurb: Alys, a small-time thief in the poorest district of the ancient city of Kithamar, sets out to learn who killed her brother and why; her friend Sammish is drawn after her into a conspiracy around the city's rulers.

velmoc.blurb: Athens, mid-fifth century BC. An earthquake levels Sparta, and Perikles seizes the moment to wall and strengthen Athens while a ruthless new Spartan leader rises to answer him.

vlci-stesti.blurb: Fausto, forty and newly single, leaves Milan for the alpine village of Fontana Fredda, takes a job as cook in Babette's restaurant, and grows close to a young waitress, Silvia, who wants to work in a glacier refuge.

vlk-ve-stinu.blurb: Three hundred years after the world was thrown off its axis, the gunman Jon Shannow wanders the ruins looking for the Jerusalem promised in his Bible. He settles briefly with a widow and her son before the Hellborn, an army serving Abaddon, take her.

vojevudce.blurb: 480 BC. After Thermopylae the Greek fleet falls back on Salamis, and Themistokles, Aristides and Xanthippos must hold an alliance of free cities together through Salamis, Plataia and Mykale.

vyhled-na-hvezdy.blurb: Spensa leaves the human remnant on Detritus disguised as an alien defector and enters the Superiority's own flight school light-years from home, intending to steal a hyperdrive before her cover fails.

vyslapana-cara.blurb: Frankie, twenty-five and recently out of art school, moves into her late grandmother's empty bungalow in the Irish countryside after a breakdown, and organises her days around photographing dead animals and recalling works of art.

vzdycky-budeme-mit-pariz.blurb: A late collection of twenty-one previously unpublished short stories and one poem, ranging from 1950s-style science fiction to nostalgic small-town vignettes and a Paris encounter.

zac-je-zivota-loket.blurb: A collection of autobiographical humorous pieces in which the author looks back on her youth, her search for a partner, her marriages and her children's partners, and on trips taken with her mother.

zivot-je-jinde.blurb: Jaromil, a Czech boy pushed towards poetry by his widowed mother, grows into a lyric poet and enthusiast of the 1948 communist revolution, and his devotion to both leads him to denounce the family of the girl he loves.

zkaza.blurb: Queen Rhin holds the west and High King Nathair holds the cauldron, the most powerful of the Seven Treasures, which his demon counsellor needs to bring Asroth's host into the world. Corban is swept into the war while Queen Edana finds allies in the marshes and Maquin runs from pirates.

znicit.blurb: In 2027 France, cyber and terrorist attacks strike symbols of Western life while Paul Raison, an adviser to the finance minister, is drawn back to his estranged family by his father's stroke and then by his own cancer diagnosis.

zodpovedne-lehkomyslna.blurb: Autobiographical humorous pieces in which the author recounts episodes and observations from her life during the coronavirus pandemic. Illustrated by Tereza Budilova; 211 pages.

plamen-v-temnote.blurb: A deserter and a Scholar girl travel north across the Empire to break her brother out of its most secure prison, hunted by soldiers, while in the capital a newly appointed enforcer is bound to the will of a violent new Emperor.

brana-z-obelisku.blurb: The dying Alabaster tries to teach Essun to link the floating obelisks together and catch the returning moon, while her daughter Nassun, taken far away by her father, learns the same power faster and from other teachers.

den.blurb: A Brooklyn family - a married couple, their two children and the wife's brother - is followed on the fifth of April in 2019, 2020 and 2021 as the household comes apart and rearranges itself.

kapka-aja.blurb: A water droplet named Aja attends a school for droplets, learns to turn into vapour, ice and snow, and is then swept through the water cycle and the waterworks before returning home.

letorosty-samomluv.blurb: A set of short recollections, essays and reflections, one for each year of the author's life from 1928 to 2022, each followed by a brief note on his state at that time.

mechanicky-pomeranc.blurb: Alex, a fifteen-year-old gang leader in a near-future Britain, narrates his nights of assault and robbery in an invented teenage slang, then is imprisoned and subjected to an aversion treatment that makes violence physically impossible for him.

milostne-rosady.blurb: Four stories about sexual deceit: a seducer trapped in a Syrian household, two husbands who secretly swap beds for a night, a widow's revenge on a gynaecologist, and a scheme built around a manufactured scent.

modra-planeta.blurb: Twelve short illustrated stories about the daily lives of children on different continents, all happening at the same moment, each with factual notes for adults reading along.

muz-v-cervenem-kabate.blurb: A non-fiction portrait of Samuel Pozzi, a Belle Epoque Paris society doctor and pioneering gynaecologist, built outward from a Sargent painting into the artists, writers and scandals around him.

na-vode.blurb: In 1961 a community of houseboat dwellers is moored at Battersea Reach on the Thames; Nenna, living aboard with her two young daughters, waits on a husband who will not join her there.

noc-nic-nezadrzi.blurb: After her mother's suicide, the author gathers letters, recordings and family interviews to reconstruct the woman's childhood, her rise into a large Parisian family's mythology, and the decades of bipolar illness that followed.

obraz-doriana-graye.blurb: A young man's portrait ages and coarsens in his place while he spends decades pursuing sensation without visible cost, until he decides to destroy the picture.

otec-vanoce-a-ja.blurb: Amelia Wishart, a human girl adopted by Father Christmas and his wife Mary, struggles to fit in at elf school in Elfhelm. When a resentful elf allies with the Easter Bunny and his rabbit army to overthrow Father Christmas, it falls to Amelia and the elves to stop them.

pikova-dama-a-jine-povidky.blurb: A young officer becomes obsessed with a secret of three winning cards said to be held by an aged countess; the volume collects this novella with Pushkin's other short prose.
pikova-dama-a-jine-povidky.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

povidky-malostranske.blurb: A cycle of stories about the feuds, gossip, poverty and small vanities of the inhabitants of Prague's Mala Strana in the middle of the nineteenth century.

predvedte-mrtve.blurb: Thomas Cromwell, now the king's chief minister, assembles the case that destroys Anne Boleyn and the men accused with her, over five months of 1536.

pribehy-z-konce-predmesti.blurb: Fifteen short illustrated tales set in suburban streets, among them a water buffalo that points the way, a tiny foreign exchange student, and a nameless holiday nobody can explain.

pusobnost.blurb: Verity Jane beta-tests a digital assistant that proves far more capable than her employers admit, while in a distant future a fixer is set to steering her timeline away from nuclear war.

silene-smutne-povidky.blurb: Thirteen short stories, mostly minimalist, about people bearing loss, loneliness and misfortune, with recurring notes of irony and paradox.

skleneny-pokoj.blurb: A wealthy Czech industrialist and his wife build a glass-and-steel modernist house above a Czech city in the late 1920s; the novel follows the family until they flee the German occupation, then the house through the hands of its later occupants.

takovy-pekny-par-a-jine-povidky.blurb: Twenty-four of Fitzgerald's magazine stories - among them Bernice Bobs Her Hair, The Ice Palace, The Last of the Belles and the title story - arranged chronologically from adolescence and first love through marriage.

tisice-planoucich-slunci.blurb: Marjam is married off at fifteen to a man in Kabul thirty years her senior. Two decades later she and a younger neighbour, Lajla, are bound into something like a mother and daughter as Taliban rule turns their lives into a struggle with hunger, cruelty and fear.

usmev-lorda-ickenhama.blurb: Lord Emsworth's country house is overrun by his domineering sister, an intimidating secretary, a disagreeable duke and a camping brigade of church lads, and Lord Ickenham arrives to sort out a thwarted romance and a plot against the prize pig.

valka-svetu.blurb: Cylinders fired from Mars land in the English countryside and the machines inside them destroy everything in their path. An unnamed writer records the invasion, the flight from London and the collapse of ordinary life.

vynalezci-zazraku-sebrane-povidky-h-g-we.blurb: Thirty-three short stories H. G. Wells published in periodicals between 1888 and 1896, bringing together The Stolen Bacillus and Other Incidents and The Plattner Story and Others, from scientific romances to uncanny and comic incidents.

zastup-vzpominek.blurb: A collection of Expanse short fiction: the invention of the Epstein drive, a young Amos Burton in a criminal underworld in Baltimore, the events that made Fred Johnson notorious, and further pieces set before, between and after the novels.

zrcadlo-a-svetlo.blurb: Thomas Cromwell at the height of his power after Anne Boleyn's execution, negotiating Henry VIII's next marriages and the Tudor succession, until his own arrest and fall.

nekonecny-pribeh.blurb: A bullied boy steals a book in an antiquarian shop, reads about the failing world of Fantastica and is pulled inside it, where every wish he makes costs him a memory of his own life.

devcatko-momo.blurb: In a ruined amphitheatre on the edge of a city, an orphan girl who listens better than anyone notices that grey men in bowler hats are persuading the adults to save time, and that the time they save is disappearing.

sofiin-svet.blurb: A fourteen-year-old Norwegian girl starts receiving anonymous notes asking who she is, and is taken through the whole history of Western philosophy by a correspondence teacher whose own situation turns out to be stranger than hers.

bratri-lvi-srdce.blurb: A boy dying of tuberculosis is told by his older brother about Nangijala, the land you go to afterwards, and the two of them arrive there to find it under a tyrant.

ronja-dcera-loupeznika.blurb: The daughter of a robber chieftain grows up in a fortress split in two by lightning and befriends the son of the rival band that moves into the other half.

mio-muj-mio.blurb: A fostered, unwanted boy in Stockholm is carried away to Farawayland, where he is the king's son and is expected to face the knight Kato.

chlapci-z-pavelske-ulice.blurb: Two gangs of Budapest schoolboys in 1889 fight a formal war, with ranks, oaths and a court, over possession of a timber yard.

ostrov-v-ptaci-ulici.blurb: A boy is left alone in a bombed-out house in the Warsaw ghetto after his father is taken, and survives there for months on the assumption that he will come back.

zimni-bitva.blurb: Four teenagers escape from boarding schools in a country ruled by the men who killed their resistance-fighter parents, and go looking for what is left of the resistance.

tim-tolar.blurb: A poor Hamburg boy signs a contract with a wealthy stranger, trading away his laughter in exchange for winning every bet he ever makes.

sarlotina-pavucinka.blurb: A runt pig on an American farm is to be slaughtered in the autumn, and the barn spider in the doorway sets out to make him famous enough to keep.

zlodejka-knih.blurb: Narrated by Death, the story of a foster girl in a German town during the war who learns to read, steals books, and helps hide a Jewish refugee in the cellar.

transport-za-vecnost.blurb: A Czech novel about Petr Ginz, the Prague boy who edited a secret magazine in the Terezin ghetto and drew a picture of the Earth seen from the Moon before he was sent to Auschwitz.

dobrodruzstvi-huckleberryho-finna.blurb: Huck Finn fakes his own murder to escape his father and rafts down the Mississippi with Jim, a man escaping slavery, telling the story in his own voice.

robinson-crusoe.blurb: A shipwrecked English merchant sailor spends twenty-eight years on a Caribbean island, rebuilding shelter, agriculture and defence from what he can salvage, and keeping an account of it.

strom-lzi.blurb: On a Victorian island where her naturalist father has just died, a girl finds the tree he was hiding: it bears fruit that reveals truths, but only if it is fed a lie that spreads.

alenka-v-kraji-divu.blurb: Both Carroll books in one volume: a girl follows a rabbit underground and later climbs through a mirror, and in each place meets creatures who take language and logic entirely literally.

dopis-pro-krale.blurb: On the night of his knighting vigil a squire answers a stranger's call for help, takes charge of a letter he must not read, and rides across the mountains unable to explain himself to anyone.

kdysi-gleitzman.blurb: A Jewish boy walks out of a Polish orphanage in 1942 to find his parents, explaining everything he sees along the way as if it were one of the stories they used to tell him.

orel-devate-legie.blurb: An invalided Roman centurion travels north of Hadrian's Wall out of uniform, with a freed British slave, to find out what happened to the legion his father commanded.

vitr-ve-vrbach.blurb: Episodes from the riverbank: Mole, Rat and Badger keep house and keep the peace while Toad's enthusiasms - most disastrously the motor-car - carry him off.

bylo-nas-pet.blurb: A small-town Czech boy narrates his gang's summer in the mangled, magnificent language of a child copying the grown-ups, in a novel written in 1943.

chlapec-v-pruhovanem-pyzamu.blurb: The nine-year-old son of an Auschwitz commandant, bored at his family's new house, finds a boy in striped pyjamas on the other side of a wire fence.

anna-ze-zeleneho-domu.blurb: An orphan girl is sent by mistake to a Prince Edward Island farm that had asked for a boy, and talks her way into staying.

zahada-hlavolamu.blurb: A Prague boys' club goes into Stinadla, a walled-off quarter with its own secret order and its own rules, after a puzzle box that holds a coded message.

kde-roste-cervene-kapradi.blurb: A boy in the Ozarks saves for two years to buy two coonhound pups, trains them, and hunts with them through the seasons.

prasina.blurb: In a Prague district where electricity has simply stopped working and the modern city has given up on it, two children go looking for a missing friend.

v-seru-davnych-veku.blurb: A Czech archaeologist's novel of a Stone Age clan in Bohemia, following their hunts, tools and seasons through a year of survival.

rekrut-244.blurb: A Czech anti-utopian novel for older children in which a boy is conscripted into a system that identifies him by number.

medvidek-pu.blurb: Milne's stories of a bear of very little brain and his friends in the Hundred Acre Wood, written for and around his son Christopher Robin.

miliony.blurb: Two brothers find a bag of banknotes by a railway line seventeen days before the pound is withdrawn in favour of the euro, and have until then to spend it.

neplavec.blurb: A Czech novel about a seventeen-year-old whose life looks entirely fine from the outside while he slowly stops being able to move through it.

atlasova-sestka.blurb: Six young magicians are recruited into a secretive society that trains initiates for a year, knowing that only five of the six will be permitted to stay.

buh-malickosti.blurb: Twins Estha and Rahel reunite in Kerala decades after the childhood summer their family was destroyed - the death of a visiting cousin, and the discovery and brutal punishment of their mother Ammu's affair with an untouchable carpenter, Velutha.

eleanor-se-ma-vazne-skvele.blurb: A socially isolated, routine-bound young woman in Glasgow develops an unlikely friendship with a coworker after witnessing an accident together, and is slowly forced to confront the childhood trauma she has spent years avoiding.

exordia.blurb: A Kurdish refugee in New York befriends a wounded alien fugitive from a galactic empire, and their bond drags her into a first-contact crisis that erupts in her home region.

kniha-noveho-slunce.blurb: On a far-future dying Earth, a young torturer's apprentice is exiled from his guild for showing forbidden mercy to a prisoner, and sets out on a journey that will eventually lead him toward political power.

kolibka.blurb: A writer researching the day the atomic bomb was dropped investigates the eccentric family of one of its creators, and is drawn into the affairs of a small Caribbean island with its own invented religion, as a doomsday substance called ice-nine threatens the world.

kral-byvaly-a-kral-budouci.blurb: A retelling of the Arthurian legend spanning young Wart's whimsical education under Merlyn through the founding of the Round Table and its eventual tragic collapse under the weight of old sins and a doomed love triangle.

moby-dick.blurb: An illustrated, heavily abridged retelling of Melville's novel: Ishmael joins Captain Ahab's whaling ship as Ahab pursues the white whale that took his leg.

pod-nebesy.blurb: A man in mourning for his father, a general, receives a fortune in legendary horses as a gift from a foreign princess for his years spent burying the war dead, and the gift itself throws him into imperial court intrigue.

posledni-jednorozec.blurb: The last unicorn learns the rest of her kind have vanished, and sets out with a failed magician and a former outlaw to find and free them from the sea-dwelling Red Bull that has been driving them into the waves.

pred-ocima-zapadu.blurb: A St. Petersburg student, Razumov, is drawn into a political assassination when a fellow student who committed it hides in his room and asks for help; Razumov betrays him to the police, is recruited as a government spy, and is sent to Geneva to inform on the same revolutionary circle - where the dead man's sister waits to hear about her brother's last hours.

pribeh-sluzebnice.blurb: In a near-future theocratic state that has stripped women of autonomy, a Handmaid assigned to bear children for a Commander's household narrates her constrained daily life and fragmented memories of the world before.

pycha-a-premlouvani.blurb: Eight years after breaking her engagement to a naval officer she still loves under family pressure, Anne Elliot watches him return to her circle, newly wealthy and courted by younger women, and must decide whether either of them can undo the persuasion that separated them.

raj.blurb: A twelve-year-old boy is sold by his father to a traveling merchant to settle a debt, and works and journeys through early-1900s East Africa as European colonialism closes in.

skoricove-kramy.blurb: A collection of interlinked, dreamlike short prose pieces narrated by a boy recalling his childhood in a provincial Galician town, centered on his eccentric father's surreal transformations and obsessions.

slavne-casy.blurb: The fall of an aging dictator in a fictional African nation, narrated by a chorus of animal citizens, in a satire pointed at the real 2017 ouster of Robert Mugabe.

slib.blurb: Over four decades and four family funerals, a white South African family fails again and again to make good on a deathbed promise to give their Black housekeeper the small house she has always lived in.

sogun.blurb: An English pilot shipwrecked in feudal Japan around 1600 is drawn into the political maneuvering of a warlord's rise to power, while also falling into a dangerous romance with his married interpreter.

soumrak-dne.blurb: An aging English butler takes a motoring trip through the countryside, reflecting on a lifetime of unwavering service and a repressed, unspoken devotion to the housekeeper he worked alongside.

stoleti.blurb: The first volume of a trilogy following several families across Britain, Germany, Russia and America whose lives are pulled together and torn apart by the outbreak of the First World War.

tess-z-d-urbervillu.blurb: A poor Dorset girl is raped by a wealthy relative, has his child who dies in infancy, then marries a man who abandons her on learning her past; her return to her seducer ends in his murder and her execution.

truhla-casu.blurb: A girl wakes early from the suspended-animation box her whole society sealed itself into to wait out a crisis, finds the outside world gone wild, and is told the old legend of a king who tried to conquer time for his daughter's sake - a story that turns out to explain her own present.

ines-ma-draha.blurb: An elderly Ines Suarez writes a memoir of her life for her adopted daughter: fleeing an unhappy marriage in Spain, she crosses to the New World, becomes the longtime companion of conquistador Pedro de Valdivia, and helps found the city of Santiago during the Spanish conquest of Chile.

superman.blurb: As his rogues' gallery makes a coordinated last attempt to kill him, Superman is forced to break his own rule against killing to save his friends, then gives up his powers in penance and disappears - told in flashback ten years later by Lois Lane to a reporter investigating what really happened.

alone-on-a-mountaintop.blurb: A bilingual edition collecting three short prose pieces by Kerouac in different registers, including his account of a solitary stint as a fire lookout on Desolation Peak.

amalie-zubata-a-jednorozci-pani.blurb: Amelia, a good-hearted vampire girl, and her friends travel from their gothic homeland into the unfamiliar Realm of Light to find and rescue a friend's mother.

anatomie-rodu.blurb: Built from parish and military records of the author's own ancestors, the novel follows a Suffolk orphan who goes to sea, a seamstress who moves to London, and a soldier and his family across Victorian England and the Crimean War.

andelin-popel.blurb: A memoir of a desperately poor Irish Catholic childhood in 1930s-40s Limerick, tracing hunger, a father who drinks away the family's wages, the deaths of several siblings, and the narrator's eventual escape to America.

armenska-genocida.blurb: A history of the Armenian genocide of 1915-1922 under the late Ottoman/Young Turk regime, covering its causes and course, followed by a section of eyewitness testimony and an account of how the genocide has been remembered and covered in the Czech press.

artur-a-zlate-lano.blurb: A young boy in Iceland sets out to relight his village's extinguished fire by seeking help from the Norse gods, and is set a quest of his own by Thor in return.

bez-citu.blurb: Continues the Unwind Dystology as Connor, Risa and Lev keep resisting the unwinding system; introduces Cam, a teenager surgically assembled from unwound parts, and the organization that built him.

bez-sance.blurb: In a future America, a law ends the abortion debate by letting parents retroactively terminate a child between the ages of thirteen and eighteen through 'unwinding', a process that disassembles the teen for organ and tissue transplants. Three teenagers scheduled to be unwound - Connor, Risa and Lev - go on the run together.

biblicke-pribehy-pro-neverici-deti.blurb: A civil, non-religious retelling of the Old and New Testament stories aimed at readers with no faith background, written to explain the biblical roots of European identity, with the author's own commentary, contradictions, and links to the present day interleaved.

bludiste-odrazu.blurb: In a near future where anyone can enter a shared virtual world called the Deep, an elite 'diver' capable of navigating it freely is sent to rescue a stranger trapped inside.

budoucnost.blurb: In a 25th-century Europe where death has been eliminated, a paramilitary officer who enforces the trade of immortality for the right to have children begins to doubt the system he serves.

cesta-nikam.blurb: A journalist near Vilnius tries to avoid collaborating with the Soviet occupation of the Polish-Lithuanian borderlands by withdrawing into manual labor, while pressure to conform closes in on him and everyone around him.

cisar-radosti.blurb: Nineteen-year-old Hai, about to jump from a bridge in a fading Connecticut mill town, is talked down by Grazina, an elderly Lithuanian widow losing her memory, and becomes her caretaker over the following months while working at a fast-food restaurant alongside a found family of coworkers.

cisty.blurb: Years after the Detonations, Partridge lives safely inside the Dome as one of the unmarked Pures, while Pressia survives outside among the wretches, fused since childhood to the head of a doll. When a hint suggests his mother may still be alive, Partridge leaves the Dome and meets Pressia.

citanka-neila-gaimana.blurb: A retrospective anthology gathering close to fifty of the author's short stories alongside short excerpts from five of his adult novels, framed as an introduction to his body of work.

clayuv-most.blurb: Five brothers raise themselves after their mother's death and father's disappearance; the fourth, Clay, sets out to build a literal bridge that comes to stand for reconciling the family's past.

dedictvi-ztraty.blurb: In the Himalayan foothills, a retired judge and his orphaned granddaughter Sai navigate a Nepalese insurgency while, in New York, the family cook's son Biju works a string of illegal restaurant jobs as an undocumented immigrant.

doktor-sax.blurb: A childhood memoir of growing up in Lowell, Massachusetts, blended with a surreal pulp-adventure fantasy about a mysterious caped figure named Doctor Sax battling a hidden evil beneath the town.

dva-roky-osm-mesicu-a-osmadvacet-noci.blurb: After a supernatural storm strikes near-future New York, jinn and their scattered mixed-blood descendants are drawn into a mythic war between reason and unreason.

dve-mista-na-slunci.blurb: A shipboard AI, newly and illegally placed into an android body after losing her memory, learns to live as a person with the help of a friend who has her own history of escaping captivity.

holandska-vila.blurb: After their father dies and a resentful stepmother disinherits them, siblings Danny and Maeve Conroy spend decades parked outside the Philadelphia mansion they grew up in, working through nostalgia, resentment and what they actually owe each other.

hukot-casu.blurb: A fictionalised account of composer Dmitri Shostakovich's life under the Soviet regimes of Stalin and Khrushchev, told in three episodes spanning decades, tracing the compromises an artist makes to survive under a dictatorship that controls art.

intermezzo.blurb: After their father's death, two Dublin brothers, a lawyer torn between two relationships and a young chess player falling for an older separated woman, navigate grief and their own strained relationship.

jak-uchvatit-draci-klenot.blurb: Outcast and hunted by both dragons and Vikings, Hiccup must find the Dragon's Jewel to stop Alvin the Treacherous from being crowned King of the Wilderwest and save his people from the Dragon Rebellion.

kazani-ohne.blurb: Four hundred years after a nuclear war, every person is born with a twin -- one unmarked, one visibly altered -- and the two share a single fate: if one dies, so does the other.

kdo-me-vzal-prvne-za-ruku.blurb: In 1950s London, Lexie Sinclair falls for magazine editor Innes Kent and builds a career as an art critic and single mother after his death; in the present day, new parents Elina and Ted navigate a difficult birth and buried family secrets that connect the two storylines.

kniha-hrbitova.blurb: An infant whose family is murdered by an assassin wanders into a graveyard and is raised by its ghosts, growing up caught between the world of the living and the dead while the killer keeps hunting him.

kolaborant-2-vyvrhel.blurb: A soldier killed by the faction he served is revived by a mysterious stranger and given a chance to help the survivors of a ruined city that despises him as much as he despises them.

kosmonaut-z-cech.blurb: A Czech astronaut sent alone to investigate a mysterious dust cloud near Venus loses contact with the wife he left behind on Earth, while an ambiguous alien presence keeps him company on the mission.

kramek-s-kouzly.blurb: A librarian flees a burning capital city with a satchel of stolen spellbooks and returns to her childhood island, where she secretly opens a shop selling small illegal spells.

krehke-veci.blurb: A short story collection spanning fantasy, horror and fable, including a Sherlock Holmes/Lovecraft pastiche and a novella set after one of the author's novels.

krev-kristaloveho-kvetu.blurb: A young woman who survived a massacre as a child has lived ever since inside a protected boundary, guarded by the man who saved her -- and who could kill her -- as the outside world closes in again.

krokodyl.blurb: A Russian civil servant is swallowed alive by a crocodile on display in a St Petersburg arcade, and rather than being freed, decides to make the best of his new home while continuing to conduct his official business from inside it - a satire of bureaucratic vanity, left unfinished by the author.

krysy-apokalypsy.blurb: Eighty years after the gods were overthrown, the world of Ler ends in a small way every seven days when a magical storm sweeps the land outside its protective barriers, and its people scrape by in the ruins.

kudy-do-kamkoli.blurb: K2 O'Hero can draw maps of worlds that turn out to be real, a secret his magical family has always kept hidden - until his baby half-sister is kidnapped by a mysterious teacher and he, his twin, and his sceptical stepsiblings must cross into another world to save her.

letni-srst.blurb: Thirteen-year-old Brian is left to care for his severely disabled older brother Lucien over one summer, while their unreliable father lives off the money the arrangement brings in.

mag-satori-v-parizi.blurb: A brief, autobiographical account of a solo week Kerouac spent in Paris searching for family history and a moment of enlightenment ('satori') that keeps eluding him.

maruska-pulnocni-a-zahada-mesice.blurb: A young moth named Marnie starts at an insect academy eager to study moon magic, but discovers the lessons have been cancelled and sets out with friends to find out why.

metro-2034.blurb: In the tunnels of the post-nuclear Moscow Metro, a chronicler sets out with a young woman to document the underground's scattered communities as a new danger threatens them.

mladej-mungo.blurb: In 1990s sectarian Glasgow, fifteen-year-old Protestant Mungo falls for his Catholic neighbor James while his family pushes him toward violence, and a fishing trip with strangers turns dangerous.

muj-bratr-ocean.blurb: Kerouac's earliest attempt at a novel, written at twenty about a merchant seaman's voyage and friendship, published posthumously decades later as juvenilia.

muz-v-labyrintu.blurb: A diplomat left scarred by first contact with an alien race, broadcasting an unbearable psychic aura, exiles himself inside a maze on a remote planet until a new alien threat forces two other men to seek him out.

na-ceste.blurb: Sal Paradise recounts his cross-country travels in the late 1940s with the restless, charismatic Dean Moriarty, based closely on Kerouac's own life and friendships within the Beat generation.

nez-potkala-me.blurb: Historian Graham Hendrick leaves his first wife for Ann, a former actress, and is happy until he learns of her life and lovers before they met. He becomes consumed by retrospective jealousy over a past he was never part of.

nimbus.blurb: Rowan sets out alone to test and punish corrupt Scythes by fire across the continent, while the benevolent AI that governs the rest of the world watches events it is forbidden to intervene in.

normalni-lidi.blurb: Marianne and Connell, opposite in social standing in their small Irish town, become secret lovers in secondary school and drift in and out of each other's lives through university.

nova-planeta.blurb: Daniel grows up in a technologically advanced, fully closed civilisation calling itself the New Planet, which claims to have left Earth but has really just built an impassable wall around itself. A betrayal casts him out among the dead beneath that wall, and he must survive in the ruined world outside while learning what the New Planet is really built on.

nuz.blurb: Rushdie recounts the 2022 stage attack that nearly killed him and cost him an eye, and the physical and psychological recovery that followed.

o-dusi-a-divce.blurb: A collection of fourteen fairy tales set in the mountains, in which animals and elements of nature speak in human voices and recount their encounters with people, often as parables about human life.
