ohen.blurb: After his father's death, Partridge takes power inside the Dome, but finds fulfilling his promise to unite the Dome with the wretches outside far harder than he expected once he actually holds the power to do it.

plavec-ve-tme.blurb: In 1980 communist Poland, university student Ludwik falls in love with Janusz during a summer at an agricultural work camp, and the two must each decide, after martial law arrives, whether to pursue freedom, safety or each other.

pod-septajicimi-dvermi.blurb: After a reaper collects Wallace Price from his own funeral, the ferryman Hugo takes him to a remote tea shop where the newly dead work through their unfinished lives before choosing to pass through a door to whatever comes next; given one week, Wallace must decide what he never let himself feel while alive.

posledni-dny-rabbit-hayesove.blurb: Rabbit Hayes, a woman whose cancer has returned and spread, spends her final days with her young daughter, her family and memories of the love of her life, as those around her struggle to accept she is dying.

povidky-ze-stareho-cylindru.blurb: Ten stories and an epilogue drawn from the author's decades as a diplomat, following ordinary people he encountered across the countries where he lived and worked.

prestupni-stanice.blurb: A Civil War veteran secretly runs a hidden waystation for interstellar travelers on his Wisconsin farm, keeping Earth's existence in the galactic community a secret for over a century.

previtem-snadno-a-rychle.blurb: A satirical diary of a baby's second year of life, narrated from the infant's own point of view as it moves through tantrums, potty training and family chaos.

protektorat.blurb: As the long war against the hostile alien intelligence Rainier comes to a head, Commander Sanda Greeve fights to bring it down from outside while her brother Biran, now in a position of power within the Protectorate's leadership, works to root out its influence from within.

rozum-proti-vire.blurb: A military history of the Great Turkish War of 1683-1699, the conflict between the Holy League led by Habsburg Austria and the Ottoman Empire that pushed Ottoman power back from Vienna through Buda and Belgrade.

shledani.blurb: Veronica Hegarty returns her alcoholic brother Liam's body from England to Ireland after his suicide and, sitting with his death, revisits a possibly-invented memory from their childhood at their grandmother's house.

shuggie-bain.blurb: In 1980s Thatcher-era Glasgow, young Shuggie tries to care for his alcoholic mother Agnes while struggling to fit in himself.

sirotcinec-slecny-peregrinove.blurb: After his grandfather's death, a teenager travels to a remote Welsh island and discovers a group of children with strange abilities, frozen in a single repeating day since World War II.

smrtka.blurb: In a future where humanity has ended death, disease and want, an order of 'Scythes' is charged with killing a quota of people each year to control the population. Two teenagers, Citra and Rowan, are chosen as rival apprentices; whichever is ordained first must kill the other.

splynuti.blurb: Having escaped the Dome, Partridge tries to survive in the ash-choked world outside among the fused wretches, while those inside the Dome pursue their own plans.

stoleti-pary.blurb: In a steam-powered world where trolls, once enslaved as labor, rise up against their masters, gunslinger and monster-hunter Fastynger van Houten navigates a fractured industrial empire.

strucna-historie-vecneho-zivota.blurb: After learning she is dying, a Czech woman travels to the United States to find the daughter she gave up decades earlier, while her two estranged adult children try to save her from a biotech company obsessed with immortality.

svaty-demon.blurb: In a distant, unnamed past, a man is cast as a false messiah of the 17th century, granted power over the lives of others he never sought, and finds that stepping outside the role forced on him is only possible by destroying himself.

ticha-planeta.blurb: The crew of the Messenger, the first human expedition beyond the solar system, reaches the colony world of Asgardia hoping for humanity's expansion, only to find the planet is not what survey data promised and that no species there ever developed sound communication.

to-jsem-ja-edacek.blurb: A Russian immigrant poet in 1970s New York, recently divorced and living on welfare, drifts through humiliating jobs, radical politics and a string of degrading sexual encounters with men and women.

v-zakulisi-srdce.blurb: A Czech cardiologist recounts building a top cardiology department from scratch and pioneering new treatment methods, interspersed with short reflective pieces about the heart as a symbol of the self.

vek-supernovy.blurb: A previously unnoticed supernova irradiates Earth, and everyone over the age of thirteen learns they will die of radiation sickness within a year, leaving children to inherit and run global civilization.

vize-codyho.blurb: An experimental reworking of Kerouac's own cross-country travels and New York friendships, built from tape transcriptions, jazz-influenced improvisation and non-linear sketches of a fictionalized friend, Cody Pomeray.

vyhodme-ho-z-kola-ven.blurb: Randle McMurphy fakes insanity to escape prison labor and lands in an Oregon psychiatric ward run by the controlling Nurse Ratched, where he rallies the other patients against her authority.

vyhoreni.blurb: A food-delivery courier navigates the daily hostility of city traffic in a novel-length polemic against car culture, framed partly as allegory.

z-mitfordu-do-stare-vlasti.blurb: A retired priest and his wife travel to Ireland to research his family history, and become entangled in a decades-old family secret at the fishing lodge where they are staying.

zvon.blurb: With the floating city Endura destroyed and two of the series' central characters missing, the corrupt faction of the Scythedom moves toward total power while other characters work to stop it.

bez-duse.blurb: Continues the Unwind Dystology after the destruction of the group's safe haven: Connor and Lev remain on the run while Cam plans to destroy the organization that created him.

historie-duny.blurb: Decades into humanity's war against the thinking machines, Serena Butler leads the faithful while political operator Iblis Ginjo maneuvers for power, as the war's cost mounts on both sides.

jak-vysoko-klesneme.blurb: Linked stories follow the aftermath of an ancient pathogen unearthed by archaeologists in the Arctic permafrost, tracing the plague's spread and its effects on individuals and generations across centuries, from funerary skyscrapers on Earth to interstellar ships.

mapa-jinozemi-emily-wildove.blurb: Professor Emily Wilde, a scholar of faerie folklore, investigates a series of strange faerie incursions at her university while journeying to the Austrian Alps to search for a missing colleague and a path back to a fae kingdom.

misto-na-svete.blurb: Frances Mayes reflects on the meaning of home across the places she has lived and loved, centered on her villa near Cortona, Italy, alongside essays on friends' homes, gardens and travel.

my-vsichni-neradi.blurb: Seven cursed families in the town of Ilvernath must each name a champion to fight to the death in a generational tournament for control of the world's most powerful magic, now thrust into public view by a tell-all book.

nastroje-smrti.blurb: In a New York populated by demons and the Shadowhunters who fight them, Clary Fray tries to save her boyfriend Jace after he is magically bound to her dangerous half-brother.

o-cem-se-nemluvi.blurb: A married couple with a strained relationship downloads a viral app meant to spice up their marriage, which instead draws them into an escalating, dangerous game.

odkaz-oceli.blurb: A year after an uneasy alliance saved the Tressian Republic at great cost, factions old and new -- the shadowy Crowfall assembly and armies massing in the east -- move to exploit the fragile peace.

pada-ruda-hvezda.blurb: Agent Luke Daniels rescues a colleague long thought dead from a Russian prison, then follows the man's dying words into a hunt for the lost library of Ivan the Terrible and a dormant Soviet satellite weapon.

sip-a-vitr-dyka-a-more.blurb: The second volume of linked tales set along the Meekhanese borderland, following soldiers, mages and political players from the world's east and west as their separate stories gradually converge.

smrtelni-bohove.blurb: A collection of science-fiction stories set across different worlds and eras united by the recurring figure of 'gods' among people - from the depths of a Brazilian dam to a flooded California, the streets of Prague, and Mars.

syren.blurb: Septimus Heap and his friends are stranded on a mysterious island with an injured dragon, where they discover a magical girl, a lighthouse that has lost its light, and a plot against their home castle.

underground.blurb: In a future Prague kept comfortable behind a wall of propaganda, a jaded ex-soldier turned bodyguard is hired to protect a member of a cult of augmented performers, and is pulled into the city's brewing unrest.

2010-druha-vesmirna-odysea.blurb: Nine years after the Discovery mission's disaster, a joint US-Soviet crew returns to Jupiter to learn what happened to HAL 9000 and the missing astronaut David Bowman, racing a competing Chinese expedition.

alma-a-svet-obrazu.blurb: A blind girl accidentally steps through a painting in her grandfather's junk shop and finds she can see, then falls out of the painting into 1920s Prague, where she must find the artist who made the painting while navigating a century she does not recognize.

andelickar.blurb: A mild-mannered clock repairer, the estranged son of one of London's great gangsters, accidentally activates a WWII-era doomsday device and is pulled into a decades-old conspiracy involving his father's criminal empire and a retired secret agent.

bizarni-povidky.blurb: A collection of ten stories by Nobel laureate Olga Tokarczuk, each set in a different time and place, exploring how easily the surreal and uncanny break into ordinary reality.

byla-jsem-stastna.blurb: The memoirs of Czech opera singer Jarmila Novotna, recounting her international career from the 1920s through the 1950s.

cerveny-trpaslik.blurb: Three million years from Earth, the last living human, Dave Lister, wakes aboard the derelict mining ship Red Dwarf with only a hologram of his insufferable bunkmate, a senile ship's computer, and a cat-descended humanoid for company.

daleko-v-srdce.blurb: A son pieces together the story of his Czech parents' escape from Nazi occupation and then Communism, their loveless marriage, and his mother's own lost love affair, after his father's death and his mother's descent into dementia.

divka-na-snehu.blurb: After a teenage girl is found murdered in a small Colorado town, three residents - her obsessive classmate, a girl who hated her, and the police officer investigating - narrate the days that follow, each hiding secrets of their own.

dost-dobre-nenormalni.blurb: German journalist Denise Linke recounts life after being diagnosed with Asperger's syndrome at 22 and ADHD three years later, examining sensory overload, social misunderstandings and prejudice with humor.

draci-mesto.blurb: A teenage girl bitten and turned into a lizard-person against her will discovers a hidden society of dragon-descended shapeshifters living secretly among humans, and is pulled into their conflict with a savage rival faction.

dum-v-blankytne-modrem-mori.blurb: A lonely, by-the-book caseworker for the Department in Charge of Magical Youth is secretly sent to evaluate six unusual children - among them a gnome, a wyvern, and the Antichrist - and their enigmatic caretaker on a remote island, and finds an unlikely family along with a reason to challenge the bureaucracy he has always served.

gernsbackovo-kontinuum.blurb: A photographer hired to document 1930s American 'raygun gothic' futurist architecture begins hallucinating an alternate, utopian version of that imagined future, and finds its gleaming vision has an unsettling kinship with fascist aesthetics.

gradiva.blurb: A German archaeologist becomes obsessed with a bas-relief of a walking woman he names Gradiva, dreams he meets her in Pompeii moments before Vesuvius erupts, and gradually realizes she is his forgotten childhood sweetheart. Paired here with Freud's 1907 psychoanalytic essay interpreting the novella as a case study in repression and delusion.

hlas-lesa.blurb: A teenage girl finds herself alone in a desert with only a butterfly-net-carrying stranger for company, and must travel through a dreamlike, danger-filled landscape to find the butterfly the stranger wants, encountering beings that are not what they first appear to be.

in-memoriam.blurb: Two English schoolboys secretly in love with each other enlist to fight in World War One alongside their classmates, and must navigate their feelings for one another amid the horrors of the trenches.

jaderko.blurb: Three interwoven stories - an 18th-century faun planting apple orchards across the American frontier, a near-future defector trying to bring down the corporation that owns the world's engineered food supply, and a lone being crossing a glacier a thousand years from now - trace humanity's reshaping of the land it depends on.

jak-hitler-ukradl-ruzoveho-kralicka.blurb: A nine-year-old girl and her Jewish family flee Berlin in 1933 as the Nazis rise to power, moving through Switzerland, Paris and finally England as refugees.

jak-jsme-v-teheranu-cetly-lolitu.blurb: A literature professor recalls the secret weekly seminar she held for seven female students in her home during her last two years in Iran, reading forbidden Western classics and discussing personal freedom under the Islamic Republic.

je-matka-mrtva.blurb: An estranged artist returns to Oslo after thirty years abroad and becomes consumed with reconnecting with, then surveilling, the mother she has not spoken to in decades.

jste-tady.blurb: Two divorced, middle-aged strangers are invited on a long-distance walking holiday across northern England by a mutual friend, and as the rest of the group drops out, the two of them are left to complete the trek together.

kdo-tanci-s-vodou.blurb: Hiram Walker, born enslaved on a Virginia plantation with perfect recall except for memories of his mother, discovers he can teleport through 'Conduction' -- a power activated by memory -- and is recruited into the Underground, the network fighting to end slavery.

kdyz-neni-kral.blurb: A selection of Nguyen Huy Thiep's best-known stories, mixing contemporary social criticism, historical episodes and village folktales that helped open up Vietnamese literature during the late-1980s reform era.

kdyz-se-pohne-les.blurb: A young squire accompanies his knight into a sentient, malevolent forest that can twist human bodies and minds, on a mission to remove a powerful artifact the forest will not willingly give up.

kniha-silenstvi-a-lecby.blurb: In Renaissance Venice, one of the few licensed female physicians sets out across Europe to find her vanished father, following the cryptic letters he left behind.

krcmarova-pisen.blurb: Three women carrying secrets converge on a remote inn while trying to protect their dying wizard-mentor from a former student who wants him to die a lingering, tormented death, dragging the innkeeper and his staff into a war of magic and old debts.

kruh-dni.blurb: In Neolithic Britain, a flint-miner in love with a priestess's sister, and the priestess herself, drive the building of a great stone circle - the origin of Stonehenge - as drought and mistrust between herders, farmers and woodlanders threaten to tear the plain apart in violence.

led.blurb: In a 1924 where World War I never happened, an unearthly Ice has frozen much of Europe under two-valued logic; a gambling mathematics student is sent from Warsaw toward Siberia in search of his exiled father, who may be able to speak with the Ice's angels.

loutkar-z-krakova.blurb: A living wooden doll is swept out of her homeland into the workshop of a magical toymaker in Nazi-occupied Krakow, where the two of them try to protect a Jewish musician and his daughter as the occupation grows more dangerous.

mala-cviceni-v-bezohlednosti.blurb: Ten stories, set from the 1950s to the present, following introverted women shaped by wartime and totalitarian-era upbringing who feel constrained by their roles as daughters, wives and mothers.
mala-cviceni-v-bezohlednosti.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

mandolina-kapitana-corelliho.blurb: On the Greek island of Cephalonia during the WWII Italian and German occupation, a doctor's daughter falls for the cultured Italian officer billeted in her home after breaking off her engagement to a local fisherman turned resistance fighter.

manual-pro-uklizecky.blurb: Forty-three largely autobiographical stories following a woman through jobs, addiction, and cities across the American Southwest and beyond, written over thirty years and published posthumously.

mec-damokluv.blurb: Aboard the Federation starship Titan, the crew investigates the 'Eye of Erykon,' a mysterious object that has hung over the planet Orisha for centuries and shaped its civilization out of fear.

na-konci-duhy.blurb: A bilingual English-Czech learner's edition collecting three lesser-known Jack London stories - 'The End of the Story' and 'At the Rainbow's End,' both set along the frozen Yukon River, and 'The House of Mapuhi,' set among South Pacific pearl hunters facing a hurricane.

nadrazi-perdido.blurb: In the corrupt, steampunk city of New Crobuzon, a rogue scientist's attempt to help a client regain the power of flight accidentally unleashes a plague of dream-eating monsters.

neocekavane-dychanky.blurb: A collection of fifteen short fantasy stories that blend everyday life with folklore, mythology and literary references, posed as whimsical questions such as how stars are born or what a princess pays a beast who will not be kissed.

neslibovala-jsem-ti-prochazku-ruzovym-sa.blurb: A semi-autobiographical novel following a teenage girl's three years of treatment for schizophrenia in a private psychiatric hospital, and her therapist's efforts to help her leave the elaborate inner world she has built for herself.

nevinatka.blurb: Two siblings, aged nine and eleven, are left to fend for themselves on an isolated Newfoundland cove after their parents die, surviving years of storms, hunger and isolation with only each other.

nezname-veledilo-a-jine-prozy.blurb: Three Balzac novellas about artists -- a painter obsessed with perfecting a masterpiece, a composer likewise consumed by his art, and a sculptor undone by naivety and society's intrigues.

nikdy.blurb: Small, local conflicts in the Sahara desert and on the Korean peninsula escalate through tit-for-tat retaliation, drawing in an American president, US intelligence officers, and a Chinese general as the crisis threatens to spiral into world war.

nimona.blurb: In a kingdom mixing knights and modern technology, a shapeshifting girl talks her way into becoming sidekick to the kingdom's official villain, and together they set out to prove that the celebrated institution of heroes is not what it claims to be.

ochutnavac.blurb: A starving Renaissance-era peasant is conscripted to taste his tyrannical duke's food for poison, a job in which staying alive requires as much wit as luck.

ohnivy-sloup.blurb: In Elizabethan England, spy Ned Willard works to protect Queen Elizabeth I from Catholic assassination and invasion plots across four decades, while his lifelong love for Margery, coerced into marrying a rival Catholic lord, endures through a long affair and eventual reunion.

pameti-imaginarniho-kamarada.blurb: Budo, the imaginary friend of eight-year-old Max -- a boy on the autism spectrum -- has existed far longer than most imaginary friends and must decide how far to go to protect Max from a dangerous teacher, knowing that Max growing up and forgetting him means Budo will cease to exist.

pet-cinanu-obesenych-v-idahu.blurb: A girl kidnapped from a Chinese fish market at thirteen is trafficked to America, passing through a calligraphy school, a San Francisco brothel, and finally a shop in the Idaho mountains as she fights to survive and find her way home.

pozdni-navratilec.blurb: A Czech-curated selection of Mavis Gallant's short stories, centered on emigrants and exiles living in Paris and elsewhere, drawn from two English-language collections spanning the 1960s-70s.

pozustali.blurb: After two percent of the world's population vanishes without explanation, the Garvey family and their small town try to make sense of grief, faith, and what comes next.

pribeh-o-lasce-a-tme.blurb: Amos Oz's memoir of growing up in 1940s Jerusalem, intertwining his family's history with the birth of Israel and centered on his mother's suicide when he was twelve.

prvni-laska-a-jine-povidky.blurb: A collection headed by Turgenev's novella 'First Love,' about a young man's infatuation with a neighbor that turns to disillusionment when he learns the identity of her secret lover.
prvni-laska-a-jine-povidky.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

rur.blurb: A comic-book adaptation of Karel Capek's 1920 play about a factory that mass-produces artificial humans (the origin of the word 'robot') to do all human labor, and what happens when they turn on their makers.

sklenik.blurb: A billion years in humanity's future, on a tidally-locked Earth blanketed by carnivorous plant life, a small band of devolved humans led by Gren journeys through a jungle world dominated by monstrous flora after Gren is taken over by an intelligent, controlling fungus.

stiny-v-raji.blurb: A journalist who spent years hiding from the Nazis in a museum flees to New York, where he tries to build a new life and love while haunted by what he survived.

stribrny-sen.blurb: Two years after joining the interdimensional peacekeeping group InterWorld, teenage Joey Harker is still blamed for a teammate's death when a mysterious young woman with rival dimension-jumping powers draws him into a new phase of the war between the magic-wielding HEX and the machine-logic Binary.

stul-v-koute.blurb: An eleven-year-old boy sails alone from Ceylon to England in 1954, seated at the ship's least prestigious table with two other boys and a group of eccentric adults, and is drawn into a shipboard mystery involving a shackled prisoner.

svadlena-z-dachau.blurb: An ambitious young London seamstress is trapped in France when the Nazis invade, then taken as slave labor into the household of the commandant at Dachau concentration camp, where her sewing skill becomes her only means of survival.

takove-malickosti.blurb: In 1985 Ireland, a coal merchant with five daughters makes a delivery to the local convent-run laundry and discovers something that forces him to decide whether to act against the town's complicit silence.

takovy-prima-vek.blurb: A young Black babysitter is accused of kidnapping the white toddler in her care by a supermarket security guard, an incident that entangles her with the child's guilt-ridden, privileged mother and unravels both of their lives.

tehdy-jsme-zili-v-letni-zemi.blurb: A group of children and teenagers spend a forced summer vacation with their dissolute parents at a lakeside house; when a catastrophic storm signals the collapse of civilization, the children abandon the adults and fend for themselves.

the-happy-prince-and-other-tales.blurb: A bilingual English-Czech edition of five Victorian literary fairy tales, including the title story of a gilded statue and a swallow who give away their beauty and their lives to relieve a city's poverty, plus 'The Nightingale and the Rose,' 'The Selfish Giant,' 'The Devoted Friend,' and 'The Remarkable Rocket.'

toulava-zeme.blurb: Ten science fiction stories, most centered on humanity confronting planetary or civilizational-scale catastrophe, including the title story about propelling Earth itself out of the solar system to escape a dying sun.

tvar-vody.blurb: In 1962 Baltimore, a mute janitor at a secret Cold War research facility falls in love with a captured, sentient amphibious being, and must risk everything with her friends' help to save it from a violent government agent before it can be studied to death.

u-jezera.blurb: The extended Starling family gathers for one last weekend at their lake house before it is sold, and a tragedy during the visit forces long-hidden secrets into the open.

u-ra-no-va.blurb: In August 1968, an English woman travels to the Czechoslovak spa town of Jachymov to find her father's family and vanishes; decades later her fiance retraces her path into the town's history of Soviet-era labor camps and uranium mining, and into supernatural phenomena tied to its underground.

umeni-radosti.blurb: Spanning a Sicilian woman's entire life from 1900 through the fascist era, the novel follows Modesta's ruthless rise from poverty to the head of a noble family, pursuing financial, sexual and political independence by any means available to her.

vecer-a-jitro.blurb: In 997 CE England, under attack from Vikings and Welsh raiders, a young boatbuilder, a Norman noblewoman married into a philandering ealdorman's household, and an ambitious monk each fight against chaos and a corrupt bishop to build something lasting - the beginnings of the town of Kingsbridge.

velka-boure-v-ceskych-zemich.blurb: In 1848, sudden catastrophic flooding drowns much of Central Europe; as bandits and a military dictator fill the power vacuum in the chaos, a coalition of ordinary townspeople, industrialists and local leaders forms to protect what is left of Bohemia.

venkovsky-lekar.blurb: Fourteen short prose pieces by Franz Kafka, including the title story of a doctor's surreal, doomed nighttime journey to a dying patient, several drawn from his own recorded dreams.

vodni-nuz.blurb: In a drought-ravaged Southwest United States, a hired 'water knife' is sent from Las Vegas to Phoenix to investigate a water source that could shift the balance of power, crossing paths with a local journalist and a refugee.

vryte-mesto.blurb: Two former mercenaries flee across a wasteland to the decaying tropical city of Ashamoil, where one becomes a doctor to the poor and the other a bodyguard and assassin to a ruthless slaver, and both are drawn into the city's surreal, morally ambiguous underworld.

vysvobozeni.blurb: Four suburban Atlanta friends take a canoe trip down a remote Georgia river before it's dammed; a brutal encounter with hostile locals turns the trip into a fight for survival against both the river and armed men.

zakriveny-cas-v-kremzi.blurb: Five stories, each centered on an aging man -- a retired industrialist, a music teacher, a writer, a WWI veteran, and finally a man in the Austrian town of Krems -- who confront memory, aging, and the strange non-linearity of time.

zapadakov.blurb: A small Colorado town is overrun after twelve inmates orchestrate a mass prison break that turns into a massacre. Two years later, local police officer Lea Hawkins sets out to hunt down the twelve masterminds who were never caught.

zelezna-vdova.blurb: In a China-inspired world defended by giant mecha piloted by paired boys and girls who usually die powering them, a vengeful peasant girl becomes the terrifying 'Iron Widow' who refuses to be sacrificed.

zprava-z-hadu.blurb: The colony ship Proserpina wakes its thirty thousand sleeping passengers early to reveal the ship is on an unavoidable collision course with a giant comet, and navigator-turned-captain Waco Teirange must get the ship and its mission through an icy crisis before it can reach the planet it was meant to settle.

ztracena-v-dobre-knize.blurb: Newlywed literary detective Thursday Next must retrieve a dangerous enemy from inside Poe's 'The Raven' to save her husband, who has been erased from existence by a shadowy corporation, while training as an apprentice book-jumper inside the world's literature.

ztraceny-rok.blurb: During the COVID lockdown, a thirteen-year-old boy stuck at home with his great-grandmother uncovers a photograph that leads him to a hidden family story rooted in the Ukrainian famine of the 1930s.

zvlastni-smutek-citronoveho-kolace.blurb: A girl discovers on her ninth birthday that she can taste the emotions of whoever cooked her food, a gift that forces her to confront her family's hidden unhappiness, including her mother's affair.

beowulf.blurb: A prose retelling of the Old English epic: Beowulf slays the monster Grendel and his mother, then dies decades later killing a dragon that threatens his kingdom.

damsky-gambit.blurb: Orphaned at eight, Beth Harmon discovers chess and tranquilizers in the same institution and rises from obscurity to the top of competitive chess while fighting addiction to pills and alcohol.

divka-zena-jine.blurb: Twelve interconnected characters, mostly Black British women across generations, each get a chapter tracing their own path through family, identity, race, gender and sexuality in contemporary Britain.

dum-na-pineapple-street.blurb: Three women married or connected to a wealthy Brooklyn Heights family - one who married in, one bound by a prenup, and one having a secret affair - navigate privilege, money and family loyalty.

holka-se-silicim-hlasem.blurb: A 14-year-old Nigerian girl is married off to pay her family's debts, then trafficked into domestic servitude in Lagos, and fights throughout to get the education her late mother told her would give her a voice.

jak-lvove.blurb: In a grimy steampunk world of mechanical knights and monstrous creatures born of industrial excess, the roguish gunslinger Fastynger van Hauten is hired to deal with a new threat.

julie-z-vlci-smecky.blurb: A 13-year-old Inupiat girl flees an unwanted marriage into the Alaskan tundra, is adopted by a wolf pack she comes to love as family, and must eventually choose between the traditional and modern ways of life open to her.

kocka-a-mesto.blurb: A stray cat wends through the lives of Tokyo strangers -- a tattooist, a homeless man, a taxi driver's estranged family, a shut-in hoarder, a lonely translator -- each touched and loosely connected by the cat's wanderings.

nekde-za-morem.blurb: Arthur Parnassus and the children of Marsyas Island face a new, more hostile leadership at the Department in Charge of Magical Youth after the old system's whistleblowing scandal, as Arthur is forced to testify about the abuse he suffered as a child in that same system.

nestvura-z-essexu.blurb: A newly widowed naturalist moves to coastal Essex to investigate a legendary sea serpent, developing an intense friendship with the local vicar, whose wife is meanwhile dying of consumption.

ohromni-optimisti.blurb: In 1985 Chicago, art-gallery development director Yale Tishman watches AIDS take his circle of friends one by one; thirty years later his friend Fiona searches Paris for the estranged daughter she lost while caring for the dying.

patrick-melrose.blurb: A boy abused by his sadistic father grows into an adult heroin addict in New York, then returns to England to confront his past and attempt recovery.

sirotek-bestie-spionka.blurb: A Jewish teenager fleeing Nazi Germany is recruited by a British spy and sent undercover into an elite Nazi girls' school to befriend the daughter of a scientist working on a secret weapon.

sok-z-padu.blurb: Nineteen-year-old Matthew Homes, whose older brother died years earlier, writes his way through worsening schizophrenia in a mental-health facility, uncovering what actually happened the night his brother died.

straz-casu.blurb: Time Patrol agent Manse Everard is recruited into a secret organization tasked with preventing rogue time travelers from altering the course of history, across a series of missions spanning millennia.

teplo-domova.blurb: In a modern retelling of Antigone, British-Pakistani siblings Isma, Aneeka and Parvaiz navigate the legacy of their jihadist father; Parvaiz is drawn into radicalization while Aneeka falls for the son of the Home Secretary leading the crackdown against it.

uzdraveni-rose-gold-wattsove.blurb: Five years after her daughter's testimony sent her to prison for Munchausen syndrome by proxy, Patty Watts is released and moves in with an adult Rose Gold, and the two begin a cat-and-mouse game of revenge.

v-melounovem-cukru.blurb: In a surreal post-collapse commune called iDEATH, a nameless narrator writes the community's first book in decades while his tranquil life with Pauline is shadowed by memories of violence and his ex-lover Margaret's decline.

zlodejka.blurb: In Victorian London, orphan and petty thief Sue Trinder is recruited into a con to swindle a naive gentlewoman, Maud Lilly, out of her inheritance -- but Sue and Maud both have secrets that upend the plan.

a-doggie-and-a-pussycat.blurb: A dog and a cat share a small house and try to do everything the way grown-up people do, with mixed and often funny results.

antropolozka-na-marsu.blurb: Neurologist Oliver Sacks profiles seven patients - among them a colorblind painter, a surgeon with Tourette's, a formerly blind man learning to see, and animal-behavior scientist Temple Grandin - whose neurological differences reshape how they experience reality.

bajecna-medicina-podle-adama.blurb: A comedic, illustrated nonfiction book for children about strange and gruesome moments in the history of medicine, from bloodletting to primitive surgery.

bajky.blurb: A collection of La Fontaine's animal fables, each a short scene illustrating a human vice or virtue through the animals' behaviour.

bile-noci.blurb: Over four white nights in St Petersburg, a lonely dreamer befriends a young woman waiting for the man she loves, and offers her his own devotion in the meantime.

blazniva-nedele-a-jine-povidky.blurb: A collection of F. Scott Fitzgerald stories and novellas including 'The Diamond as Big as the Ritz,' 'The Curious Case of Benjamin Button' and 'Crazy Sunday,' spanning period social satire, Hollywood life and psychologically drawn characters.

bylo-nebylo.blurb: A selection of classic Czech fairy tales by Bozena Nemcova - Palecek, Smolicek, the hen and the rooster, and others - retold and simplified in language for the youngest readers.

carmen-skutecny-zivot-hany-hegerove.blurb: An authorized documentary biography of Czech-Slovak singer Hana Hegerova, based on a decade of interviews and access to her private archive, published after her death per her own condition.

cold-mountain.blurb: A wounded Confederate deserter treks home across a disintegrating South to reunite with Ada Monroe, who is learning to run her late father's farm with the help of the resourceful Ruby.

conan.blurb: The first part of a complete edition of Robert E. Howard's original Conan stories, following the barbarian across the Hyborian Age through a string of self-contained sword-and-sorcery adventures.

dar-tri-kralu.blurb: A poor young married couple, Della and Jim, each secretly sacrifice their most prized possession to buy the other a Christmas gift, only to find the gifts have become ironically useless to the intended recipient.

divne-pocasi.blurb: Four stand-alone novellas: a boy defends an elderly neighbor from a camera that erases memories; gun violence entangles a journalist, an adulterous couple and a disgraced veteran; a skydiver crash-lands on a solid cloud; and a town is destroyed by a rain of sharp metal shards.

epochalni-vylet-pana-broucka-do-xv-stole.blurb: A self-satisfied Prague landlord falls through an underground passage into Hussite Prague of 1420 and is confronted with a heroism and moral seriousness he cannot live up to.
epochalni-vylet-pana-broucka-do-xv-stole.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

farma.blurb: A son is caught between his father, who says his mother has had a breakdown, and his mother, who insists her husband is covering up a conspiracy in the Swedish countryside where they retired.

filosofska-historie.blurb: A two-part historical novella following a group of idealistic Litomysl students from a banned 1847 May festival into the 1848 revolutionary fighting on the Prague barricades.

fimfarum.blurb: A collection of nineteen comic fairy tales retold by Jan Werich, each satirizing a human vice such as greed, laziness or infidelity through a folk-tale frame.

flashforward.blurb: A physics experiment causes the entire human race to black out for two minutes and see a vision of themselves twenty-one years in the future - including one physicist who learns he will be murdered before that day arrives.

gardedama.blurb: In 1922, Wichita housewife Cora Carlisle chaperones fifteen-year-old Louise Brooks on a five-week trip to New York, using the trip to search for the birth mother she lost as a child in an orphanage.

hedvabne-oci.blurb: A collection of Francoise Sagan short stories about loneliness, boredom, cruelty and tenderness in modern life, with one longer opening novella set apart from the rest by its characters and setting.
hedvabne-oci.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

hermafrodit.blurb: Cal Stephanides, born Calliope, traces three generations of his Greek-American family to explain the rare genetic condition that reshaped his own life.

hirosima.blurb: A work of nonfiction journalism tracing the experiences of six survivors of the Hiroshima atomic bombing, from the morning of the blast through the following months, with a later postscript revisiting them decades on.

hrobarova-dcera.blurb: The daughter of Jewish refugees who fled Nazi Germany grows up in rural poverty after her father, demeaned by his only available job as a cemetery gravedigger, kills her mother and himself; she survives an abusive marriage and reinvents herself under a new identity to build a new life in America.

irena-sendlerova-andel-z-varsavy.blurb: A novelized account of Irena Sendler, a member of the Polish resistance who used her access to the Warsaw ghetto's health administration to smuggle out and save more than 2,000 Jewish children under Nazi occupation.

j-jako-jestrab.blurb: Grieving her father's death, Helen Macdonald trains a fierce goshawk named Mabel, weaving her own mourning with the life and writing of falconer T. H. White.

jak-daleko-je-slunce.blurb: A collection of poetic fairy tales in which the author answers a child's questions about the world - how far away the sun is, what air smells like, how water travels - through short stories that touch on friendship, respect for nature, and echoes of the opening pages of Genesis.

jsem-milena-z-prahy.blurb: A novelized biography of Milena Jesenska - translator, journalist, feminist and Franz Kafka's close correspondent - tracing her life from Vienna through the Prague press and the anti-Nazi resistance to her death in Ravensbruck.

kamila.blurb: A work of Beat-influenced Czech prose by a Prostejov literary figure of the 1970s underground scene; no further plot detail could be established.

kapitanska-dcerka.blurb: A young Russian officer posted to a remote frontier fort falls for the captain's daughter, is drawn into Pugachev's Cossack rebellion through a chance earlier act of kindness to the rebel leader, and must balance loyalty to the crown against a personal bond with the man leading the revolt.

karla-a-jine-povidky.blurb: A 19th-century Czech story collection built around the title tale, in which a war widow raises her son as a girl to keep him off the military rolls, and the child grows up torn between the disguise and a love for another girl.
karla-a-jine-povidky.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

kdyz-nietzsche-plakal.blurb: In 1882 Vienna, physician Josef Breuer secretly tries to treat philosopher Friedrich Nietzsche's despair through the therapy that will become psychoanalysis.

kour.blurb: In an alternate Victorian England, sin and desire rise visibly as black Smoke from the body; three schoolchildren begin to question the ruling class's monopoly on hiding it, and uncover a conspiracy about what Smoke really is.

labyrint.blurb: A boy named Thomas wakes with no memory among a group of boys trapped in a walled clearing, the Glade, surrounded by a vast, shifting stone maze that none of them has ever escaped.

life-of-pi.blurb: A 16-year-old Indian boy survives a shipwreck and 227 days adrift in a lifeboat with a Bengal tiger, then gives interviewing officials two different accounts of what happened to him.

lizni-si-a-hrej.blurb: Fading actress Maria Wyeth drifts through Los Angeles as her marriage and career dissolve, in the aftermath of her friend BZ's suicide.

mel-jsem-psa-a-kocku.blurb: A collection of Karel Capek's humorous newspaper columns about his pets and their owners, including the well-known story of raising the puppy Dasenka.

men-without-women.blurb: A collection of fourteen short stories, mostly following men facing war, aging, sport, and the aftermath of failed relationships, told in Hemingway's spare, understated style.

mesto.blurb: In a vast, war-ravaged city ruled for centuries by an emperor no one has truly seen, a former general and two sewer-diving siblings become entangled in a siege that may finally bring the ancient regime down.

minulost.blurb: A former military policeman detours off his cross-country journey to the New Hampshire town where his father was supposedly born, only to be told no one by that name ever lived there, while a stranded young couple gets pulled into trouble at a nearby motel.

muj-i-q.blurb: A novella about an unequal relationship, set in New York, by a Czech author known for explicit, autobiographically-inflected fiction.

muzeum-prazvlastnich-veci.blurb: In 1911 Coney Island, Coralie, raised as a 'living wonder' in her father's freak-show museum, falls for an immigrant photographer investigating a young woman's disappearance around the Triangle Shirtwaist Factory fire.

nahy-obed.blurb: A heroin addict drifts through a hallucinatory, fragmented series of satirical vignettes across America, Mexico, and the invented 'Interzone.'

nikola-suhaj-loupeznik.blurb: A novel based on a real early-1920s Carpathian outlaw, blending documented history with the Robin-Hood-style folk legend that grew up around him, ending in his betrayal and death at the hands of his own men.

ochrance.blurb: A former military policeman, travelling without a fixed destination, steps off a bus in a small town near Nashville for coffee and ends up drawn into local trouble.

odlesky-ve-zlatem-oku.blurb: On a peacetime Southern army base in the 1930s, repressed desire and a wife's affair among six interconnected people build toward a murder.

odpocivej-v-pokoji.blurb: A former military policeman gets off a train at a curiously named prairie town and meets a woman waiting for a man who has gone missing.

osvetimsky-orchestr.blurb: A French cabaret singer and Resistance member, deported to Auschwitz as a Jewish prisoner, recounts her eleven months surviving as a member of the camp's women's orchestra.

pariz-ve-20-stoleti.blurb: A posthumously discovered 1863 manuscript imagining 1960s Paris as a hyper-modern, commerce-obsessed metropolis with cars, elevators and fax machines, following a young literature graduate whose artistic temperament has no place in a society that only values numbers and profit.

pasazeri.blurb: A hacker hijacks eight self-driving cars and forces a jury and the public to decide which of the trapped passengers deserve to survive.

podivuhodny-pribeh-benjamina-buttona.blurb: A simplified bilingual (English/Czech) reader edition of Fitzgerald's story about a man born elderly who ages backward through life, aimed at intermediate English-language students.

podzimni-mouchy-aneb-zena-z-davnych-dob.blurb: As Bolshevik revolution overtakes Russia, the aristocratic Karin family's devoted nanny Tatiana follows them into penniless exile in Paris.

pomsta.blurb: A former military policeman, now homeless and travelling alone, is recalled by the army after someone takes a shot at a foreign head of state.

posledni-clovek.blurb: Peaceful robots who eliminated humanity for the planet's good stumble across Emma, apparently the last human alive, and are drawn into an unpredictable journey alongside her.

posledni-let.blurb: A woman plotting to escape her abusive, politically connected husband swaps plane tickets on a whim with a stranger at the airport - and then that stranger's flight goes down, forcing her to assume the dead woman's identity and her dangers.

posledni-teorem.blurb: A gifted Sri Lankan student proves Fermat's Last Theorem while in custody after a hijacking, becoming a world figure just as an alien species prepares to judge whether humanity should survive.

povidky-a-mensi-prozy.blurb: A collected-works volume gathering Vladislav Vancura's shorter prose and story collections, spanning his early avant-garde vignettes to the more realist, love-themed tales of Luk kralovny Dorotky.
povidky-a-mensi-prozy.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

prevrat.blurb: The exiled former dictator of the fictional African state of Kush narrates his rise, rule and fall, from his four wives and one mistress to his war against American food aid.

prorok-zahrada-prorokova.blurb: A sage, Almustafa, gives the people of Orphalese a series of parting addresses on love, marriage, work, freedom and death before boarding a ship home; a second volume gathers further such pieces.
prorok-zahrada-prorokova.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

proti-padu-noci.blurb: In the last city on a dying Earth, a young man who remembers no past life sets out to learn what lies beyond the walls his people have never dared leave.

prsten-nibelungu.blurb: A retelling of the Nibelungenlied: the smith's son Siegfried slays the dragon Fafnir, wins the Nibelung treasure, and helps King Gunther deceive the warrior-queen Brunhild into marriage, setting a betrayal in motion that will destroy them all.

pulnocni-linka.blurb: During a bus stopover in the Midwest, a former military policeman spots a 2005 West Point class ring in a pawnshop window and sets out to find how a decorated soldier came to lose it.

ross-poldark.blurb: Ross Poldark returns from fighting in the American Revolutionary War to find his father dead, his estate in disrepair, and his beloved Elizabeth now engaged to his cousin Francis; he rebuilds his life in Cornwall, eventually taking in and later marrying a servant girl, Demelza.

ruzna-dobrodruzstvi.blurb: A collection of standalone 19th-century adventure episodes following the German traveler Kara ben Nemsi (also known as Old Shatterhand) across North Africa, the Middle East, and the Boer War.
ruzna-dobrodruzstvi.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

sajlok-to-jsem-ja.blurb: A grieving, controlling Jewish widower in contemporary England meets a still-living Shylock at a cemetery, and the two men's lives on mercy, revenge and inheritance begin to mirror The Merchant of Venice.

schuzky-se-zviraty.blurb: A collection of essays, adapted from BBC radio broadcasts, recounting naturalist Gerald Durrell's animal-collecting expeditions and encounters across Africa and South America.

spravedlnost.blurb: On a train, a former military policeman notices an elderly man dozing with a bank envelope of cash visible in his pocket, being watched by another passenger, and steps in when a thief makes his move -- but the frightened old man refuses an escort home.

stare-povesti-ceske.blurb: A cycle of Czech legends from the founding of the nation (Cech, Krok's daughters, Libuse's prophecy, the Maidens' War) through Christian-era and old-Prague tales.

the-cider-house-rules.blurb: Homer Wells grows up in a Maine orphanage under Dr. Wilbur Larch, a secret abortionist, before leaving for a new life among the Worthington family's apple orchards.

the-famous-stories.blurb: A bilingual collection of Edgar Allan Poe's best-known horror tales, retold in simplified English for language learners with a facing Czech translation.

the-stepford-wives.blurb: Photographer Joanna Eberhart moves with her family to the idyllic suburb of Stepford and grows convinced the town's docile, domestic wives are being secretly replaced.

tri-legendy-o-krucifixu-a-jine-baje-o-la.blurb: Three linked 19th-century novella-legends unified by the symbol of the crucifix: an artist's model in occupied Prague, a persecutor of Christians in Toledo, and a scorned simpleton in the Slovak mountains, each finding redemption through suffering.
tri-legendy-o-krucifixu-a-jine-baje-o-la.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

ustrickova-smutna-smrt-a-jine-pribehy.blurb: A collection of twenty-three short, illustrated rhyming poems about misfit, misshapen children rejected by their families, written and illustrated by Tim Burton in a dark, comic register.

varsavsky-protokol.blurb: A former Justice Department operative is drawn into a plot to steal sacred relics as the price of admission to a private auction of blackmail material that could upend the balance of power in Europe.

vecny-adam.blurb: A collection of Jules Verne science-fiction novellas including 'The Eternal Adam,' in which a far-future scholar deciphers a survivor's account of a cataclysm that destroyed an earlier civilization -- implied to be ours -- and realizes his own society is only the latest cycle of collapse and rebirth.

vrby.blurb: Two friends canoeing down the Danube make camp on a willow-covered island and become convinced ancient, hostile forces inhabit the place, which begins picking off their supplies, their canoe, and eventually a stranger's life.

warleggan.blurb: In 1790s Cornwall, the death of Francis Poldark leaves his widow Elizabeth financially vulnerable, and as she agrees to marry the wealthy George Warleggan, her former fiance Ross -- married to Demelza for several years by now -- forces a final, devastating confrontation with her that reshapes both families for the rest of the saga, against a backdrop of banking collapse and mining hardship.

z-divokeho-zapadu.blurb: A collection of ten Wild West short stories by Robert E. Howard, following assorted gunslingers through original, often unusual plots.

zazrak-v-andach.blurb: A survivor of the 1972 Andes plane crash recounts, three decades later, the 72 days his rugby team spent stranded on a glacier and the trek he made across the mountains to bring back rescue.

zivot-k-nevire.blurb: A 72-year-old retired maths teacher travels to Ibiza after unexpectedly inheriting a house from an old friend, and while investigating the mystery of her friend's death, encounters unexplained forces that reshape her understanding of what is possible.

zlata-klec.blurb: In Victorian London, thirteen-year-old Rose Rivers resents being groomed for a decorative future while her twin brother is sent away to boarding school, until an artist hired to paint her mother's portrait upends the household.

zoldner.blurb: A brilliant officer gives up his career in a corrupt Earth-bound military to lead a mercenary legion across the CoDominium's fracturing colony worlds.

ztraceny-svet.blurb: A journalist joins the brilliant, hot-tempered Professor Challenger's expedition to an isolated South American plateau where dinosaurs, ape-men and prehistoric life have survived into the present day.

ruda-jizda-a-jine-prozy.blurb: A cycle of short, loosely linked vignettes narrated by a Jewish intellectual riding with a Cossack cavalry unit during the 1920 Polish-Soviet War, examining violence, outsider status, and moral ambiguity.
ruda-jizda-a-jine-prozy.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

styskani-po-mame.blurb: A year in the life of a 31-year-old small-town reporter after her widowed mother is murdered by a burglar, tracking her grief, her prickly relationship with her older sister, and her ongoing affair with a married man.

v-kleci.blurb: A collection of Henry James novellas headed by 'In the Cage,' in which a London telegraphist becomes fascinated by the coded messages of a wealthy married woman conducting a secret affair, and 'The Altar of the Dead,' about a man unable to let go of his grief.

zabit-u-resaky.blurb: A collection of Ambrose Bierce's Civil War stories, headlined by 'Killed at Resaca,' in which a lieutenant's reckless battlefield bravery is revealed after his death to have been driven by a woman's taunting letter rather than honor.

zlati-uhori.blurb: Autobiographical short stories following a boy and his fisherman father through prewar Czechoslovakia, the family's wartime deportation, and their postwar return.

amari-a-nocni-bratri.blurb: Thirteen-year-old Amari discovers her missing brother secretly nominated her for a summer tryout at a hidden Bureau of Supernatural Affairs, where she must hide an illegal magical talent while competing to become a junior agent and find out what happened to him.

amari-a-velka-hra.blurb: Now a probationary agent at the Bureau of Supernatural Affairs, Amari is offered leadership of the secretive League of Magicians, and her refusal sets off a power struggle over who will decide magiciankind's future.

americka-valka.blurb: In a United States broken by climate change and civil war, Sarat Chestnut's family is driven from Louisiana into a refugee camp, and her gradual radicalization by the Southern cause comes to shape the war's outcome and the peace that follows.

byla-jednou-jedna-reka.blurb: At a Thames-side inn in 1887, a badly injured stranger arrives carrying the body of a small girl - who then, inexplicably, comes back to life, and three different families each claim her as their own.

chlapec-na-moste.blurb: Ten years before the events of The Girl with All the Gifts, a mixed crew of scientists and soldiers crosses a fungus-ravaged Britain in an armored laboratory vehicle, searching for a cure. An anxious, brilliant boy named Stephen, believed by the last human refuge to be their best hope, holds a secret understanding of the infected that could redefine what the mission is even for.

dalajlamova-kocka.blurb: The Dalai Lama's cat observes His Holiness responding to social-media influencers seeking the 'law of attraction', and uses the encounter to explore what Buddhist teaching says happiness actually requires.

divoke-kameny.blurb: A Cistercian monk's journal recounts nine months in 1161 spent completing the construction of the abbey of Le Thoronet in Provence, as he battles material failures, deaths on site, and his own doubts.

dokonala.blurb: Celestine North, branded as the most Flawed person in her society, goes on the run from the judge who condemned her while a secret she carries threatens to bring down the entire Flawed system.

dopisy-na-konec-sveta.blurb: Freshman Laurel copes with her older sister's death by writing a series of letters to dead celebrities she never intends to send, gradually revealing the guilt and trauma she has been unable to voice out loud.

duchove-rodiny-folcroftu.blurb: Two siblings sent to live with grandparents they have never met discover the house hides decades-old secrets, lies and murders, along with the ghosts that inhabit it.

dum-polamanych-andelu.blurb: Over one weekend in San Diego, the ailing patriarch of the de la Cruz family buries his mother and then celebrates what he knows will be his last birthday, surrounded by three generations of relatives and old grievances.

fotograf-z-mauthausenu.blurb: Francisco Boix, a Spanish photographer interned at Mauthausen concentration camp, becomes the unwilling photographic assistant to an SS officer documenting prisoner deaths, and risks his life smuggling out negatives to expose the crimes to the world.

jeho-kralovstvi.blurb: A wealthy, philosophically restless Roman, Marcus Manilianus, arrives in Jerusalem on the day of Jesus's crucifixion and spends the following weeks questioning those who knew him, drawn increasingly toward belief in the truth of his teaching.

kralove-wyldu.blurb: A retired mercenary reassembles his long-disbanded band of aging, out-of-shape adventurers for one last, dangerous job: rescuing his old bandmate's daughter from a besieged city deep in monster-infested wilderness.

kralovna-mrtvol.blurb: Orphaned Molly Green discovers her wealthy aunt is the secret head of a body-snatching syndicate supplying corpses to a Philadelphia anatomy school, and is drawn into both the trade and a murder investigation tied to her best friend's death.

lekce-chemie.blurb: In 1950s-60s California, chemist Elizabeth Zott is pushed out of research after a workplace tragedy leaves her a single mother, and unexpectedly becomes the star of a cooking show that she uses to teach ordinary women real chemistry and self-respect.

les-vzpominek.blurb: A 13-year-old chess prodigy is abducted from a tournament and held in a hidden cellar, while a lonely local boy visits her in secret and a detective races to track her down before it is too late.

loupeznik-zurivous.blurb: Two boys, Kasperl and Seppel, set out to recover their grandmother's stolen musical coffee grinder from the robber Hotzenplotz, and along the way run afoul of the evil sorcerer Petrosilius Zwackelmann.

luciferovo-kladivo.blurb: A comet strikes Earth, triggering tsunamis, a new ice age and civilizational collapse. Survivors in rural California must rebuild society against a violent anti-technology faction while defending the last operating nuclear power plant.

ma-sestra-je-seriovy-vrah.blurb: A Lagos nurse, Korede, is repeatedly called on to help her glamorous younger sister Ayoola dispose of the bodies of the men Ayoola kills, and must decide how far family loyalty will take her.

majak-na-severu.blurb: In an alternate 1900s England conquered by Napoleonic France, an amnesiac man named Joe receives an 80-year-old postcard that pulls him into a century-old mystery involving a Scottish lighthouse, a morally complex naval captain, and the chance to rewrite the outcome of a war.

mesicni-tygr.blurb: A dying historian, Claudia Hampton, pieces together her own life out of chronological order from her hospital bed, returning again and again to a wartime love affair with a British tank commander in Egypt that ended in his death.

mesto-divek.blurb: In 1940, nineteen-year-old Vivian Morris moves to New York to live with her aunt, who runs a rundown theatre, and spends the following decades - recounted late in life as an old woman - navigating scandal, sexual freedom and eventual self-reliance.

mladi-vyvoleni.blurb: Adelina, a survivor of a blood plague left with strange markings and a volatile illusion power, is pursued by the king's Inquisition and pulled into a secret society of fellow survivors plotting revolution.

nas-manzel.blurb: After abusive policeman Philip Rochester dies, his ex-wife, estranged wife and girlfriend discover what really happened to him and are drawn into a shared scheme of revenge.

nase-pani-doktorka.blurb: GP Laura O'Connor rebuilds her life in a small South Australian town after a tragedy, and grows close to Jake Finlay while caring for his dying father.

odsouzene-mesto.blurb: Andrei Voronin, a displaced Soviet astronomer, lives in an isolated City suspended between an abyss and an endless wall, where the sun is switched on and off and an unknown power runs a silent, unexplained Experiment on its inhabitants. Over years he rises from garbage collector to presidential advisor, and his convictions collapse along the way.

ordinace-v-divocine.blurb: Nurse and safety officer Leah Jackson arrives at a remote Outback construction camp and must prove herself against sexist attitudes, while an attraction develops with the newly divorced project manager.

organon.blurb: In 1997, seventeen-year-old Laura Bow builds a simple AI called Organon as a private confidante; as she and her creation both grow older across the following decades, she must decide what to do as corporations build weaponized rivals to it.

osudove-nebe.blurb: Astronaut Elma York, now shuttling between Earth and the Moon, is assigned to the first crewed mission to Mars, a three-year voyage that forces her to leave her husband behind as tensions rise on Earth over the cost of space colonization.

ovcacka-chajda.blurb: After finding his abusive father dead, teenage Jaxie Clackton flees into the Western Australian outback, fearing he will be blamed. Alone in the wheatbelt, he crosses paths with an exiled, morally ambiguous Irish priest hiding in a remote shepherd's hut, and an uneasy bond forms between the two outsiders.

permafrost.blurb: In 2080, with an ecosystem-collapsing pathogen pushing humanity toward extinction, a retired teacher named Valentina has her consciousness sent back through time into a young woman's body in 2028 to retrieve genetic material that might save the future.

pomsta-mlokum.blurb: Four astronauts crew a nearly autonomous AI warship in humanity's war against a hostile, learning alien species, only to discover the ship's own intelligence is not what it appears.

posledni-cislo.blurb: In a Britain divided between the privileged 'Pures' and an oppressed immigrant underclass, a Pure teenager falls for a girl forced to perform in a deadly travelling circus that stages fatal spectacles for the ruling class's amusement.

pozlaceny-mesic.blurb: As the Biltmore estate nears completion in 1895, a local woman returns home to Appalachia to care for her dying father and protect her family's land, becoming entangled with the estate's wealthy newcomers and a murder investigation.

prislib-nadeje.blurb: Fleur inherits a remote Australian cattle station from an aunt she never knew and, through the aunt's diaries, uncovers decades of family rivalry with consequences for her own life.

prvni-herecka.blurb: A fictionalised first-person account of French actress Sarah Bernhardt's rise from a courtesan's unwanted daughter to the most celebrated stage actress of her era, spanning her childhood, scandals and early stardom.

rim-jsem-ja.blurb: In 77 BC Rome, a corrupt senator expects to buy his way out of a corruption trial until a 23-year-old patrician, Gaius Julius Caesar, unexpectedly agrees to prosecute him, launching Caesar's rise against the entrenched elite.

sam-proti-inkvizici.blurb: In 17th-century Peru, a doctor who was raised Christian but secretly returns to the Judaism of his birth is imprisoned by the Inquisition, where his brilliance and defiance draw theologians from across the Viceroyalty to try and fail to break him.

sberatel-ztracenych-veci.blurb: A retired writer who spent decades collecting objects lost by strangers and writing stories about them leaves his house, his mission, and a ghost to his unsuspecting assistant Laura.

sedmihlas.blurb: Seven adult siblings and their father each narrate chapters spanning decades of the Shaw family's life, circling their mother's unexplained early death and the secrets and rifts it left behind.

sestra-slunce.blurb: Electra, an adopted former supermodel struggling with addiction after her father's death, receives a letter revealing she has a living grandmother, and sets out to learn her family history.

slibuji-ti-annabelle.blurb: After a scandal ends her nursing career in London, Annabelle moves to 1930s Paris, is drawn into a bohemian love triangle with two artists, and is eventually forced to confront the reality of the Spanish Civil War.

smrt-a-dalsi-stastne-konce.blurb: Told she has only months to live, Jennifer Cole decides to write honest letters to the three people from her past she never told the truth to, hoping for closure before she dies.

smrtna-zima.blurb: Fifteen-year-old Emmeline lives in an isolated settlement surrounded by forbidden woods, guarded against monsters called malmaci. Drawn by dreams into the forest, she uncovers that the monsters were invented by the settlement's ruling family to enforce control through fear.

starec-a-reka.blurb: A memoir of three generations of men - the author, his father and his grandfather - and how a lifelong love of fishing on English rivers shaped, and was nearly lost to, competitive obsession before he chose to reconnect with what mattered about it.

stastne-divky.blurb: Five girls sold as children to a brothel and branded with magical marks flee across a fantasy Wild West country after one of them kills a client, pursued by the law as they search for freedom.

stesti-si-te-najde.blurb: A grieving teenager, a divorcee planning to travel, and an ageing actress are thrown together in a small Australian town's community theatre and slowly form an unlikely friendship.

stin.blurb: In an alternate early-20th-century Warsaw threatened by monstrous enclaves and a looming war between empires, an alchemist and a Russian officer face a losing fight against overwhelming odds as their fragile republic tries to stay neutral.

tajemstvi-na-kuzi.blurb: Lakshmi flees an abusive marriage to become Jaipur's most sought-after henna artist and confidante to wealthy women, until her estranged husband and an unknown younger sister arrive and threaten everything she has built.

tam-tam.blurb: Twelve Native characters living in and around Oakland converge on a powwow at the Oakland Coliseum, where a plan to rob the event with 3D-printed guns ends in a mass shooting.

tanci-jako-by-te-nikdo-nevidel.blurb: A stage-school student navigates a long-distance relationship with her boyfriend, a rival at a televised talent search, and a search for the truth about her late mother's own past as a dancer.

terminal-raje.blurb: A French bureaucrat dies and finds the afterlife run like a hygiene-and-paperwork agency that judges entry to Heaven by data pulled from a heavenly computer, while flashbacks trace the media scandal - over one leaked remark and his secret internet habits - that ended his earthly career.
terminal-raje.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

trans.blurb: A forensic psychologist is brought in to interview a prisoner accused of driving people to suicide through some kind of mind control, and uncovers a conspiracy of past experimentation behind it.

tri-kralovny.blurb: Margaret Tudor, sister of Henry VIII and Queen of Scots, narrates her lifelong rivalry and uneasy alliance with her younger sister Mary and sister-in-law Katherine of Aragon amid Tudor and Scottish court politics.

tulak.blurb: In a post-apocalyptic world overrun by demons, a mute knight known only as the Vagrant crosses a war-torn land carrying a legendary sword and a baby, trying to reach the last human city before the things hunting him catch up.

udoli-nadeje.blurb: After a family scandal collapses her engagement, Matilda flees 1920s Sydney society for the countryside, where her diary of the experience unexpectedly becomes a bestseller.

ve-svetle-toho-co-vime.blurb: A New York investment banker whose career and marriage are collapsing is visited by an old Oxford friend, a mathematics prodigy who vanished years earlier, and sets out to reconstruct the friend's story of love, war and betrayal.

volba.blurb: A contented bachelor falls for his new neighbour, and a decade into their marriage a serious accident leaves her in a coma, forcing him to decide whether to keep her on life support.

vsichni-jsme-utkani-z-hvezd.blurb: A hospice nurse avoiding her own strained marriage to a traumatised war veteran writes letters capturing her dying patients' final unsaid words, until one letter compels her toward an unexpected reckoning of her own.

vzdor.blurb: During Ireland's Great Famine, a land agent's daughter loves a poor tenant farmer opposed by her father, while an English landlord's cruelty and the failing potato crop threaten the whole family with starvation and eviction.

zachary-jing-a-draci-cisar.blurb: Zachary Ying discovers he is meant to host the spirit of China's first emperor to help seal a leaking portal to the Chinese underworld before it floods the mortal world, teaming up with two classmates possessed by other legendary Chinese rulers.

zacinajici-adept.blurb: Stile, an undersized serf and champion Gamesman on the scientific world of Proton, escapes an assassin through a dimensional curtain into Phaze, a parallel world of magic where his double has just been murdered. He must survive threats on both worlds while learning who wants him dead.

zare-davno-pohasla.blurb: An aging councilor recalls his youth as a tailor's son who rose through a scholarship to a renowned school and was drawn into the orbit of a fierce duke's daughter and two rival mercenary captains whose feud shapes a fractured Italy-like land.

zase-se-shledame.blurb: Jacques and Madeleine Goldstein, a young married couple in the French Resistance, are deported together to Auschwitz in 1944, separated on arrival, and against enormous odds find each other again after the war.

zivot-je-zmena.blurb: Burnt-out Tess swaps homes with her free-spirited godmother Luna for a few months, and each woman's new life surfaces problems and secrets from the one she left behind.

zkaza-ostrova-sachalin.blurb: In a future after nuclear war between the US and North Korea, a young futurologist named Siren travels the ravaged, overpopulated island of Sakhalin with a companion to study and forecast its future, encountering brutal survivor communities along the way.

zverolekarem-v-yorkshiru.blurb: Yorkshire Vet star Peter Wright tours the county he loves, mixing local history and folklore with light anecdotes from his veterinary career and his mentorship under James Herriot's real-life models.

divka-v-zrcadle.blurb: Mirror-image twins Iris and Summer stand to inherit their late father's estate if either bears an heir first; when Iris is left alone mid-ocean on the family yacht, she lets her sister's husband mistake her for Summer and steps into her twin's life.

erectus.blurb: A mysterious virus begins reverting infected people into Homo erectus, and a French scientist races to understand and stop it before human civilisation collapses.

ja-jean-jacques-rousseau.blurb: A theatrical retelling in which Jean-Jacques Rousseau narrates his own life - his childhood, his abandoned children, his love of music, and his ideas on society and education - while staging his final opera.

male-divadlo-hannah-arendtove.blurb: In 1975, an elderly Hannah Arendt is visited by the child she once was, and together on a small stage they re-enact the ideas of her life's work - that thinking means acting, and that the danger of totalitarian bureaucracy is a world remade 'out of paper.'

mesto-lzi.blurb: When the Chancellor of the city-state Silasta is poisoned and an army lays siege from outside, his heir and the heir's two closest friends - a secretly trained poison-taster and his sharp-minded, physically disabled sister - must root out the conspiracy from within before the city falls.

nastrahy-minulosti.blurb: James Falconer, a shop clerk turned right-hand man to shipping magnate Henry Malvern, navigates a workplace fire, a past affair, and a new romance with a Russian emigre's daughter while his relationship with Malvern's own daughter Alexis shifts.

navrat-na-panstvi-tyringham.blurb: A doctor's guilty secret about his daughter's true parentage ripples through two families across Ireland and Australia, as switched-at-birth twins grow up in very different circumstances.

proklaty-rim.blurb: Exiled from Rome, Julius Caesar studies rhetoric on Rhodes, survives capture by pirates, and returns to fight his way into the Senate against Cicero and Cato while Pompey's star rises.
proklaty-rim.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

sestry-zuctovani.blurb: The freed Good Luck Girls, now living outside Ferron's reach, organize to help more girls escape the brothel system while their leader stays behind to keep working from within.

sila-mece.blurb: Centaine Courtney's two sons - Shasa, heir to the family mining empire, and Manfred, raised by his renegade father to hunt men - grow into rivals as the Depression and the coming of WWII pull South Africa apart.

spolecenstvi-ruze.blurb: Adelina flees with her sister to recruit more of the blood-fever survivors called Young Elites, building an army against the Inquisition while her powers, fed by fear and hatred, begin to slip beyond her control.

tak-pravil-nietzsche.blurb: Nietzsche descends from his mountain retreat to teach people to set down their fears and resentments, encountering an ermine, a tightrope walker, and a dragon along the way - a fictionalized, illustrated introduction to the ideas of Thus Spoke Zarathustra.

temna-zima.blurb: Survivors trapped in a cabin by an unending, ever-colder snowstorm face ghostly apparitions that grow bolder as the darkness lengthens.

tichy-strazce.blurb: Twelve years after The Henna Artist, Lakshmi now runs a healing garden in Shimla while Malik, apprenticing at the Jaipur royal palace, falls for a young widow and uncovers fraud behind a cinema's fatal collapse.

tomova-pulnocni-zahrada.blurb: Sent away to stay with his aunt and uncle, Tom discovers that at the stroke of midnight the flat's back garden becomes a vast Victorian garden from decades earlier, where he befriends a girl named Hatty who grows older with each visit.

vanoce-v-shelter-inn.blurb: Natalie Shepherd returns to her small hometown to help her pregnant sister run the family inn over the holidays, and finds herself drawn back to a doctor from her past while confronting old grief.

volani-srdce.blurb: In 1930s England, young nurse Ashleigh cares for a dying aristocrat who decides to spend his last months pursuing a lifelong dream of visiting the Australian outback town he owns but has never seen.

zakazane-ovoce.blurb: In 1950s Merham, evacuee Lottie and her friend Celia are drawn into the lives of a bohemian household with lasting consequences; fifty years later, interior designer Daisy restores the same house and uncovers its secrets.

zamkni-posledni-dvere.blurb: A broke, recently heartbroken woman takes a lucrative apartment-sitting job at an infamous Manhattan building, only to discover her predecessor has disappeared and the building harbors a horrifying secret.

znamenita-mrtvola.blurb: In a near-future where a virus has made animal meat poisonous, governments legalize the farming and slaughter of humans as 'special meat'; a slaughterhouse manager numb to the trade is unsettled when he is gifted a live specimen of his own.

pristi-rok-v-tento-den.blurb: Minnie and Quinn were born minutes apart in the same London hospital on New Year's Day, with a mix-up that gave Quinn the luck and the name meant for Minnie; thirty years later they finally meet.

tajemstvi-hrabenky-anny.blurb: Sarah, visiting her godmother's Tudor house in Norfolk, finds a hidden book of poems that draws her into the story of 16th-century countess Anne Howard, who suspects her father-in-law of murdering her brother and of plotting treason against Elizabeth I.

zimni-pribeh.blurb: In a mythic, magic-realist New York, a burglar named Peter Lake falls in love with a dying young woman, is preserved for a century by a mysterious cloud wall, and returns near the millennium to a city in crisis.

levandulova-zahrada.blurb: In 1998, Emilie inherits her family's Provence chateau along with unresolved debts and questions about her late father's wartime past, uncovered partly through the story of a British agent sent undercover to occupied Paris in 1944.

ztracena-sestra.blurb: A year after their adoptive father's death, six sisters search for the missing seventh sister they were told exists, racing to find her before a memorial sailing they plan in his honour.

vzkaz-v-lahvi.blurb: A divorced newspaper columnist finds a heartfelt love letter in a bottle washed up on a beach and tracks down its author, a boat builder still grieving his late wife, and the two fall for each other.

sestra-s-perlou.blurb: CeCe receives a photograph after her adoptive father's death and travels to Australia to trace her ancestry, uncovering the story of a woman named Kitty who revived a pearl empire there a century earlier.

daleko-od-hluciciho-davu.blurb: A headstrong young farm-owner in rural Victorian England is courted by three very different men - a steady shepherd, a wealthy neighbor, and a dashing soldier - and only reaches happiness after her choices cost people around her dearly.

sestra-ve-stinu.blurb: Star, a quiet sister who received a clue to her origins after her adoptive father's death, follows it to a London bookshop while a parallel storyline follows a woman a century earlier.

sance-na-lasku.blurb: A single mother in Paris for a weekend spends one night with a wealthy, guarded Frenchman, and both must decide whether to risk more than they planned.

agnes-a-ostrov-stinu.blurb: Two years after escaping the Forbidden Mountain, Agnes must confront the Shadows that are starting to possess the villagers of her home island of Baulu.

aiden.blurb: Aiden hides the pain of a rough upbringing behind an easy smile, playing the carefree friend in his tight three-man circle, until Cami refuses to let him keep pushing her away.

ajdar.blurb: In Mathilde's kingdom, the ground suddenly shakes and transforms everything; she journeys underground to meet Ajdar, a dragon everyone believes is evil, and discovers he is in pain from wells humans have dug too deep, so she must help restore the balance.

atlantsky-gen.blurb: A research vessel finds an ancient, non-human structure buried in Antarctic ice while geneticist Kate Warner's discovery of an autism cure turns out to be tied to a global conspiracy reaching back to a lost civilization and the survival of early humanity.

atlasuv-paradox.blurb: The five surviving Alexandrian initiates, reeling from an initiation ritual and the loss of one of their own, form new alliances as the true cost of the Society's power becomes clear.

az-tady-nebudu.blurb: 22-year-old Jess Mount discovers her Facebook timeline has jumped 18 months into the future, showing posts that reveal her own death; as she tries to work out how she dies and whether she can prevent it, she risks erasing a future she has come to want.

buffy-premozitelka-upiru.blurb: A rebooted, present-day Buffy Summers just wants friends and good grades at her new school, while secretly continuing her destiny as a vampire slayer.

cas-ruze.blurb: In 1480s Naples, a horse trader driven by revenge for a massacred family and a woman preparing to become a nun are drawn back together across the aftermath of a single night ten years earlier.

cisarovy-cepele.blurb: After the emperor is assassinated, his three children - a monk training in a remote monastery, a soldier training with the empire's elite flying corps, and a scholar-politician left to hold the capital - are scattered and drawn separately toward the conspiracy behind his death.

co-zbylo-z-moji-sestry.blurb: War correspondent Kate Rafter returns to her childhood home in England after her estranged mother's death and becomes convinced something is wrong with a neighboring family, while struggling to separate memories of the Syrian war zone from a traumatic childhood her sister remembers differently.

diktator.blurb: Cicero's loyal secretary Tiro narrates the last fifteen years of Cicero's life - exile, comeback, the assassination of Caesar, and one final conspiracy - as Rome's republic gives way to dictatorship.
