divka-na-utesu.blurb: Grieving sculptor Grania Ryan meets a mysterious eight-year-old girl on the Irish coast and, through a trove of family letters from 1914, uncovers a century-old entanglement between her family and the girl's aristocratic one, spanning wartime London and present-day New York.

dnesek-neni-naposled.blurb: Tom Barren lives in the retro-futuristic 2016 people once imagined, until a reckless act with a time machine collapses it into our own ordinary 2016 - except the woman he loved is alive there, and he must decide whether to undo what he broke.

einstein.blurb: A curious mouse arrives a day late for the great cheese fair and sets out to build a machine that can turn back time, guided by the notes of a young Albert Einstein it meets after overshooting its target by nearly 80 years.

epos-okridleny-ohen.blurb: The sorcerer Malvel has cursed Epos, the flame bird most feared of all Avantia's beasts, who has woken a volcano that threatens to bury a whole town in lava; Tom must confront him at the crater's edge.

existence.blurb: An orbital garbage collector retrieves an unmapped crystalline object that turns out to be an alien contact device, setting off a sprawling multi-POV story about first contact, media, class and humanity's future.

ferno-ohnivy-drak.blurb: Tom, an ordinary village boy armed with a magic sword and shield, must free Avantia from Ferno the Fire Dragon, the first of six beasts enchanted by the evil wizard Malvel and now burning crops and villages.

gerta.blurb: After a monstrous creature kills her parents, Gerta secretly enters an all-male warrior initiation trial, determined that no one else feel the pain she has.

haremy-kouzla-zbavene.blurb: Three educated women confined in a Constantinople harem correspond with a famous French novelist, and one falls for him; he visits them in secret and promises to write a book exposing their confinement, while the novel tracks their doomed longing for a freedom their society denies them.

hodina-hromu.blurb: In 1899 Olomouc, a rational young teacher hides a family curse and has sworn never to fall in love, until a mysterious man who risks everything to help others enters her life.

hvezdonauti.blurb: The crew of the starship Nadeje, each paired with a personal robot, searches for a habitable planet for humanity while coping with hibernation, contact with a lunar base, and attacks from hostile 'bubble' raiders.

kavky.blurb: As the Allies prepare to invade Normandy, SOE agent Flick Clairet assembles a team of women to infiltrate and destroy a German telephone exchange under Nazi guard.

kralovna-tearlingu.blurb: Exiled princess Kelsea Raleigh Glynn returns to claim the throne of the Tearling, protected by a jewel of great power, as a sorceress queen threatens to destroy what remains of her kingdom.

kroniky-svetakraje.blurb: Raised by trolls in the perilous Deepwoods, a young outsider named Snitch sets out to learn who his real parents were, encountering strange creatures and dangers on the way.

legendarni-kralovstvi.blurb: A solo/party gamebook campaign set in a desert land of tyrant kings and ancient ruins, where the reader's choices and skill checks drive a branching, open-ended story.

leva-ruka-bozi.blurb: Cale is one of thousands of boys seized as children by the fanatical Redeemers and raised in total isolation for war against their heretical enemies. One of the order's most powerful leaders has unusual plans for the unusually capable, guarded fourteen-year-old.

liska.blurb: A teenage hacker with Asperger's who breached the Pentagon, NSA and CIA is weaponized by British intelligence and thrown into a lethal cat-and-mouse pursuit with Russian operatives.

mor.blurb: When rats begin dying by the thousands in the Algerian city of Oran, a plague quarantine seals off the population, and Dr Bernard Rieux organizes the fight against it while cut off from his own sick wife.

muz-ktery-pozoroval-nebe.blurb: In northern Chile, a young street painter and a traffic-light performer befriend an old man who stares at the sky every day, and accompany him on a journey into the desert where a tragic past and the true reason for his pilgrimage are revealed.

mysi-hlidka.blurb: Three members of the Mouse Guard set out to find a missing grain merchant and uncover a conspiracy threatening the mouse territories they protect.

na-veky-veku.blurb: In 14th-century Kingsbridge, four children who witness a violent act grow into adulthood over decades marked by rival monasteries, a builder's ambition, and the arrival of the Black Death.

nanook-ledovy-netvor.blurb: Tom, son of Taladon, must face Nanook, the ice monster of Avantia's frozen mountain plains, another of the six beasts Malvel has enchanted and driven wild against the kingdom.

nikdo-neni-ostrov.blurb: Hollywood star Sylvia Moran confesses to killing a former co-star and possible father of her disabled daughter; her devoted companion Philip Kaven narrates the confession that explains how a seemingly perfect life concealed deep fractures, including society's treatment of the mentally disabled.

o-cem-reka-vi.blurb: After her archaeologist parents vanish in Egypt, a Buenos Aires socialite travels to Cairo to find out what happened, guided by a magical ring that channels visions of Cleopatra and a rivalry-turned-romance with her guardian's associate.

osiach.blurb: A modern woman with a rational, Kafka-tinged outlook is betrayed by her lover and finds herself moving between the present day and the year 1463, encountering real historical figures.

ostrov-zasveceni.blurb: Eleven-year-old Hanka, who lives in a children's home, discovers with her friends Svata and Rafan a hidden magical world where ordinary people live alongside wizards, unicorns, dragons and other creatures.

osvetim.blurb: A history of the town of Auschwitz across seven centuries, tracing how a former medieval trading town became the site of the Nazi camp complex, drawing on architectural plans, archives and survivor oral histories.

otrokyne-citu.blurb: A Psy who must hide the emotions her repressive society forbids is drawn into an uneasy alliance with a changeling pack alpha hunting the killer of one of his own.

pan-cavendish-jestli-se-nemylim.blurb: Amelia Willoughby has been engaged to the Duke of Wyndham since she was six months old, but when a man with a rival claim to the title appears, she finds herself drawn to him instead - the same story as its companion novel, told from Amelia and Thomas's side.

pet-prani-pana-murrayho-mcbridea.blurb: A lonely, century-old former baseball player who has outlived almost everyone he loves finds new purpose helping a ten-year-old boy with a terminal heart condition complete a short list of wishes before he dies.

podivuhodna-roboti-expedice.blurb: Long after humanity's extinction, two robot explorers, William and Meriwether, set out across the former United States to map resources and puzzle out, often comically wrong, what the vanished human civilization was for.

predtuchy-smyslnosti.blurb: An F-Psy whose precognitive gift is starting to show her both violent death and forbidden desire finds herself drawn to a changeling sentinel, even as a powerful Psy councilor moves to exploit her sight.

prozretelnost-ohne.blurb: After uncovering her father's assassin, Adare flees the palace and searches for allies against the coup that toppled her family, gathering followers who believe the sun goddess Intarra has touched her.

runy.blurb: Two orphaned children, Chiri and Daj, wander into the fantastical realm of Pisingr, where they must contend with the shapeshifting Shadow King and his mechanical minions.

sepron-morsky-plaz.blurb: Second of six enchanted beasts: the blacksmith's apprentice Tom must face Sepron the sea serpent, one of the monsters the sorcerer Malvel has turned against the kingdom of Avantia, which prophecy says only Tom can free.

skandar-a-zlodej-jednorozcu.blurb: Thirteen-year-old Skandar Smith is unexpectedly drawn into the secretive Island's world of wild, deadly unicorns just as a mysterious villain steals the world's most powerful unicorn.

stezka-v-troskach.blurb: In August 1945, an Italian ex-soldier making his way home through ruined Germany takes in an orphaned boy and finds shelter in a cabin, where a former German soldier, a traumatized couple, and a woman's secret past converge.

svezest-vody.blurb: In Georgia just after the Civil War, landowner George Walker hires two newly freed brothers, Prentiss and Landry, to work his farm, while his son Caleb returns from the war concealing a forbidden relationship with a fellow soldier; when the brothers are endangered by the town's prejudice, George's choice to protect them turns violent.

tagus-kentaur.blurb: Tagus, once a protective half-horse half-man guardian of Avantia's herds, has been driven wild by Malvel's curse and now burns fields and slaughters livestock; Tom, a blacksmith's apprentice, must stop him.

temna-ukolebavka.blurb: In a Britain where natural births ended two decades ago, Kit and Thomas fight to keep their daughter after small parenting mistakes draw the attention of the state agency empowered to take children from unfit parents.

the-house-in-the-cerulean-sea.blurb: Linus Baker, a caseworker for the Department in Charge of Magical Youth, is sent to a remote island orphanage to determine whether six unusual children - including one prophesied to end the world - are a danger, and finds himself unable to leave unchanged.

titani.blurb: Fraternal twins Samantha and Nathan, separated at birth in 1880s Texas and raised apart, are drawn back together as adults amid the Fort Worth oil boom, uncovering the family secrets and rivalries that once tore them apart.

tlukot-kridel-smrti.blurb: Since learning his brutal training was meant to bring about humanity's destruction, Cale has been pursued by Bosco, the Redeemer leader who made him the Angel of Death. As the reckoning nears, Cale's thirst for revenge draws him back to the sanctuary and toward the man he hates most.

tlumocnice.blurb: London court interpreter Revelle Lee alters a defendant's testimony to try to secure what she believes is the right verdict, then finds her deception discovered by someone with their own reasons to want revenge.

to-byl-nas-dum.blurb: A young couple flipping a remote house is overrun by a family who claim to have once lived there, and as objects move and a child goes missing, the boundary between haunting and delusion collapses along with the couple's grip on what is real.

utociste.blurb: Having fled her old life to protect the people she loves, Sara struggles to earn her place among the Mohiri and control her changing powers while a vengeful vampire lord searches for her.

vyhnani-gerty-schnirch.blurb: In the final days of WWII, Brno German Gerta Schnirch is expelled toward Vienna with other ethnic Germans; the forced march stops in southern Moravia, and she goes on to live through the following decades of Czechoslovak history.
vyhnani-gerty-schnirch.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

vyprava-za-diamantovym-mecem.blurb: When zombies attack his village and turn the blacksmith, Minecraft farmer Steve sets out to mine forty diamonds to craft a sword and protect his friends.

vypujceny-cas.blurb: Sofie Adlerova wakes after more than 160 years in cryogenic stasis to find her old life and identity gone, and becomes the unwilling test subject of a corporation pushing its research into human-like bioroids.

western-lane.blurb: After her mother's death, eleven-year-old Gopi throws herself into squash training under her father's intensifying coaching, drifting from her two older sisters as the sport becomes her only real connection to him and to herself.

wynd.blurb: In a city where any trace of magical heritage is a death sentence, a boy hiding a magical secret flees with his friends after his secret is discovered, into a wider fantasy world of royal conspiracy.

zelezny-vlk.blurb: Nineteen-year-old Juva despises the revered but, in her view, fraudulent seer caste she was raised in, and has sworn never to become one of them.

zeme-tech-druhych.blurb: Alsatian Mathilde follows her Moroccan husband Amine, a former French-army veteran, to his family farm near Meknes after WWII, as the couple and their mixed-race daughter navigate colonial segregation through a decade that ends in Morocco's push for independence.

zimni-vcely.blurb: In the Eifel region in 1944-45, Latin teacher and beekeeper Egidius Arimond keeps a diary of his failing health, his affairs, and his dangerous work smuggling Jews across the Belgian border hidden in his beehives.

zlodej.blurb: The Black Dagger Brotherhood, now allied with the Band of Bastards, presses its war against the Lessening Society while the traitor Throe uses an ancient book to raise a new army against them.

zoldneri.blurb: In the mid-23rd century, after the corporate wars over the solar system have ended, a squad of elite mercenaries is sent on a secret mission to seize a hidden scientific-industrial base on Pluto, without knowing at first who -- or what -- they are really up against.

zpevozar.blurb: In a persecuted-minority dystopia, a village girl with a forbidden telepathic 'songlight' ability and a government official's daughter are drawn together across a war against those the state calls 'unhuman'.

zverolekar-a-spol.blurb: Veterinarian Luke Gamble recounts anecdotes from his early career at a Dorset mixed practice, covering farm-animal work, the 2001 foot-and-mouth outbreak, and his courtship of a fellow vet, with names and details altered from the real events.

besnici-priboj.blurb: Now an MP splitting his time between Cornwall and London, Ross Poldark is drawn back into collision with his rival George Warleggan over the child Elizabeth is carrying, while Demelza becomes the target of a cruel wager at a London party and the couple works to repair their own marriage.

ctyri-posledni-veci.blurb: After betraying the Redeemers and returning to them, Cale is told by the order's leader that mankind must be destroyed to correct God's greatest mistake. He outwardly makes peace with his role as the angel of death, wielding both religious fervor and the Redeemers' military might.

devet-dni.blurb: Elite soldier Lee Parker is sent to capture and deliver the rebel Sera to the Citadel alive, but when their escape from a killing storm strands them together in the wilderness for nine days, both are changed by it.

devet-noci.blurb: With the immediate threat past, Sera and Lee try to build the lives they dreamed of, but the Citadel's dictatorship grows harsher and an energy-starved Blok drifts toward the same brutal tactics as its enemies.

ember-a-buraceni-draku.blurb: After saving a strange magical creature, young Ember Spark becomes an apprentice vet to magical beasts and must race to save a baby dragon before a scheming villain exposes the secret magical world.

ember-a-snezny-fenix.blurb: Ember and Arno follow a baby frost phoenix north to the Arctic and discover that the migrating neverwhales are in danger, with their old enemy once again on their trail.

grandhotel-schwarzenberg.blurb: In 1928, Anna Schwarzenberg has rebuilt her life after earlier hardship, but her son Karl's dream of building a mountain hotel and his choice of fiancee divide the family just as the Nazis begin tightening their grip on public life.

jeremy-poldark.blurb: Grieving the death of his infant daughter, Ross Poldark stands trial for inciting impoverished locals to loot a shipwreck, while Demelza works to save both her husband and their strained marriage; the book ends with the birth of their son Jeremy.

jmena.blurb: In 1987, Cora goes to register her newborn son's name while dreading her abusive husband Gordon's insistence the boy be named after him; three parallel versions of the next 35 years unfold from the single choice she makes that day.

kroniky-nezmapovanych-kralovstvi.blurb: Squabbling twins Fox and Fibber are swept into the magical kingdom of Jungledrop, where they must find the legendary Forever Fern before the power-hungry harpy Morg destroys both worlds.

ledova-kolebka.blurb: On the world of Urth, four unlikely companions race across a frozen wasteland to find the lost capital of a vanished civilization before the falling moon destroys everyone.

nezdolna.blurb: Sara Grey has spent ten years since her father's murder hiding a growing supernatural power from everyone she loves, until a chance encounter reveals she is one of the Mohiri, an ancient race of demon hunters.

odyssey-one.blurb: Captain Eric Weston and the crew of the NAC ship Odyssey, on humanity's first deep-space mission, are drawn into a local war between two alien species and must decide whether to intervene beyond their authority.

otrocka-krasa.blurb: Hanka has had a glowing gem set into her skin as a beauty mark; the unicorns around her stop speaking to her and the dragons react with alarm. Follows on directly from Pruvodce ztracenych.

pamet-kosti.blurb: Jamie Fraser, fighting on the losing side of his convictions in the American Revolution, comes face to face with the illegitimate son who serves as a British officer, while Claire's family two centuries later uncovers the story through letters.

pekelne-zvony.blurb: Samuel Johnson and his dachshund Boswell are pulled into Hell by the vengeful demon Mrs Abernathy, who wants payback for the failed invasion of the first book.

pet-nedel-v-balonu.blurb: Dr. Ferguson, a hunter friend and a comic manservant attempt to cross Africa from Zanzibar to Senegal in a specially designed balloon, surviving a run of narrow escapes along the way.

posledni-smrtelne-pouto.blurb: The trilogy's finale: the empire is consumed by war as the ancient, near-extinct Csestriim return to finish their purge of humanity, while gods walk the earth in human guise pursuing their own agendas.

pruvodce-ztracenych.blurb: At a school called Airbowan, on the border between life and death and taught by harpies, twins Tom and Sam face trials as Tom tries to save Sam's soul and reunite it with his body against dark forces.

ptaci-vodopady.blurb: A WWI veteran returns to his family's African land to find it seized and his grandfather dead, and is drawn into General Sean Courtney's violent feud with his corrupt son Dirk.

samotarka.blurb: Sara Grey, having fled the Mohiri stronghold with Jordan, sets out to find the one person who can answer her questions about her past, gaining new allies and growing powers along the way.

stitch.blurb: When robots kidnap Stitch, Lilo sets out to find him - but Stitch has already escaped and will do anything, even flee to the ends of the world, to protect his new family.

theatre-macabre.blurb: In a city where the bored aristocracy is entertained by a traveling troupe of deviants, a captain of the guard hunts a mutilated-body killer while a legendary hunter of people arrives with his own agenda.

vonava-lekarna.blurb: When the magic powder Meteor is stolen, Lucie and her friends chase the thief to Amsterdam to save her friend's father from a curse-scent.

zacatek-nove-ery.blurb: In 1919 Hamburg, midwifery trainee Henny and three friends -- rebellious Kathe, wealthy Ida, and independent teacher Lina -- build a lifelong bond that carries them through the interwar years, the rise of the Nazis, and the Second World War.

zlodejicek-z-patych-hradeb.blurb: Now seventeen, Hanka unexpectedly meets the nanny she doesn't remember, who claims that Hanka's father, believed dead, is actually alive.

atlasuv-komplex.blurb: The six surviving initiates of the Alexandrian Society, bound by a deadly bargain they have failed to satisfy, turn against each other as their patron's true plan for their power comes to a head.

dva-roky-prazdnin.blurb: A schooner carrying a group of British, French and American schoolboys is swept out to sea in a storm and wrecked on an uninhabited Pacific island, where the boys must govern and provision themselves for two years until rescue.

posledni-den.blurb: Two years after an EMP attack devastated the United States, John Matherson's small Black Mountain community must resist a new, authoritarian federal government moving to cede US territory abroad.

aliance-udatnych.blurb: Seventh-grader Tomas, alias Skrcek, is more confident battling monsters in the video game Aliance udatnych than facing two bullies at school - until the real and virtual worlds start to merge.

arena.blurb: In Rome under Emperor Claudius, a soldier is ordered to train a young, inexperienced recruit to survive the arena against a champion gladiator who has already beaten the empire's best fighters.

barva-nachu.blurb: Celie, an abused and uneducated Black woman in the early-20th-century rural South, endures a forced marriage until her husband's mistress, the blues singer Shug Avery, becomes her friend, lover, and the catalyst for her independence.

bezuzdna-blahoslavenstvi-baltazara-b.blurb: A picaresque following the wealthy, neglected Balthazar B from a Parisian childhood through English boarding school and Trinity College Dublin, tracking his friendship with the roguish Beefy and a string of romantic and sexual entanglements along the way.

bili-havrani.blurb: In a fictional medieval kingdom, a scheming regent seizes power after the king's death and plots to force the orphaned princess into marriage, driving the prince and princess to flee and fight for the throne.

bourlive-ticho.blurb: Trying to settle back into an ordinary home after their coastal walk, the author struggles with fear of people and the future while her husband's illness continues to progress, until an unexpected act of generosity gives them a new place to live.

bratri-ve-zbrani.blurb: In Rome, the imperial secretary's men capture a messenger for dangerous conspirators and torture out of him a plot to derail the Roman campaign against Caratacus, leader of the British tribes still resisting Rome.

carojas.blurb: An orphan forced to work in a cruel orphanage's match factory rescues an abandoned fairy child, escapes with help from the boy's tiny forest-guardian family, and returns to free the other orphans.

cas-mezi-nami.blurb: A teenage girl in 1995 Illinois and a time-traveling teenage boy from 2012 fall in love, knowing he could be pulled back to his own time without warning.

cena-za-krale.blurb: In 1647, with the English Civil War's outcome undecided and the King under house arrest, Tom Neave must balance his loyalty to a divided Parliament against his estranged Royalist father and the safety of his own young family.

cerna-labut.blurb: A nonfiction argument that rare, unpredictable, high-impact events ("black swans") shape history and markets far more than the models we use to plan for them admit, illustrated through finance, history and the nature of hindsight bias.

daleka-cesta.blurb: In 1939, an affluent Jewish family in Czechoslovakia flees the German occupation with their six-year-old son and his nanny, who is drawn into an affair with a Nazi collaborator that threatens the family's escape.

darwinsky-vytah.blurb: In the 23rd century, an alien-built space elevator in Darwin, Australia is the only safe zone left on a virus-ravaged Earth; an immune scavenger and his crew get caught in a power struggle over the elevator's future.

dejiny-ruska-20-stoleti.blurb: A two-volume academic history of Russia from the fall of tsarism through 2007, written by a team of Russian historians led by Andrej Zubov, examining why post-tsarist Russia's path led to a modernizing but totalitarian regime.

den-cisaru.blurb: Back from campaign in Hispania, Cato and Macro want to return to ordinary soldiering, but rival factions fighting for control over Rome force Cato to play a dangerous game to survive, trusting only Macro.

denik-1938-1945.blurb: A diary kept by a Jewish girl in Prague and then Terezin and Auschwitz between the ages of ten and fourteen, later expanded with retrospective sections and an interview after she reclaimed the notebooks hidden by her uncle.

divka-v-podivne-zemi.blurb: Sophia has spent her whole life in a valley community sealed off from a world she is told is ravaged by war. When her friend Mirko disappears over the mountains, she follows him and discovers a highly advanced society instead of a battlefield.

dlouha-valka.blurb: Direct continuation of Dlouha zeme: humanity has spread across countless parallel Earths connected by airship trade routes, but as people try to adapt the Long Earth to themselves, the Long Earth adapts them back, and tensions boil over into crisis.

dlouha-zeme.blurb: An eccentric inventor publishes plans for a simple homemade device that lets anyone 'step' into an endless chain of parallel, uninhabited Earths; drifter Joshua Valiente, who can step without the device, sets out with the AI Lobsang to explore how far the Long Earth goes.

dym-nad-brezinkou.blurb: A political prisoner's account of nearly three years at Auschwitz-Birkenau, written in a distinctive third-person documentary style intended to represent the collective fate of the camp's prisoners rather than a single personal voice.

fackovani-andele.blurb: A biographically-toned account of the author's personal and often painful experiences from the 1950s to the present, set against the political and social changes of Czechoslovakia and the Czech Republic.

hora-v-mori.blurb: A marine biologist is invited by a secretive tech corporation to study a newly discovered species of hyper-intelligent octopus on a sealed-off archipelago, while an AI-crewed fishing vessel and a corporate-built android pursue parallel questions about machine consciousness.

hra-o-manzelstvi.blurb: At Brown University in the early 1980s, English major Madeleine Hanna falls into an intense relationship with the brilliant, troubled Leonard while her devoted friend Mitchell searches for meaning abroad, and the three navigate love, mental illness and faith into the years after graduation.

invictus.blurb: Mid-first-century Rome under Claudius continues to expand. After hard fighting in Britain, the inseparable Prefect Cato and Centurion Macro are sent to Hispania, which refuses to submit.

jazyk-draku.blurb: In an alternate 1923 London where dragons and humans are bound by an unequal Peace Agreement, a rule-abiding translation student accidentally triggers a civil war and takes a dangerous code-breaking job to save her arrested family.

kdyz-panda-tanci.blurb: After his wife's death in a car accident leaves their young son unable to speak and he loses his job, a struggling father takes up busking in a worn panda costume in the local park - and becomes the only one who can reach his traumatized son, who doesn't know the panda is his own father.

klic-k-rebece.blurb: Cairo, 1942: Nazi spy Alex Wolff feeds Rommel's advancing army British intelligence using a code keyed to Daphne du Maurier's Rebecca, while British officer William Vandam races to catch him with the help of a courtesan he recruits to get close to Wolff.

kluci-z-glasgow.blurb: Two young men who were close as boys in the Scottish foster care system, now estranged, separately try to build stable adult lives - one training as a nurse, one newly settled with foster parents - while carrying the trauma of the care system and wondering whether to reconnect.

knihovnik-a-malirka-casu.blurb: A young artist travels to a sleepy Korean town to claim an inheritance and finds a deck of hand-painted fortune cards, a mysterious cafe owner, and a temple hiding a legend that becomes the key to traveling through time.
knihovnik-a-malirka-casu.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

kobky-pod-potalou.blurb: In 1968, Red Guards occupy Tibet's Potala Palace and imprison the Dalai Lama's former court painter, who recalls his life devoted to sacred art while they work to destroy every trace of it.

kruan-ze-zlute-planety.blurb: An omnibus collecting a classic Czech science-fiction adventure comic strip, following the character Kruan across two serialized trilogies of episodic adventures.

krvavi-havrani.blurb: Rome's grip on Britain is being tested by the fanatical resistance leader Caratacus, who has already worn the legions down. Two of the army's most experienced soldiers return to the province after years away.

kukuricny-mesto.blurb: Sixteen-year-old Austin records in obsessive detail how he and his best friend Robby accidentally unleash an unstoppable army of giant praying mantises on their small Iowa town, all while sorting out his feelings for his girlfriend and for Robby.

legie.blurb: A former gladiator turned rebel leader, who already caused huge damage during a slave uprising, is fleeing justice and still threatening Rome's stability; Cato and Macro are sent after him, with personal scores of their own to settle.

leonard-a-hladovy-paul.blurb: Two solitary, unremarkable men in their thirties - one a children's-encyclopedia writer newly grieving his mother, one a substitute postman living with his parents - navigate ordinary life: a sister's wedding, a workplace competition, and a tentative romance, largely without conflict.

maxmilian.blurb: In an alternate 19th-century Austria-Hungary where an assassination attempt on Franz Josef I succeeded, his brother Maximilian rules as emperor and has just defeated France and Italy in the north, now facing pressure from Prussia to keep Austria's place in the German Confederation.

mazel.blurb: In a city that insists its monsters are gone, a girl and a creature that climbs out of her mother's painting hunt down a real danger hidden inside a trusted household.

mezi-vilami.blurb: A multigenerational saga following the Boyle family of Dublin from the late 1950s to 2002, tracking ambition, thwarted expectation, and the changing shape of Ireland through parents Declan and Sinead and their children Owen and Issie.

mnoho-smrti-laily-starr.blurb: The goddess of death is fired from her post when a baby is born who will one day discover immortality, and is reincarnated as a mortal woman who repeatedly dies while deciding whether to kill the child.

murodejka.blurb: A young apprentice tasked with tending her desert village's sacred moon-moths struggles with the isolation of the job and what it costs her friendships.

na-hrane-koule.blurb: A girl named Eliska grows from childhood into adolescence believing she has already lived through everything and has nothing left to lose, while the adults and institutions around her repeatedly fail her.

na-vetrne-hurce.blurb: Heathcliff, an orphan taken in by the Earnshaw family, and Catherine grow up devoted to each other, but when she marries a neighboring landowner instead, his consuming resentment reshapes both families across two generations.

nadeje-umira-posledni.blurb: A Polish-Jewish woman's autobiographical account of surviving the Warsaw ghetto and the Majdanek, Auschwitz, Ravensbruck and Neustadt-Glewe camps as a teenager, written as an adult roughly two decades later.

nebe-v-plamenech.blurb: A woman who has survived alone in the jungle for years is pulled into a heist against a tyrannical dragon regent's hoard, and finds herself drawn into the politics and romance of the dragon-ruled cloud cities.

nebezpecne-krasny.blurb: A teenage girl who has always been able to see invisible faeries is pursued by the Summer King, who believes she is the queen he has sought for centuries.

neobycejna-grace.blurb: A woman in the middle of a divorce and still grieving a family tragedy abandons her car in traffic and sets off across London with a cake, determined to reach her estranged sixteen-year-old daughter on her birthday.

orlova-korist.blurb: More than a year after the Roman invasion of Britain, the local war leader Caratacus keeps making life hard for the legions, and Emperor Claudius needs a clear victory to shore up his rule at home.

pirati.blurb: A young sailor, Telemachos, survives a pirate attack on his ship and is forced into a brutal choice: join the pirate crew or die, then must prove himself among a mutinous band.

plants-vs-zombies.blurb: Nate, Patrice and the inventor Crazy Dave repeatedly face Dr. Zomboss and his zombie armies, including a scheme that sends the fight across the past, present and future.

po-stezkach.blurb: The author and her husband Moth undertake a roughly 1,000-mile walk from Cape Wrath in Scotland's far north down through the highlands and on to the South West Coast Path, hoping the outdoors will again ease his declining health.

pobrezni-cesta.blurb: After losing their home and learning that her husband Moth has been diagnosed with a rare terminal illness, the author and Moth set off with almost nothing to walk the 630-mile South West Coast Path.

pohansky-pan.blurb: Estranged from his family and outlawed by the Church, Uhtred of Bebbanburg leads a band of outcasts north in a bid to retake his family's fortress while a Danish warlord threatens Wessex.

pohlednice.blurb: An anonymous postcard naming four relatives killed at Auschwitz prompts the author to reconstruct her Jewish family's history and, years later, to investigate who sent it.

posledni-hodina.blurb: Roman general Marcus Clodius Ballista learns of a plot to assassinate Emperor Gallienus as he leaves the Colosseum in twenty-four hours, and must evade the conspirators hunting him while racing to warn the emperor in time.

posledni-ukol-mabel-beaumontove.blurb: After her husband of sixty years dies, an 86-year-old widow finds a note from him reading only "Find D" and sets out to track down Dot, the childhood best friend and first love she lost touch with decades earlier under the social pressure of the 1950s.

pretorian.blurb: Rome in 50 AD is riven with plots and a dangerous grain shortage that threatens to spark riots. Conspirators calling themselves the Liberators pose the gravest threat yet to Emperor Claudius.

prodam-2-deti.blurb: During the Great Depression, a struggling reporter's staged photograph of two children with a 'for sale' sign launches his career - and when a real mother sells her own children after his story runs, he and a colleague set out to find and reunite the family.

propast-casu.blurb: In a world where history has fractured and reassembled into a patchwork of colliding eras, two rival empires - a British Empire from 1900 and a Roman Empire led by the story's heroine - struggle for control of the new Europe this collision has created.

ptacatko.blurb: In a future Canada at war with an American theocracy called the New Vatican, a young Indigenous girl whose mother was taken by the enemy becomes the reluctant face of a rebellion.

pteranodon.blurb: A factual, comic-style recreation of a Pteranodon's life, showing it hunting fish at sea while avoiding sea monsters and land predators, based on fossil evidence.

rebelske-srdce.blurb: In Budapest on the eve of the 1956 revolution, a young woman whose parents were executed by the secret police must decide whether to flee the country or fight for recognition of the injustice done to her family, aided by a magical river and an angel of death.

regaci-a-neznami-hrdinove-odboje.blurb: Four young friends whose parents work in the emergency-rescue services face bullying, a dangerous rafting accident, and peer pressure at school, while also hearing the stories of lesser-known heroes of the WWII resistance.
regaci-a-neznami-hrdinove-odboje.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

rezave-panny.blurb: In the summer of 1980, Phoebe Shaw watches the girls of her declining Cleveland neighborhood transform - their bones corroding like rusted metal - while she alone remains unchanged, and returns decades later to confront what happened.

rimska-cest.blurb: Fifteen years after the invasion of Britain, Centurion Macro leaves the legion to help his mother run an inn in Londinium and manage the land granted to him as a veteran.

rimska-krev.blurb: Cato and Macro escort the ruthless king Rhadamistus back to the Armenian throne, a client Rome would rather tolerate than lose to Parthia, over the objections of Armenians who preferred the man he displaced.

ritual.blurb: In a world where magic is part of everyday life, four girls approaching their sixteenth birthdays investigate the secretive coming-of-age Rite that will decide who they become.

robin-druhy-a-jeho-rodina.blurb: A large family living together in one house, along with several dogs adopted by the two young daughters, gets into constant comic scrapes while renovating their home, told with warmth and humor.

sadako-sasaki-a-tisic-papirovych-jerabu.blurb: A biography of Sadako Sasaki, a Hiroshima survivor who developed leukemia a decade after the atomic bombing and folded paper cranes while hoping to recover, told for the first time by her older brother Masahiro alongside co-author Sue DiCicco.

sberatel-dymek.blurb: Ten short stories, each unspooling from a pipe washed up by a cold tide in the Dead Man's Fjord, carrying the reader from the Tsarist court to Siberia, pre-war Berlin, Brazilian favelas and Berber lands, with characters from Kettu's earlier novel and historical figures recurring across them.

sharpova-pomsta.blurb: In the chaotic peace after Napoleon's exile to Elba, Richard Sharpe is framed for stealing the Emperor's treasury and must clear his name while his estranged wife schemes against him at home.

silnejsi-nez-smrt.blurb: Three childhood friends in Rome - an aspiring novelist, a champion cyclist, and a Jewish mathematics prodigy - are pulled apart by Mussolini's fascism and the Nazi occupation, and a decades-old paternity secret reveals how their fates were decided.

sloup-do-nebe.blurb: A renegade scientist and a Ukrainian-born physicist campaign to build a space elevator as the world slides toward war over water and energy.

smrt-cisari.blurb: The future of Roman Britain hangs by a thread: after the Iceni queen is captured, several native tribes unite in revolt, and Centurion Macro and Prefect Cato face the hardest fight of their lives.

spodek.blurb: A schizophrenic sixteen-year-old escapes a psychiatric hospital and descends into the New York subway system, pursued by his mother and a police detective, convinced he must find a girl from his past to prevent the end of the world.

star-wars.blurb: Three short stories set after the Battle of Endor: Luke Skywalker defends the New Republic from a mercenary gang, Han Solo investigates a deadly underworld mystery, and Leia Organa confronts a new alliance opposed to the Republic's goals.

stin-legendy.blurb: Decades into a war against an alien enemy, Earth has become a vast military-industrial complex ringed by satellite cities; agent John Francis Kovar is sent to confirm the existence of a weapon that threatens the wider metauniverse.

sto-roku-lenni-a-margot.blurb: On the terminal ward of a Glasgow hospital, 17-year-old Lenni befriends 83-year-old Margot, and together the two decide to paint one hundred pictures marking the combined hundred years of their lives, trading their stories as they go.

strasliva-zavrat.blurb: Five linked, fact-blended stories about real 20th-century scientists - Heisenberg, Schrodinger, Grothendieck, Haber, Einstein - whose breakthroughs carried them to the edge of madness and gave humanity the power to destroy itself.

sudety-ztraceny-raj.blurb: Ten short stories from leading contemporary Czech writers, set in the multi-ethnic Sudeten borderlands before the events of the Second World War and the postwar expulsion of the German population irrevocably changed the region.

syn-draka.blurb: In 1477, rumors spread that Vlad III Dracula did not die but returned as a vampire seeking revenge on those who killed him, drawing the Ottoman and Hungarian courts into the conflict.

tajemstvi-modrych-tresni.blurb: In a post-apocalyptic future where every child sickens with permanent exhaustion on reaching adolescence, an unheroic girl and her nervous monkey navigator journey into a mutant-filled wasteland in search of a rumoured cure.

tehotnej-buddha.blurb: A Czech mother's first-person account of a stillbirth and the high-risk pregnancy that followed, confronting the social taboo around infant loss and the medical system's lack of empathy with dark humor.

tymian-z-oxary.blurb: A girl is pulled into an unfinished undersea storybook world after its author dies, and must help restore order before chaos and evil take over.

ve-vterine.blurb: Sixteen-year-old Finn Miller dies in a car accident and is suspended between life and death, watching helplessly as her family and friends struggle to survive its aftermath.

vyhnanstvi.blurb: Emperor Nero's advisers push him to send his lover, a former slave, into exile on Sardinia to defuse a political threat. Cato, out of favour after leaving the Praetorian Guard, is given the job of escorting her there and a second task besides.

vykopavky.blurb: In the summer of 1939, widow Edith Pretty hires self-taught excavator Basil Brown to dig the burial mounds on her Suffolk property, uncovering an Anglo-Saxon ship burial as war approaches, told through the shifting perspectives of Pretty, Brown, and the young archaeologist Peggy Piggott.

vzkaz-na-zdi-zachodku.blurb: A teenager newly diagnosed with schizophrenia starts an experimental drug that suppresses his hallucinations so he can appear normal at a new school, where he falls for a girl who doesn't know his secret - until the drug starts to fail.

zariva-noc-hvezd-a-ledu.blurb: Alternating between Captain Arthur Rostron racing the Carpathia toward Titanic's distress call and third-class survivor Kate Connolly in a lifeboat, the novel follows a single night's rescue based on the true story.

zil-jsem-mezi-malomocnymi.blurb: A journalist sentenced to prison for bank fraud discovers his facility shares grounds with America's last leper colony, and forms unlikely friendships with the stigmatized patients living there.

zlata-sbirka-pohadek.blurb: Wendy and her brothers meet Peter Pan and fly with him to Neverland, discovering the Lost Boys' hideout and battling Captain Hook's pirates, in this Disney retelling of J. M. Barrie's story.

zradcove-rima.blurb: Rome prepares for war with Parthia but is not ready to fight until winter, so General Corbulo sends Cato to negotiate a peace the Parthian king cannot accept, buying time for the legions to muster.

mec-kralu.blurb: As the ailing King Edward of Wessex loses his grip on his heirs and followers, two rival claimants prepare to fight for the throne while Uhtred tries to keep his beloved Northumbria out of the coming war.

pisecnici-a-volani-tesakody.blurb: After 43 years of hibernation and a 24-light-year voyage, cadet Tomas and his friends wake to a new age of human space exploration, training at a space academy while Tomas becomes fixated on a mysterious alien artifact, the tesakoda.

pisen-mece.blurb: Uhtred, the Northumbrian Saxon raised among Vikings, is drawn into a fight over London as Danish raiders and Saxon lords both try to control the city.

plamenonosic.blurb: With a fragile truce holding between the Saxons and the Danes, Uhtred of Bebbanburg finally gets his chance to retake the family fortress stolen from him by his treacherous uncle.

prazdny-trun.blurb: When the ruler of Mercia dies without a male heir, Uhtred of Bebbanburg backs the dead lord's widow, Aethelflaed, in the fight over who will rule.

sharpovo-waterloo.blurb: As Napoleon marches on Brussels, Richard Sharpe tries to warn an inexperienced Dutch commander before the armies collide at Waterloo.

smrt-kralu.blurb: As King Alfred's health fails, Uhtred of Bebbanburg must decide where his loyalty lies while the Danes sense an opportunity to strike at a weakened Wessex.

srsen-leta-v-noci.blurb: Nazi-occupied Denmark, 1941: a pastor's son discovers a secret German radar installation that is shooting down British bombers, and must fly a derelict biplane across the North Sea to warn the RAF before a major raid.

triceratops.blurb: A factual, comic-style recreation of a Triceratops navigating threats and dangers of its prehistoric environment, based on fossil evidence.

valecnici-boure.blurb: Uhtred of Bebbanburg must choose between family and the Saxon cause as Norse warriors threaten the fortress city of Chester.

valka-vlku.blurb: Newly restored to his family fortress, Uhtred of Bebbanburg is drawn back into the wider war as King Edward's health fails and rebellion stirs in Mercia.

ztracene-svety-2001.blurb: A collection of deleted scenes, alternate drafts, and journal entries from the four-year process of writing a famous science-fiction novel, alongside the short story that inspired it.

zaslana-posta.blurb: A condemned confidence trickster is spared the gallows on condition that he reopen Ankh-Morpork's collapsed postal service, against the semaphore company that replaced it.

mali-bohove.blurb: A novice in a militant church discovers that his god now has exactly one believer left, and that a god's power is the number of people who believe in him.

podivny-regiment.blurb: A girl cuts off her hair and enlists in her country's army under a false name to find her brother, in a nation whose state religion keeps adding to a list of forbidden things.

nadelat-prachy.blurb: The new master of a royal mint that loses money on every coin it strikes introduces paper currency into a metal economy.

otec-prasatek.blurb: The Discworld's midwinter gift-bringer has been removed by an attack on the belief in him, and Death takes over the round while his granddaughter looks for the culprit.

uzasny-mauric.blurb: A talking cat and a troop of self-aware rats run a Pied Piper confidence trick on country towns until one town turns out to have something worse in its cellars.

pyramidy.blurb: A boy trained as an assassin is recalled to rule a river kingdom that has spent seven thousand years building pyramids, and finds out what the pyramids do to time.

tezke-melodicno.blurb: A new kind of music arrives on the Discworld that is alive and plays its players, while Death's granddaughter takes over his duties.

pravda-the-truth.blurb: A gentleman's son who writes a hand-copied newsletter acquires a printing press, invents the newspaper, and finds himself investigating who framed the city's ruler.

pod-parou.blurb: A locomotive is built on the Discworld and the continent reorganises itself around the railway that follows.

pohyblive-obrazky.blurb: A place is found where the barrier between the imagined and the real has worn thin, and a film industry grows on top of it.

hrrr-na-ne.blurb: An uninhabited island surfaces between two cities and both claim it, while the Ankh-Morpork Watch commander investigates the first death of the resulting war.

magicky-prazdroj.blurb: An eighth son of an eighth son of an eighth son is born a source of raw magic, and the Discworld's wizards begin a war over it.

erik-eric.blurb: A teenage demonologist summons a demon and gets a failed wizard instead, then spends his three wishes on the Discworld's version of Faust's bargain.

zajimave-casy.blurb: A revolution in the Discworld's oldest empire is set off by a pamphlet, and a failed wizard is sent there because someone asked for a Great Wizard.

posledni-kontinent.blurb: A failed wizard is stranded on a hot, dry southern continent that has stopped raining, while a party of academics is lost at another point in time.

sekac.blurb: Death is dismissed from his post, so nothing on the Discworld dies properly and the unclaimed life force has to go somewhere.

andel.blurb: On her first assignment a guardian angel falls in love with the earthly boy she is supposed to watch over, while he occasionally glimpses her and her superiors keep watch on them both.

atlantida.blurb: Missing planes and ships in the Bermuda Triangle, the Devil's Sea and a region of Cambodia turn out to be the work of an ancient hostile force, and a former Green Beret who once survived it is called back to face it.

azincourt.blurb: Nicholas Hook, an English archer under sentence of death, escapes the noose by joining an expedition to France and marches with Henry V through the siege of Harfleur to the battle of Agincourt in 1415.

benrok.blurb: After the tyrant Hestis is defeated and a new queen takes the throne, his son Benrok flees her soldiers, tries to find a place in the changed kingdom, and is courted by his father's old allies who want the new rule undone.

bila-perla.blurb: In 1941 British Malaya, Constance Hadley, the bored wife of a rubber planter, flees the Japanese advance on the family yacht with her husband, her son, friends, stowaways and an enigmatic boat dealer who is the only man who can navigate the islands.

bozi-pest.blurb: During the 1990-91 Gulf War, SAS officer Mike Martin goes undercover in occupied Kuwait and then Baghdad to find a suspected Iraqi superweapon before the Allied ground offensive begins.

bud-jako-reka.blurb: In 1948 Colorado, Victoria Nash meets a drifter while delivering peaches from her family's orchard; the meeting changes both their lives. After a tragedy she survives alone in the mountains as the Gunnison River is dammed and her family's land is submerged.

carovenik.blurb: Stepan goes into the woods on Walpurgis Night to find a witch's-broom growth he wants to graft, and runs into three mysterious figures who turn the outing into a nightmare. The same day he meets Jindriska, the only person who can help him.

cerny-dort.blurb: Estranged siblings Byron and Benny reunite after their mother's death to find they have been left a traditional Caribbean black cake and a long voice recording, in which she tells the story of a young swimmer who fled her island home under suspicion of murder.

cesta-ctnosti.blurb: Antonia Caenis, an imperial household slave and later freedwoman, and Vespasian, a country-born officer with a career to build, meet in the palace under Tiberius and keep returning to each other across the reigns of Caligula, Claudius and Nero as he climbs towards the throne.

cesta-pousti.blurb: A partly autobiographical novel following Stepan, a Czech Jewish adolescent, through first loves, work on the land, his relations with his parents and the competing ideologies of the twentieth century, with the Second World War largely as context.

cestovatelska-krev.blurb: Eveline, a young competitive runner raised by her mother, escapes a dangerous situation during a forest training run by crossing into a parallel world, where she joins the Order of Travellers, learns to use her ability and faces what hunts travellers.

chasidske-povidky-z-doby-holocaustu.blurb: Eighty-nine short tales of the Holocaust, recorded from survivors' oral testimony and set down in the form of the traditional Hasidic story. Most centre on East European Hasidim and turn on an intervention, a rescue or an act of loyalty.

chrlic.blurb: A stone gargoyle on St Vitus Cathedral comes to life in heavy rain and sets out into Prague to find out what its purpose is, meeting kind and hostile spirits and befriending a young girl.

cina.blurb: Beginning in 1839 on the eve of the First Opium War, the novel follows Chinese, British and American families through the Taiping Rebellion, the Boxer Uprising and the fall of the empire.

dedictvi-nibelungu.blurb: A century after Siegfried killed Fafnir, his descendants live in Iceland, where prince Sigfinn plans a future with Brynja until the Nibelungs persuade the gods to alter time and the pair wake in a dark age ruled by the immortal Hurgan.

denik-dory-grayove.blurb: Hanka is uprooted from the city to the countryside and hates it until she finds an old notebook in the attic, the diary of Dora Grayova. She sets out to discover what became of its author and of her Jewish friend during the war.
denik-dory-grayove.coverNote: no cover on Open Library after two passes (2026-08-31)

diplomatova-zena.blurb: Marta Nederman, a Polish resistance member, survives a Nazi camp and meets Paul, an American soldier, at the liberation. After his death she marries a British diplomat, and two years later British intelligence sends her back to Poland to identify a traitor.

dum-na-utesu.blurb: After her mother's death Rebecca finds a letter from an elderly Cornish cousin, Olivia, begging for help to save her house. She goes down to restore the crumbling clifftop property and uncovers what happened there during the Second World War.

holky-z-detroitu.blurb: Cleaning a 1920s car she inherited, Melanie finds her distant aunt Violet's journal in a hidden compartment; Violet's account of leaving Kentucky for Detroit runs alongside Melanie's own choice between a promotion and love.

hrichy-rodu-borgiu.blurb: Esther, a Jewish girl baptised and renamed Violante, enters the household of Lucrezia Borgia as a lady-in-waiting and follows her to Ferrara for her marriage to Alfonso d'Este, while becoming entangled with Lucrezia's brother Cesare.

hubert-hugo.blurb: Ten short comics episodes following Hubert and Hugo, a fearless father-and-son pair of mountaineers, through encounters with the elements, ancient creatures and their own family past.

hubitel.blurb: A collection of short pieces and routines by William S. Burroughs, published in 1973, ranging over an exterminator's trade, political satire and hallucinatory fragments.

ilustrado.blurb: The body of Crispin Salvador, a controversial figure of Philippine letters, is pulled from the Hudson River and the manuscript of his last book is missing. His student Miguel returns to Manila and reconstructs his life from his writings, interviews and memoirs.

in-the-lives-of-puppets.blurb: Victor Lawson, the only human in a forest treehouse he shares with the android who raised him and two eccentric machines, repairs a salvaged android called Hap and uncovers a shared past that brings the Authority down on the family and takes them across a hostile country to rescue his father.

invaze.blurb: Britain, AD 44: Optio Horatius Figulus, picked for the mission because his half-Celtic parentage gives him the local language, escorts a deposed king of the Durotriges to Lindinis to overthrow a usurper, against an imperial envoy's interference and a druidic sect stirring revolt.

jak-se-vari-drak.blurb: Adam lives on a colony ship and learns at school to modify living creatures by genetic engineering; bored with giving rats gills, he sets out to build an intelligent fire-breathing dragon of his own.

kamzikuv-velky-skok.blurb: A young chamois loses his older brother, and with his mother's help learns to live with the death and jump the gap of fear and confusion.

kdo-odejde-uz-se-nevraci.blurb: Raised in the insular Skverer Hasidic sect and married at eighteen, the author's curiosity leads him from a forbidden radio to a public library and the internet, until his faith gives way. He is expelled from his village for heresy and loses contact with his five children.

kdo-zastavi-dest.blurb: Sixteen-year-old Ema emigrates to her grandparents in Britain after 1968 and spends a summer on Cyprus among the wealthy British set, where she meets a British soldier, James. Their correspondence continues as the island slides toward the Turkish invasion.

klan-gucci.blurb: A journalist's account of the Gucci family and its company, from the founder through the Investcorp buyout and the Tom Ford turnaround, framed by the 1995 shooting of Maurizio Gucci in Milan and the conviction of his ex-wife Patrizia Reggiani for arranging it.

kniha-o-tichu.blurb: Josef Formanek retells stories from his own travels and from people he met - beyond the Arctic Circle, in the Serengeti, in the rainforest - built around moments of silence in which someone has to decide how to go on.

kniha-ztracenych-jmen.blurb: A retired librarian in Florida recognises a photograph of a book she last saw in 1944, a forger's ledger in which she and a fellow forger encoded the real names of Jewish children given false papers to reach Switzerland.

kolos.blurb: Babylon, 323 BC: Alexander the Great survives, and turns the war elephants he brought back from India towards Carthage. A young elephant handler, the only man who can calm the beast Colossus, rises through the Macedonian ranks and has to choose between his ambition and what he loves.

kralovna-parize.blurb: Paris under German occupation: Coco Chanel lives at the Ritz among the Reich's High Command while trying to wrest full control of her perfume company from her Jewish business partner, and agrees to travel to Spain as a spy in exchange for protection.

kralovnin-klenotnik.blurb: From 1593: George Heriot, goldsmith and lender to Anna of Denmark, follows the Scottish court south when James VI inherits the English throne, financing the crown and navigating palace intrigue and English contempt for the Scots.

krev-budoucnosti.blurb: In a near-future New York divided by a wall, a parent who has lost the means to treat a terminally ill daughter accepts a criminal offer to have the child continue in a virtual world, which puts her against the surveillance state.

kronika-zlatych-casu.blurb: Nine previously unpublished science-fiction stories by a Czech writer, about murderous angels, intelligent cats, vampires in Zizkov, successful entrepreneurs and other creatures living among us.

legenda-o-brokenu.blurb: Presented as a rediscovered ancient manuscript, the novel alternates between the walled city of Broken, whose army commander and merchant lord manoeuvre as plague and war approach, and the exiled forest-dwelling Bane, whose tracker allies with a mutilated philosopher to bring the city down.

louceni-s-jeruzalemem.blurb: A late novel by a Czech-Israeli writer in which a concentration-camp past, present-day Jewish-Palestinian politics, a death and a prophecy converge on the discovery of love, erotic and spiritual, between two people well into middle age in Jerusalem.

lovkyne.blurb: A British war correspondent turned Nazi hunter, a Soviet night bomber pilot who survived his target, and a teenage photographer in post-war Boston converge on a German woman who murdered civilians and then vanished.

matrjoska.blurb: An undefined catastrophe empties the world of people and animals; Karel, who was in a fallout shelter, wakes to a changed Prague and the handful of others who also survived underground must decide what to do next.

mesicni-stin.blurb: A hippie is abducted from Earth by inscrutable beings of light and gives birth to Moonshadow, who escapes a deep-space zoo and grows up crossing a universe at war; the story is narrated by Moonshadow in old age.

mesto-rozkvetu.blurb: New York from 1864: Joshua Turner, home from the Civil War with a peg leg, sets out to build the city's first steel-framed apartment buildings uptown, opposed by an enemy from his past, while the Turner and Devrey family fortunes shift around him.

mesto-v-oblacich.blurb: Five lives across six centuries - a girl in besieged Constantinople, a boy on an Ottoman farm, a Korean War veteran translating Greek in an Idaho library, a teenager who brings a bomb into that library, and a girl aboard a ship bound for an exoplanet - are linked by a fragmentary ancient tale about a man trying to reach a city in the clouds.

milenci-v-roce-2042.blurb: In a near-future Europe reshaped by a directive on religious correctness, a young Czech doctor studying in Germany meets Yamina, a devout Muslim student, and their relationship becomes the centre of the book.

moriandr.blurb: Twins Michal and Marie are brought a cat wearing a medallion marked M by a strong wind, and are taken on a journey through the fantasy landscapes of the kingdom of Moriandr.

mosty-pres-propast-casu.blurb: Two loosely linked novels in one volume, in which descendants of an advanced human civilisation return from space to Earth and find themselves among the wars, slave raids and religious hatred of the sixteenth century.

na-prvni-pohled.blurb: Rachel, a courtroom reporter, breaks off her engagement and by chance meets Ben, her inseparable university friend of ten years earlier, now a lawyer and married. Present-day chapters alternate with flashbacks to their student years.

navrat-z-nicoty.blurb: Martin Pistorius fell ill at twelve, lost speech and movement, and was diagnosed as vegetative. He regained awareness years before anyone realised it, and spent over a decade unable to signal that he was present, until a carer noticed and helped him learn to communicate by computer.

neco-uzasneho.blurb: Margot, an addicted prostitute on the run from her pimp, is helped by a strange boy called Kristian who performs what looks like a miracle the next day; her attempt to find out who he is draws her into a dark world and the attention of a powerful society.

nevinnost.blurb: Addison Goodheart, whose face drives anyone who sees it to murderous rage, lives hidden beneath a city until he meets Gwyneth, a young woman who cannot bear to be touched and is being hunted by the man who killed her father.

nocni-ptacata.blurb: In the city of Simta, the Nightbirds are girls who can gift magic with a kiss, hidden and guarded by the great houses and hunted by the church. Matilde, Aesa and Sayer spend their season bestowing gifts on paying clients until they learn their powers are stronger than they were told.

novy-hrabe-monte-christo.blurb: A Hungarian nobleman's conspiracy is betrayed and he is condemned; he escapes, and fifteen years later returns under another name as a wealthy doctor to bring the men who informed on him to justice.

novy-vek.blurb: On the factual record of the seventeenth-century Jewish Sabbatian heresy and the false prophet Sabbatai Zevi, Bondy builds a parable about hope, belief and whether a society can be changed.

od-seminka-v-prach.blurb: Marc Hamer records his last year as the sole gardener on a twelve-acre Welsh estate, season by season, alongside the plants and animals he works among and the reticent widowed owner he has worked for over two decades.

ostrov-ztracenych-snu.blurb: Lorelei learns she has inherited property in Tasmania and travels there to find out who left it to her and what really happened to her father, running into her hostile stepmother and an unexpected love.

panna-ve-zbroji.blurb: Joan of Arc's childhood friend and secretary, writing sixty years after her death, recounts her life from the village of Domremy through the campaign that crowned a king to her trial and burning at Rouen.

po-stopach-ztraceneho-syna.blurb: Vojta, Jindra and Tereza have already uncovered the secrets of a treasure cave and an old brickworks, but their friendship has soured. Jindra runs away from home to a half-ruined gamekeeper's lodge, where a loose stone in the wall hides letters a hundred years old.

pohadka-z-hnizda.blurb: A young blackbird tells the story of its first spring in the garden of a big house, in a series of short adventures seen from a bird's point of view.

popletene-pocitani.blurb: An interactive counting book in which a prince enlists a wizard to free a princess from a dragon, the wizard's spells go wrong and turn one dragon head into six, and the child is asked to count along.

druha-sance.blurb: A man and his young daughter cross a depopulated world looking for answers about a past neither of them remembers, hoping the sun will one day set again. The story moves between our own past and a distant future.

hlidka-na-konci-vesmiru.blurb: The Divide is the edge of the universe, and the Sentinels posted along it are exiles, convicts and soldiers nobody wanted. hranice-imperia.blurb: Daniel Hankerson, a genetically enhanced member of the imperial family, works for fleet intelligence and reads people for a living. hvezdni-honaci.blurb: Interstellar travel depends on giant hyperspace creatures nicknamed cows, which carry people, machines and raw materials in their bodies and are escorted by human herders. hvezdy-ceske-sci-fi.blurb: Five leading Czech science-fiction writers each contribute a previously unpublished short novel or novella set in the series they are best known for. The pieces are otherwise unconnected.

idealni-svet.blurb: In Munich in 2052 Samson Freitag works for the Agency for Life Counselling, which observes citizens around the clock so the state can place each of them where they serve society best. invaze-zlodeju-tel.blurb: In Mill Valley, California, Dr Miles Bennell finds his patients convinced that their relatives have been replaced by exact but emotionless duplicates, and traces the cause to giant seed pods that copy and absorb a living body while it sleeps.

kepler62-parvela.blurb: The child crew bound for the planet Kepler62e finally learn what their capsule concealed: a stowaway bent on power who intends to wipe out anyone inconvenient and rule as a dictator, and Marie, Ari and his little brother must defend themselves and their new home.

kepler62-sorland.blurb: In an overcrowded, resource-starved future, thirteen-year-old Ari looks after his younger brother Joni while hiding that their mother has vanished. kepler62-sortland.blurb: The expedition is settling in on Kepler62e; Ari stays at the base with his little brother Joni while Marie explores alone, and neither trusts the others after the tragedy that struck the grass people or the expedition leader's calm about a new virus among the children.

komanda-omega.blurb: The Omega commandos are saboteurs, spies and assassins answerable only to the emperor, their bodies improved by illegal genetic modification that also shortens their lives. koruna-otraveneho-stromu.blurb: A British soldier and Afghanistan veteran, the only survivor of a secret mission, is brought back to Edegom - a world ruled by a mad emperor where any resemblance to the practice of magic means death. kronovy-deti.blurb: Downtown is collapsing, families are being taken from their homes and mafias are seizing the city while the Council guard keeps Downtowners penned in until the Infection finishes them. kronuv-odkaz.blurb: The civil war is over, leaving Attiona City ruined; the uprising won Downtown its freedom along with hunger, lawlessness and a police regime.
