laila.blurb: Adam Baxa, an elite lawyer at a London firm, discovers a gap in his otherwise perfect memory, and the dazzling Laila who enters his life may be a product of genetic engineering.

laska-az-za-hrob.blurb: Cameron, a journalism student living on the run-down edge of a city, is hunted by an unseen pursuer with satellite surveillance and rifles, after a school assignment led her to a mystery the FBI could not solve.

let-305.blurb: A flight from New York to London loses power and crash-lands in the English countryside, where the survivors find the world around them is not the one they left. A handful of passengers turn out to be connected to why it happened.

lovci-relikvii.blurb: Two centuries after a religious war, a dictatorship of four self-proclaimed gods has banned all other worship; a human smuggler and her masked partner are hired to recover a relic of a faith nobody has heard of.

metro-2035.blurb: Twenty years after a nuclear war, the survivors live in the Moscow metro believing the surface is still lethal. Artyom keeps climbing up to search the airwaves for other survivors, convinced the stations' rulers are hiding that the world above is habitable.

mirzova-vize.blurb: On 21 June 2034 the world falls back into prehistory. One man is stranded at the end of the Mesozoic and another is left in the present, and both try to reverse the catastrophe.

mise-saturn.blurb: In 2066 an observatory employee notices that something entering the solar system is slowing down, which means it is a ship. The United States and China each mount an expedition to reach the alien vessel parked in Saturn's rings first.

misteri.blurb: The city is the only world its inhabitants know, and outside its walls move twisted creatures; the valkeri are the ones who go out to bring back information and supplies, and most of them do not last long.

muzi-pod-ochranou.blurb: An encephalitis epidemic kills most sexually mature men, and women take political power in the United States. Dr Martinelli, one of the surviving men, is confined to a guarded research institute to develop a vaccine while the new regime tightens around him.

na-vrchol.blurb: An enormous mountain appears in the middle of the Pacific and a scientist of unexplained phenomena joins the expedition sent to reach its summit. The higher the team climbs, the less its members can hold on to time or to their own memories.

nad-ceskymi-zememi-slunce-nezapada.blurb: In 1848 a catastrophe erases parts of the Earth's surface and the oceans rise, destroying some states and creating others - among them the Czecho-Slovak Kingdom. By the 1940s it is a naval power, and it is not the only nation that wants to rule the oceans.

nadherne-posetila-snaha.blurb: Months after April May's disappearance, her friends - a social-media heir, a researcher and a grieving ex - separately pursue what became of her while a tech entrepreneur builds something new from the aliens' technology.

navigatori-duny.blurb: The founding of the Bene Gesserit sisterhood, of the mentat human computers and of the Spacing Guild's navigators, set against a conflict between reason and religious fanaticism.

neco-vic.blurb: A sixteen-year-old drowns himself and wakes, naked and alone, in the abandoned English town where he grew up, and sets out to work out where he is and whether anyone else is left.

nehodni.blurb: A Starfleet fleet returns to the Delta Quadrant to find out what became of the Borg after their absorption into the Caeliar, while Seven of Nine, neither Borg nor human, is tormented by a voice she cannot explain.

neni-krve-bez-ohne.blurb: John Francis Kovář, a former special-forces captain, takes part in the Agency's first mission into another spacetime, expected to be routine. He ends up at the battle of Austerlitz on 2 December 1805, with no means of influencing it.

neocekavany-roboti-exodus.blurb: Long after humanity has gone, the adventurer robot Meriwether and the strictly scientific William return from an exploring expedition to find they have been forgotten, and must avoid being recycled while learning what humans were.

nyxia-nespoutana.blurb: Emmett Atwater and the surviving Genesis crew reach the planet Babel calls Eden and its inhabitants call Magnia, and travel toward its largest city while mining nyxia. The Imago they were sent to deal with have secrets of their own, as does the corporation that hired them.

nyxia-povstava.blurb: Emmett and the Genesis crew ally with the Imago, whose city Babel has destroyed, and learn the planet is weeks from being made uninhabitable by a collision of its two moons. Both groups must reach Babel's orbiting ships and take them.

nyxia.blurb: Emmett Atwater, a fifteen-year-old from Detroit, signs a contract with the Babel corporation and boards a ship for the planet Eden to mine nyxia, the most valuable substance in the universe. Ten recruits from poor backgrounds spend the year-long flight competing, and only eight will be allowed to land.

obranci-civilizace.blurb: Daniel Hankerson has survived betrayal and assassination attempts and has repeatedly thwarted the New Protectorate, an enemy that subordinates everything to absolute order. To beat them he needs a large fleet, but most of the imperial navy is committed to a war at the far end of the empire against the Ralgary.

odchyleni.blurb: The twelve contestants of the Genesis programme, en route through space toward Mars, discover that the show they volunteered for is built on a deception. Leonor, who joined for fame and believed she had her feelings under control, opens up the programme's buried past.

odkaz-protektoru.blurb: Emperor Daniel Hankerson and his allies have ended the war on the far side of the Central Empire, and a fleet is gathering at Davenport for a decisive battle with the New Protectorate. First he has to open a superluminal gate left behind by the vanished Protector civilisation and deal with an enemy inside his own family.

ofelie-scaleova.blurb: In a near-future England where a king has outlawed technology, eighteen-year-old Ophelia Scale joins a resistance movement that wants artificial intelligence brought back. Selected to apply for the royal secret service so she can get close enough to kill the ruler, she falls for his brother instead.

ofenziva-ceskych-zemi.blurb: A continuation of the flooded-world alternate history in which the Czecho-Slovak Kingdom has become a naval power after the catastrophe of the mid-nineteenth century, and now goes on the offensive.

ohrozeni.blurb: The last survivors of the Genesis programme are back from a distant planet and thrown into the whirlwind of fame, launching their own video channels. The past they all wanted to forget resurfaces.

opravari-casu.blurb: Mirek and Maja are thrown together by one irreversible mistake, along with a grandfather who knows the secret of time travel and wants to undo his granddaughter's error but cannot do it himself.

pachatele-zvlastnich-cinu.blurb: In an alternative future where humanity has left space in chaos, keeping order is entrusted to machines rather than to people; five linked stories follow one protagonist through that arrangement.

paul-z-duny.blurb: After Paul Muad'Dib has taken Arrakis, his legions carry his jihad across the galaxy while he accumulates enemies and begins to doubt whether he is building order or chaos.

pisecnici-a-bludny-asteroid.blurb: On the backward desert planet Pisecnice, seven-year-old Lucka and eleven-year-old Tomas go to school, work the alien-dug mines and sleep in an orphanage until an interstellar ship arrives and invites some of them aboard.

podhoubi-smrti.blurb: Aggressive fungi attack the Moravian branch of Agency EF: giant boletes destroy vehicles, fly agarics release narcotic gases and puffballs wreck the equipment used to cross into parallel worlds. John Francis Kovář and his friends have seconds to respond.

pokoleni-starcu.blurb: Decades after nuclear tests in orbit left humanity and its animals sterile, an ageing Algernon Timberlane and his wife Martha flee their isolated village and travel down the Thames with a small group, looking for somewhere better. Interleaved chapters return to the early years of the sterility, when he was recruited to record the species' decline.

polocas-rozpadu.blurb: A loose continuation set in the same radioactive world after the war, where the old order has vanished and survival is brutal.

posledni-velkomesto.blurb: In the late twenty-third century, two hundred years after the Apocalypse, the inhabitants of the last great city in Europe have split into warring factions after an empress destroyed the social order. A soldier commanding a small army tries to protect civilians while a narrator untangles who is friend and who is enemy.

postak.blurb: Seventeen years after a nuclear and biological war, a wandering storyteller puts on a dead mail carrier's uniform and finds that surviving settlements treat him as the envoy of a government that no longer exists.

pratele-nadace.blurb: Seventeen writers contribute new stories set in Isaac Asimov's fictional universes, from the positronic robots to the Foundation, as a fiftieth-anniversary tribute. The volume adds prefaces, an afterword and reprints of three Asimov favourites.

problem-tri-teles.blurb: During the Cultural Revolution a Chinese military project secretly attempts contact with extraterrestrial civilisations. Forty years later prominent scientists are dying, a nanotech researcher is drawn into the investigation, and an immersive computer game about a world with three suns holds the explanation.

projekt-kronos.blurb: In 2052, after a nuclear war, Attiona City is one of the last outposts of civilisation, split between a recovering upper city and a Downtown still living the war's aftermath, and eaten from within by a mysterious epidemic. A young Downtowner who wants to be a hero and a recruit trained to hunt the city's most dangerous criminals are drawn into it.

psanci.blurb: Shana's younger sister walks out of the house one morning in a trance and cannot be stopped or woken; other sleepwalkers join her from across America, and a former CDC scientist is recruited to work out what the flock is walking toward.

pulnocni-nebe.blurb: An ageing astronomer refuses evacuation from an Arctic observatory after a catastrophe cuts off all news, and finds a silent child left behind. Millions of miles away an astronaut aboard a returning Jupiter mission tries to work out why every signal from Earth has stopped.

razova-vlna.blurb: In the radioactive ruins after the war, shapeshifting raiders roam and a cult gathers atomic warheads for one final detonation, believing God intended to destroy the world and needs the work finished.

reborn.blurb: Two years after the virus emptied Britain, Leon has survived two winters and hopes the cold has killed it off; news of a rescue ship reaches him, but the virus has not been idle.

remade.blurb: Leon and his younger sister Grace, newly moved from New York to London, watch a virus from Africa reach the city and dissolve the people around them, and must survive with a wary group of other survivors.

retezova-reakce.blurb: In a ruined, starving world of slavers and post-apocalyptic cults, a tattooed woman with followers who will do anything for her tries to restore the order of the old times as the hardest winter since the war approaches.

spad.blurb: In 2050, a few tens of thousands survive in the ruins of Prague and try to hold on to something like civilisation while the rest of the world fights for survival at anyone's expense.

spojenci-ceskych-zemi.blurb: Two years into the war between the Czecho-Slovak Kingdom and Tsarist Russia, both powers turn their attention to the American continent in search of allies.

sten.blurb: On Vulcan, a centuries-old factory world run by the Company, Karl Sten loses his family in an accident, rebels from the metal warrens beneath the plant, and is eventually recruited into the Eternal Emperor's forces.

stin-mrtveho.blurb: Two novellas: in one, a near-future run by organised crime whose rulers can turn victims into immaterial shadows; in the other, a parallel world where people live for centuries through repeated reincarnations and must destroy each old body.

stranger-things-bond.blurb: In 1969 Indiana, a college student joins a secret government experiment at a local laboratory, discovers she is being dosed with LSD, and meets a small girl with unusual abilities known only by a number.

stranger-things-capetta.blurb: At the start of sophomore year in Hawkins, Robin's friends decide to start pairing off and acting normal, a game she has played for years to avoid being noticed. Realising she likes girls, she sets out to save enough money to escape to Europe for the summer.

stranger-things-davies.blurb: After years of fighting monsters and with his friends scattered, Lucas Sinclair starts high school and finds options beyond his old circle. Joining the basketball team, he begins to work out what being a Black teenager in small-town Indiana means, just as Hawkins goes wrong again.

stranger-things-yovanoff.blurb: Max Mayfield, a skateboarding troublemaker moved from California to Hawkins, Indiana after her mother's remarriage, narrates her family life with her stepbrother Billy and the events of her first months in town.

stretnuti.blurb: The Genesis programme's first televised season is a hit and officially ends in a month, leaving twelve pioneers stranded on Mars ready to lie if lying gets them rescued. Audiences are excited by a new invention meant to help the contestants, without knowing the danger it carries.

studene-svetlo-hvezd.blurb: Nine stories and a novella of hard, grim science fiction: a wreck of a long-missing spaceship, a drop with marines against the creatures that wiped out most of humanity, an artificial moon, and a mass grave a long way from Earth.

svet-v-bouri.blurb: With humanity descending from its pillar-cities back to the ruined surface, a plan to make Earth habitable again requires uncovering the secrets of both the alien creatures and of the people who hid their own.

svetelne-kroky.blurb: Hynek Prokop, an unremarkable cook, quits his job on the day Earth and the surrounding galaxy are reduced to stellar dust. He has to survive and find a place for himself in an intergalactic community, the main rule being not to ask too much and not to go insane.

svetlo-pulsaru.blurb: Ten years after the Colonial Wars end in 2217, the widower Desmond Sommers takes his young daughter to the station Lighthouse in the pulsar system PSR 1257+12 to assume command, and finds his abrupt reassignment suspicious.

synteza.blurb: The starship Titan finds a region of space inhabited entirely by artificial intelligences at war with a destructive force called the Null; when the rescued AI frees Titan's own computer, the crew must decide whether they can still trust their ship.

temny-les.blurb: With an alien fleet four hundred years away and alien surveillance particles making Earth transparent, the UN grants four Wallfacers vast resources to devise strategies they must never explain to anyone. One of them is Luo Ji, an unambitious astronomer who does not know why he was chosen, and whom the enemy wants dead.

tezka-planeta.blurb: Seventeen classic science-fiction stories chosen around the scientific problems they dramatise, each followed by the compiler's short commentary on the real science behind it. Authors include Weinbaum, Heinlein, Clarke, Clement, Niven, Piper and Asimov himself.

typhonsky-pakt.blurb: Starfleet Intelligence sends two genetically enhanced agents, Julian Bashir and Sarina Douglas, to infiltrate a rival power and destroy its stolen slipstream-drive project, while a starship waits to extract them.

utek-z-arestonu.blurb: Four years in the orbital prison Areston have changed Srsen, who has survived betrayals and the whims of the powerful and emerges knowing secrets almost nobody shares.

utek-z-teritoria-smrti.blurb: Twenty years after martial law and the resettlement camps, three sixteen-year-old boys in the Republic of the True America discover what the camps are really for and run.

utopie.blurb: A traveller met in Antwerp first criticises the laws and rulers of Europe, then describes at length the island commonwealth of Utopia, its property arrangements, laws, work, war and religion.

uvezneni-v-robloxu.blurb: Three schoolchildren who play an online game are sucked into it by a rigged roulette and must survive a series of mini-games as avatars to escape.

v-tajne-sluzbe-koruny-ceske.blurb: A century after the oceans rose, the war between the Czecho-Slovak Kingdom and Tsarist Russia has stalled and both sides are rearming. The Czecho-Slovak port of Dresden fills with workers and sailors, and with saboteurs and spies, amid friction between Czechs, Germans and Russian immigrants.

ve-jmenu-zitrka.blurb: A man hides in a hole he has dug, hunted by machines that have killed most of the human population and whose origin he does not know. Between attempts to survive he remembers setting out on honeymoon in Italy with his wife.

vesmirna-zasilkovna.blurb: Nori, a boy bored on his family's base in the TRAPPIST-1 system, borrows a ship and ends up accidentally aboard the only delivery vessel of Gryfon's Express Space Courier Service. Gryfon bends the galactic rules on parcel transport, shortening routes and occasionally travelling against the flow of time.

vestcuv-rok.blurb: Will Dando, an unremarkable New York bassist, wakes from a dream knowing 108 things that will happen, and begins publishing them anonymously as the Oracle while the world tries to find out who he is.

vichry-duny.blurb: After Paul Atreides' death, his mother Jessica returns to Arrakis for the funeral while his sister Alia rules as regent and a former friend of Paul's turns against the family.

vladce-arestonu.blurb: Areston takes on new prisoners and sets off again while Srsen and his allies decipher the code to its sealed core, and a newcomer seizes half the object by force and manipulation.

vlci-zimy.blurb: Years after nuclear wars and a lethal flu, Lynn McBride survives with what remains of her family in the frozen Yukon, until the arrival of a stranger named Jax brings the secrets of why they fled there in the first place.

vymereny-cas.blurb: As the planet loses its magnetosphere and order breaks down, a professor hides his daughter in a remote prison, where she takes a job as its psychologist. A mismatched group is assembled for a journey to save life, and someone among them is trying to wreck the expedition.

vyslani.blurb: Six girls and six boys fly to Mars aboard a single ship in separate quarters, permitted six minutes together a week under constant cameras, and must each choose the partner they will spend the rest of their life with. Leonor, eighteen and an orphan, is one of the twelve contestants in the televised Genesis programme.

zakalena.blurb: In 2062 Jenny Casey, a maimed Canadian special-forces veteran living rough in Hartford, is pulled back toward the military programme that rebuilt her when a drug developed in secret for the army starts killing local children.

zeme-trva.blurb: A graduate student recovering from a snakebite in the California mountains comes home to find a pandemic has emptied the country. He spends the rest of his life among the handful of survivors and their children, watching what remains of civilisation come apart.

zeme-v-troskach.blurb: Generations after humanity built cities on vast pillars to escape a collapsing world, an expedition from a Slavic city descends to the surface to recover what could let people take Earth back from the predatory Cizinci.

zeme.blurb: Thirty years after their television-magnate father set them a game of hidden keys, one of his children is still trying to finish it. Her search connects to eight contestants in a show that promises to cut them off from the world forever, and it leads to Iceland.

zjizvena.blurb: Back in Canadian service at fifty, Jenny Casey is chosen to pilot the starship Montreal in search of a habitable world, while on Earth the rivalry between Canada, a corporate contractor and PanChina turns catastrophic.

zkouska-ohnem.blurb: Facing his own death, James Kirk lives inside the Nexus, a place assembled from his own memories, before being drawn out for one last mission that goes wrong.

klam.blurb: Gillian Grayson sets out to avenge her father's death at the hands of the Cerberus organisation, while an assassin steals a DNA-targeted bioweapon design and Admiral Anderson and Kahlee Sanders prepare to address the Citadel Council.

strastiplna-roboti-existence.blurb: In a snowbound North America long after humanity, the explorer robot Meriwether is trapped under an avalanche and the timid scientist robot William is his only hope; an accident on their flight from their own civilisation separates the pair.

_null_cover: null with a coverNote is a SETTLED row, not a gap: the search already ran on the date in the note and Open Library had nothing, so the app draws a typographic placeholder and its Gaps panel does not count it - re-running this script cannot clear it, and reporting it would name a shortfall the reader can do nothing about. Later runs skip it too; --retry-missing searches again. 'names a group, not a book' means the row covers an author or a category, so there is no single cover that would be honest. null with NO coverNote is the real gap: a row nothing has looked up yet.
